title: Reddit 深度研究报告 - 变现驱动增长与搜索流量依赖的压力测试
titleEn: Reddit Deep Research Report - Monetization-Driven Growth and the Search-Referral Dependency Stress Test
summary: 首次覆盖。Q2 2026 收入 $804.91M（同比 +61%）、净利 $252.85M、摊薄 EPS $1.25、调整后 EBITDA $343M（43% 利润率），全面超预期且 Q3 指引 $860-870M 同样高于预期，但财报后单日跌 21%（上市以来最大跌幅）。核心发现：增长引擎已从用户切换为变现——美国 DAU 环比 53.5M→53.2M 横盘略降，同期美国 ARPU 同比 +51%，本季美国收入增长几乎全部来自单用户变现。Google 数据授权协议（约 $60M/年）2027 上半年到期，同时绑定授权收入与搜索分发。以 2026-07-31 收盘 $140.67、市值约 $27.06B、EV 约 $24.30B 计，TTM P/E 32.8x、EV/Sales 8.7x、FY2026E 调整后 EV/EBITDA 约 16.8x。情景权重 30/50/20，立场为中性偏积极、低确信。
summaryEn: Initial coverage. Q2 2026 revenue of $804.91M (+61% YoY), net income $252.85M, diluted EPS $1.25, and adjusted EBITDA of $343M (43% margin) all beat, and Q3 guidance of $860-870M also came in above consensus, yet the stock fell 21% on the print — its largest single-day decline since IPO. Core finding: the growth engine has switched from users to monetization — U.S. DAU went 53.5M to 53.2M sequentially (flat to slightly down) while U.S. ARPU rose 51% YoY, so essentially all U.S. revenue growth in the quarter came from per-user monetization. The Google data-licensing agreement (roughly $60M/year) expires in H1 2027 and bundles licensing revenue with search distribution. At the 2026-07-31 close of $140.67, market cap is about $27.06B and EV about $24.30B, for a 32.8x TTM P/E, 8.7x EV/Sales, and roughly 16.8x FY2026E EV/adjusted-EBITDA. Scenario weights of 30/50/20 support a neutral-to-constructive stance at low conviction.
highlights: 增长换轨：美国 DAU 环比 53.5M→53.2M，同期美国 ARPU $9.63→$11.85（同比 +51%）；按 DAUq×ARPU 还原的收入与公司报告值误差 <0.05%
估值：TTM P/E 32.8x、P/S 9.7x、EV/Sales 8.7x、EV/EBITDA 30.3x（GAAP 口径）；FY2026E 调整后 EV/EBITDA 约 16.8x；净利含利息收入与低税率加成，跨公司比较需校正
关键风险：Google 授权协议约 $60M/年、2027 上半年到期；公司自 Q3 2026 起停止披露登录/未登录用户拆分

title: ASML 深度研究报告 - EUV / High-NA 作为设备层公共约束
titleEn: ASML Deep Research Report - EUV / High-NA as the Equipment-Layer Common Constraint
summary: AI 基础设施 semicap-equipment 层的公共约束：ASML 验证 foundry / memory capex 是否真正穿过光刻、EUV、High-NA、长期协议和出口管制这道最硬瓶颈。Q2 2026 net sales EUR 9.326B、gross margin 54.0%、net income EUR 2.918B；FY2026 指引第二次上调至 net sales EUR 43-45B、gross margin 54-56%，并计划把 2027 年 low-NA EUV 与 DUV immersion 产能各较 2026 年增加 30%。本次监测没有季度 net bookings 或 backlog 披露，因此只加强设备侧确认，不证明客户特定 capex 已全部承诺。2026-07-31 重新锚定至 2026-07-30 收盘 ADR $1,651.44、市值约 $636.5B、约 14.6x EV/2026E sales；倍数仍高于基准情景所设的高个位数至低十几倍区间，且立场并不主要依赖倍数，维持中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure semicap-equipment layer. ASML tests whether foundry and memory capex truly passes through lithography, EUV, High-NA, long-term agreements, and export controls. Q2 2026 net sales were EUR 9.326B, gross margin was 54.0%, and net income was EUR 2.918B; FY2026 guidance was raised for the second time to EUR 43-45B net sales and 54-56% gross margin, while ASML plans to add 30% to both 2027 low-NA EUV and DUV immersion capacity versus 2026. The update disclosed neither quarterly net bookings nor backlog, so it strengthens equipment-side confirmation without proving that customer-specific capex is fully committed. The $1,651.44 ADR and roughly 14.6x EV/2026E sales remain the dated 2026-07-02 initial valuation snapshot based on the then EUR 36-40B guide; this update does not refresh valuation or stance, which remains neutral watch / medium conviction.
highlights: P2 设备层公共约束：ASML 用 EUV/High-NA、backlog、installed-base service 和出口管制验证 AI capex 是否进入最硬工具瓶颈

stanceRationale.en: At $1,651.44 and about 14.6x EV/2026E sales, the market already prices EUV / High-NA scarcity, FY2026 revenue of EUR 36-40B, and manageable export controls; the 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid leaves the base case close to implied expectations, so skew is balanced.

upgrade.en: move to constructive if Q2 2026 orders and customer-capacity commentary show EUV / High-NA bookings staying above the FY2026 revenue run-rate, backlog conversion remains on plan, and export-control updates do not reduce the China service or systems opportunity while the valuation multiple does not expand further.

downgrade.en: move to cautious if EUV / High-NA bookings slow, the EUR 38.797B backlog shows cancellation or delay risk, China/export-control limits reduce system or installed-base service access, or gross margin slips below the FY2026 51-53% guide.

title: Applied Materials 深度研究报告 - AI 扩产的广谱半导体设备仪表盘
titleEn: Applied Materials Deep Research Report - Broad Semicap Dashboard For AI Capacity Buildout
summary: 【2026-08-14 监测与估值重锚：AMAT 于 2026-08-13 收于 $534.54；按 Q3 公告的 794M 基本加权平均股数，市值约 $424.4B，窄口径 EV 约 $421.7B；约 10.3x EV/Q4 年化收入、33.2x Q4 指引 EPS 年化。立场维持观望中性 / 中确信。】AI 基础设施 semicap-equipment 层的广谱设备仪表盘：FY2026 Q3（截至 2026-07-26）收入创纪录 $9,115M（同比 +25%），GAAP gross margin 50.3%、non-GAAP EPS $3.50，均高于 $8,950M / $3.36 的指引中点；Semiconductor Systems 收入 $7,040M，其中 foundry/logic/other 67%、DRAM 26%、Flash 7%。Q4 指引收入 $10,250M +/- $500M、non-GAAP EPS $4.02 +/- $0.20。中国是唯一同比收入下降地区（$2,506M，占比 28%，去年同期 35%），公告未作归因；订单/backlog 也未披露。尽管股价较 2026-07-30 上升 6.5%，下一季度口径销售倍数降至 10.3x；中国归因与订单转化仍未闭合，因此不升至 constructive。
summaryEn: [2026-08-14 monitoring and valuation re-anchor: AMAT closed at $534.54 on 2026-08-13. Using the Q3 release's 794M basic weighted-average shares, market cap was about $424.4B and narrow-definition EV about $421.7B, or about 10.3x EV/Q4-annualized sales and 33.2x Q4-guided EPS annualized. Stance remains neutral-watch / medium conviction.] Broad equipment dashboard for the AI-infrastructure semicap-equipment layer. Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-07-26) revenue was a record $9,115M, up 25% year over year, with GAAP gross margin 50.3% and non-GAAP EPS $3.50, both above the $8,950M and $3.36 guidance midpoints; Semiconductor Systems revenue was $7,040M, with foundry/logic/other at 67%, DRAM at 26% and flash at 7%. Q4 guidance is $10,250M +/- $500M revenue and non-GAAP EPS of $4.02 +/- $0.20. China was the only region whose revenue fell year over year ($2,506M, 28% of total, against 35% a year earlier), and the release offers no attribution; orders and backlog are also undisclosed. Although the price rose 6.5% from 2026-07-30, the next-quarter sales multiple fell to 10.3x. China attribution and order conversion remain unresolved, so the stance does not move to constructive.
highlights: 2026-08-14 重锚：$534.54（2026-08-13 收盘），市值约 $424.4B、窄口径 EV 约 $421.7B；约 10.3x EV/Q4 年化收入、33.2x Q4 指引 EPS 年化，维持观望中性 / 中确信
补齐广谱设备仪表盘：AMAT 验证 AI capex 是否进入 deposition、etch、advanced packaging、DRAM 和服务
FY2026 Q3 收入创纪录 $9,115M（同比 +25%）、Semiconductor Systems $7,040M，foundry/logic/other 67%、DRAM 26%、Flash 7%
Q3 收入与 non-GAAP EPS 均超指引中点（$8,950M / $3.36）；Q4 指引 revenue $10,250M +/- $500M、non-GAAP EPS $4.02 +/- $0.20
中国收入 $2,506M（占比由 35% 降至 28%）为唯一同比下降地区，公告未作归因；订单/backlog 未披露，供应链转化判为 unclear

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-08-14 按当前价格与 Q3 实绩复核。2026-08-13 收盘 $534.54，对应市值约 $424.4B、窄口径 EV 约 $421.7B、约 10.3x EV/Q4 年化收入与 33.2x Q4 指引 EPS 年化。尽管股价较 2026-07-30 上升 6.5%，下一季度口径销售倍数由 11.1x 降至 10.3x；Q3 收入、margin 与 mix 兑现支持基本面，但中国收入下降缺乏归因，订单/backlog 未披露，故维持观望中性 / 中确信而不升至 constructive。
stanceRationale.en: Re-checked 2026-08-14 at the current price and against the Q3 print. The 2026-08-13 close of $534.54 implies about $424.4B market cap, $421.7B narrow-definition EV, 10.3x EV/Q4-annualized sales and 33.2x Q4-guided EPS annualized. Although the price rose 6.5% from 2026-07-30, the next-quarter sales multiple fell from 11.1x to 10.3x. Q3 revenue, margin and mix support the fundamental case, but the China decline lacks attribution and orders/backlog are undisclosed, so neutral-watch / medium conviction holds rather than moving to constructive.

upgrade.zh: 如果 FY2026 Q4 收入达到或高于 $10.25B 中点、Semiconductor Systems operating margin 维持 35% 以上、foundry/logic 与 DRAM mix 同时强劲、中国/台湾归因排除出口管制或客户节奏冲击，且 EV/sales 未从 2026-08-13 框架进一步扩张，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if FY2026 Q4 revenue reaches or exceeds the $10.25B midpoint, Semiconductor Systems operating margin stays above 35%, foundry/logic and DRAM mix remain strong together, China/Taiwan attribution rules out an export-control or customer-timing hit, and EV/sales does not expand from the 2026-08-13 frame.

downgrade.zh: 如果 Q4 收入低于中点、Semiconductor Systems 增长或 operating margin 走弱、中国/台湾收入被证明受到出口管制或客户节奏冲击，或库存与供应链扩建转化为去库存压力，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if Q4 revenue misses the midpoint, Semiconductor Systems growth or operating margin weakens, China/Taiwan revenue is shown to be hit by export controls or customer timing, or the inventory and supply-chain build turns into destocking pressure.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：立场须在当前价格下成立。$501.77 下 11.1x EV/年化收入，负预期差算术消失，谨慎调整为观望中性。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling: stance must hold at the current price. At $501.77 (~11.1x EV/annualized sales) the negative-gap arithmetic is gone; cautious moves to neutral-watch.

trigger.en: systems revenue and operating margin continue confirming a broad WFE upcycle

latest.zh: FY2026 Q3（截至 2026-07-26）Semiconductor Systems 收入 $7,040M，去年同期 $5,564M；GAAP operating margin 37.7%、non-GAAP 38.0%，去年同期分别为 33.0% 与 33.2%。分部毛利率 55.3%（去年同期 53.4%）。上一期 metadata 记录的 Q2 收入 $5.965B 与 35.1% operating margin 未标明 GAAP/non-GAAP 口径，故此处不对该口径作环比推导。
latest.en: Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-07-26) Semiconductor Systems revenue was $7,040M against $5,564M a year earlier, with GAAP operating margin 37.7% and non-GAAP operating margin 38.0% against 33.0% and 33.2% respectively in Q3 FY2025. Segment gross margin was 55.3% versus 53.4%. The prior metadata figure of $5.965B and 35.1% operating margin for Q2 does not state a GAAP/non-GAAP basis, so no sequential margin delta is derived from it here.

trigger.zh: foundry/logic 与 DRAM 同时保持强势，验证先进逻辑和 HBM 需求
trigger.en: foundry/logic and DRAM both stay strong, validating advanced logic and HBM demand

latest.zh: FY2026 Q3 Semiconductor Systems 结构：foundry/logic/other 67%、DRAM 26%、Flash memory 7%（去年同期 69% / 22% / 9%）。DRAM 占比低于上一期 metadata 记录的 Q2 的 29%，但分部基数由 $5,965M 增至 $7,040M；即便按披露百分比的四舍五入区间上下限计算，DRAM 收入的环比方向仍为上升。管理层在同一份公告中表示，下半年收入增长将继续，尤以 DRAM、先进逻辑代工与先进封装为主。公告未披露 HBM 专项收入。
latest.en: Q3 FY2026 Semiconductor Systems mix was foundry/logic/other 67%, DRAM 26% and flash memory 7% (Q3 FY2025: 69%, 22% and 9%). The DRAM share is below the 29% recorded for Q2 in prior report metadata, but the segment base grew from $5,965M to $7,040M, so DRAM revenue rose sequentially across the full rounding band of the disclosed percentages. Management said in the same release that second-half revenue growth would continue, led by DRAM, leading-edge foundry-logic and advanced packaging. No HBM-specific revenue is disclosed.

monitoring.nextCheck: FY2026 Q4 and full-year results

trigger.zh: 出口管制或客户节奏影响中国/台湾收入
trigger.en: export controls or customer timing affect China/Taiwan revenue

latest.zh: FY2026 Q3 地区收入：中国 $2,506M（占比 28%），去年同期 $2,548M（35%）；台湾 $2,025M（22%），去年同期 $1,843M（25%）。在总收入同比增长 25% 的季度里，中国是唯一同比收入下降的地区，台湾收入同比增长约 9.9%。公告披露了地区收入，但未就中国收入的走平作出任何归因，既未提及出口管制，也未提及客户节奏；本触发条件的因果条款因此无法据此来源判定。
latest.en: Q3 FY2026 revenue by geography: China $2,506M (28% of total) against $2,548M (35%) in Q3 FY2025, and Taiwan $2,025M (22%) against $1,843M (25%). In a quarter when total revenue grew 25%, China was the only region whose revenue declined year over year, while Taiwan revenue grew about 9.9%. The release discloses the geographic revenue but offers no attribution for the flat China line and names neither export controls nor customer timing, so the causal condition in this trigger cannot be graded from this source.

latest.en: Q3 FY2026 revenue came in at $9,115M against the $8,950M guidance midpoint, and non-GAAP EPS was $3.50 against the $3.36 guided midpoint. GAAP gross margin was 50.3% and non-GAAP 50.4% (Q3 FY2025: 48.8% and 48.9%); GAAP operating margin was 33.7% and non-GAAP 34.0% (30.6% and 30.7%). Cash from operations was $3.04B and non-GAAP free cash flow $2,330M. Q4 FY2026 guidance is revenue of $10,250M +/- $500M and non-GAAP EPS of $4.02 +/- $0.20.

title: Synopsys 深度研究报告 - AI 芯片设计的 EDA/IP 与仿真约束
titleEn: Synopsys Deep Research Report - EDA/IP And Simulation Constraint For AI Silicon Design
summary: AI 基础设施 eda-ip 层的公共约束：SNPS 验证 AI silicon 需求是否穿透到 design automation、verification、simulation、IP blocks 和 system-level complexity。FY2026 Q2 revenue $2.276B（去年同期 $1.604B）、GAAP EPS $0.09、non-GAAP EPS $3.35；FY2026 指引 revenue $9.625-9.705B、non-GAAP EPS $14.72-14.80、FCF 约 $2.0B。指引包含约 $2.96B Ansys revenue，并假设没有进一步 export-control / Entity List 变化。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $372.33 计，市值约 $71.3B、EV 约 $79.7B，约 8.2x EV/FY2026E sales、约 25.2x non-GAAP P/E。偏多 / 中确信：倍数在 2026 年 7 月链条重定价中压缩，同一套指引框架反而更便宜，温和正预期差变宽；但整合、出口和客户周期性仍限制确信度。
summaryEn: Common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure eda-ip layer. SNPS tests whether AI silicon demand is flowing into design automation, verification, simulation, IP blocks, and system-level complexity. Q2 FY2026 revenue was $2.276B versus $1.604B a year ago, GAAP EPS was $0.09, and non-GAAP EPS was $3.35; FY2026 guidance is $9.625-9.705B revenue, $14.72-14.80 non-GAAP EPS, and about $2.0B FCF. Guidance includes about $2.96B of Ansys revenue and assumes no further export-control / Entity List changes. At the $372.33 close on 2026-07-30, about $71.3B market cap and $79.7B EV, SNPS trades around 8.2x EV/FY2026E sales and 25.2x non-GAAP P/E. Constructive / medium conviction: the multiple compressed in the July 2026 chain repricing so the same guidance frame is cheaper and the modestly positive expectation gap widens, while integration, export, and customer-cycle risks keep conviction capped.
highlights: 补齐 EDA/IP 公共约束：SNPS 验证 AI design starts 与复杂度是否进入 design automation、verification、simulation 和 IP
FY2026 Q2 revenue $2.276B、non-GAAP EPS $3.35；FY2026 revenue 指引 $9.625-9.705B
FY2026 指引包含约 $2.96B Ansys revenue，且假设没有进一步 export-control / Entity List 变化
2026-07-30 收盘 $372.33、EV 约 $79.7B，约 8.2x FY2026E sales、约 25.2x non-GAAP P/E；v5 偏多 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $372.33、约 8.2x EV/FY2026E sales 和约 25.2x non-GAAP P/E 计，市场仍然要求 AI EDA/IP durability、Ansys 并表和 FCF 修复，但同一套 FY2026 指引框架在 7 月链条重定价后便宜了约 15%，因此我们基准情景中 simulation pull-through、Design IP 和 verification 复杂度高于隐含要求的那部分预期差反而变宽。
stanceRationale.en: At the $372.33 close on 2026-07-30, roughly 8.2x EV/FY2026E sales, and about 25.2x non-GAAP P/E, the market still requires AI EDA/IP durability, Ansys consolidation, and FCF repair, but the same FY2026 guidance frame is about 15% cheaper after the July chain repricing, so the gap by which our base case sees simulation pull-through, Design IP, and verification complexity running ahead of that embedded requirement has widened.

title: Cadence Design Systems 深度研究报告 - AI 设计复杂度的 EDA/IP backlog 仪表盘
titleEn: Cadence Design Systems Deep Research Report - EDA/IP Backlog Dashboard For AI Design Complexity
summary: AI 基础设施 eda-ip 层的 backlog / execution 仪表盘：CDNS 验证 AI demand 是否出现在 design automation、IP、simulation、backlog、RPO 和 agentic design workflows。2026Q2 财报（2026-07-27）：revenue $1.584B（同比 +24%）、non-GAAP operating margin 45.5%、non-GAAP EPS $2.11；季度末 backlog $8.1B（公司口径 record），未来 12 个月预计从 RPO 确认收入 $4.2B；Core EDA / Semiconductor IP / System Design & Analysis 收入分别同比 +18% / 超过 +40% / +37%。管理层把 FY2026 指引上修至 revenue $6.26-6.34B（约 +19% YoY）、non-GAAP EPS $8.05-8.15、operating cash flow 约 $2B。2026-07-31 完成此前推迟的估值复核：以 2026-07-30 收盘 $332.82 计，市值约 $91.8B、EV 约 $93.4B，对照上修后指引约 14.8x EV/sales、约 41.1x non-GAAP P/E。倍数被价格下行与分母上行同时消化，立场由谨慎调整为 neutral-watch / 中确信。
summaryEn: Backlog / execution dashboard for the AI-infrastructure eda-ip layer. CDNS tests whether AI demand is visible in design automation, IP, simulation, backlog, RPO, and agentic design workflows. Q2 2026 results (July 27, 2026): revenue was $1.584B (up 24% YoY), non-GAAP operating margin was 45.5%, and non-GAAP EPS was $2.11; quarter-end backlog was $8.1B (a company-stated record), next-12-month RPO revenue was $4.2B, and Core EDA / Semiconductor IP / System Design & Analysis revenue grew 18% / more than 40% / 37% YoY. Management raised FY2026 guidance to $6.26-6.34B revenue (about +19% YoY), $8.05-8.15 non-GAAP EPS, and about $2B operating cash flow. The 2026-07-31 pass completed the previously deferred valuation review: at the $332.82 close on 2026-07-30, market cap is about $91.8B and EV about $93.4B, or about 14.8x EV/sales and about 41.1x non-GAAP P/E against the raised guide. The multiple has been absorbed by a lower price and a higher denominator together, so the stance moves from cautious to neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: 补齐 EDA/IP backlog 仪表盘：CDNS 验证 AI 复杂度是否进入 backlog、RPO、IP 和 agentic design flow
2026Q2（2026-07-27）revenue $1.584B（同比 +24%）、non-GAAP operating margin 45.5%、non-GAAP EPS $2.11
季度末 backlog $8.1B（公司口径 record，环比约持平于 Q1 $8.0B），next-12-month RPO revenue $4.2B；Core EDA / IP / SDA 收入同比 +18% / 超过 +40% / +37%，FY2026 指引上修
2026-07-30 收盘 $332.82、EV 约 $93.4B，对照上修后指引约 14.8x EV/sales、约 41.1x non-GAAP P/E；立场由谨慎调整为 neutral-watch / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $332.82、市值约 $91.8B、EV 约 $93.4B 计，对照 2026-07-27 上修后的 FY2026 指引约为 14.8x EV/sales、41.1x non-GAAP P/E，而旧的冻结 2026-07-02 框架为约 16.9x / 47.2x。谨慎判断此前几乎完全建立在“价格已前置资本化大部分好消息”这一估值主张上，而该主张已被价格下行与指引/backlog/RPO 上行两个方向同时消化；熊市情景要求的 backlog 转化延迟、IP 增速不足、Hexagon 稀释 margin 在 Q2 均出现相反证据，因此没有独立执行腿支撑谨慎。立场调整为 neutral-watch；不直接到 constructive，因为 Q3 转化确认尚未到位。
stanceRationale.en: At the $332.82 close on 2026-07-30, about $91.8B market cap and about $93.4B EV, CDNS is roughly 14.8x EV/sales and 41.1x non-GAAP P/E against the FY2026 guide raised on 2026-07-27, versus about 16.9x / 47.2x in the old frozen July 2, 2026 frame. The cautious call rested almost entirely on the valuation claim that the price had capitalized most of the good news, and that claim has been absorbed from both directions at once — a lower price alongside higher guidance, backlog and RPO. The bear case's conditions (backlog slippage, IP undershoot, Hexagon margin dilution) all ran the other way in Q2, so no independent execution leg sustains the cautious stance. The stance moves to neutral-watch, and not to constructive, because Q3 conversion confirmation is still outstanding.

upgrade.zh: 若 Q3 2026 继续证明 $8.1B backlog 与 $4.2B next-12-month RPO 干净转收入，Star IP 与 AI Super Agents 采用保持可量化，且 EV/sales 从当前约 14.8x 继续被消化而不是重新扩张，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to constructive if Q3 2026 continues to show the $8.1B backlog and $4.2B next-12-month RPO converting cleanly, Star IP and AI Super Agent adoption remain measurable, and EV/sales keeps being absorbed from the current roughly 14.8x frame rather than expanding.

downgrade.zh: 若 backlog/RPO 转化低于指引、IP 增速放缓、Hexagon/Physical AI 稀释 margin，或在当前约 41x non-GAAP P/E 估值框架下出现执行失误，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to cautious if backlog/RPO conversion misses guidance, IP growth slows, Hexagon / Physical AI dilutes margin, or an execution miss appears against the current roughly 41x non-GAAP P/E valuation frame.

trigger.zh: $8.1B backlog 与 $4.2B next-12-month RPO 按上修后的指引转收入
trigger.en: $8.1B backlog and $4.2B next-12-month RPO convert into the raised guidance

latest.en: Q2 2026 results (2026-07-27): quarter-end backlog was $8.1B (a company-stated record, roughly flat vs Q1's $8.0B) and next-12-month RPO revenue was $4.2B (Q1 was $4.0B); Q2 revenue was $1.584B (+24% YoY) with non-GAAP EPS $2.11, and FY2026 guidance was raised to $6.26-6.34B revenue and $8.05-8.15 non-GAAP EPS. The reading is consistent with conversion, but the company did not disclose backlog gross additions or burn, so it does not directly quantify a conversion rate.

summaryEn: July 30, 2026 monitoring update (Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026): revenue was $2.625B (+16% YoY, including one-time xScale fees), recurring revenue $2.377B (MRR +11%), AFFO $1.168B (+20%), and AFFO/share $11.78 (+19%); Q2 added a record 9,700 net interconnections and annualized gross bookings were $424M (+23%). Management raised FY2026 guidance and its long-term outlook. Interconnection, bookings, and MRR strengthened together, so the facility-interconnection-leasing falsifier was not triggered; the metrics are consistent with network-dense deployment, but the company did not attribute them specifically to AI and they are not causal proof of AI demand. The $1,047.53 (Jul 30, 2026 close) is the re-anchored valuation basis by this monitoring pass. DLR's paired check in the AI-infrastructure data-center facility layer. EQIX uses Platform Equinix interconnection, retail colocation, xScale JVs and AFFO/share to test whether AI demand is more than hyperscale shell leasing. Q1 2026 revenue was $2.444B (+10% reported YoY), operating income was $577M, net income was $415M, adjusted EBITDA was $1.245B, and AFFO/share was $10.79. MRR grew 12% reported / 10% normalized constant-currency YoY, annualized gross bookings were $378M, annualized presales were about $140M, and about 60% of largest deals were AI-related. The 2025 annual report disclosed 280 data centers, 10,500+ customers and 507,000+ interconnections, while Q1 2026 interconnection revenue was $446M. At $1,047.53 (2026-07-02), about $103.3B market cap and about $125.3B EV, EQIX trades around 24.4x the midpoint of 2026 AFFO/share guidance and about 12.2x 2026 revenue guidance. Neutral watch / medium conviction: high quality but high valuation; key monitors are interconnection revenue, AI bookings/presales, xScale economics, MRR/cabinet yield and power availability.

latest.en: Q2 2026 (two Forms 6-K furnished August 12, 2026): Nebius revenue was $582.3M versus $399.0M in Q1 and $105.1M a year earlier, and adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $236.2M from -$21.0M. CoreWeave reported same-quarter revenue of $2,575M, up 112% YoY, with RPO of $103.7B. Both companies showed recognized-revenue growth, but Nebius did not restate ARR, CoreWeave backlog remained about 40 times quarterly revenue, and neither company discloses utilization. Nebius cash of $8,042.1M against non-current debt of $8,499.0M also moved it from near net cash to approximately net-debt-flat. Reading: unclear. The trigger requires both companies to keep converting ARR/backlog at high utilization; the current evidence establishes revenue growth but not the two necessary ARR/backlog-conversion and high-utilization conditions.

latest.zh: 2026 年二季度（2026-08-12 提交的两份 6-K）：持续经营净利润／亏损为 -$190.4M，去年同期为 +$502.5M；而上半年仍为净利润 +$430.8M，对应约 -$303.9M 的经营亏损（收入 $981.3M 减经营成本 $1,285.2M），即半年度利润在来源上仍属非经营性。就本季而言，调整后 EBITDA 由 -$21.0M 转正至 $236.2M，经营成本占收入比由 206% 降至 130%，但在 $259.7M 折旧摊销与 $102.5M 股份支付之后，GAAP 经营利润仍约为 -$175.9M。读数为 unclear：本触发条件问的是利润是否仍由非现金投资重估驱动、而非经营转正，而本季对这两半给出相反答案——二季度没有由重估驱动的利润，因为根本没有利润；经营层面在 EBITDA 口径上大幅改善，但经营利润线尚未转正。此处withheld的理由是该监测项的两半在同一组证据上指向相反方向，而非披露不足。边界：本季经营活动现金流入 $2,246.1M 约为同期收入的 3.9 倍，只可能主要由客户预付款与递延收入构成（上半年非流动递延收入增加约 $3,693.8M），不得读作经营性盈利转正。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (two Forms 6-K furnished 2026-08-12): net loss from continuing operations was -$190.4M in the quarter against net income of +$502.5M a year earlier, while the first half still shows net income of +$430.8M against an operating loss of about -$303.9M (revenue $981.3M less operating costs and expenses of $1,285.2M), so the half-year profit remains non-operating in origin. Within the quarter, adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $236.2M from -$21.0M and operating costs fell to 130% of revenue from 206%, but after $259.7M of depreciation and amortization and $102.5M of share-based compensation the GAAP operating line is still about -$175.9M. Reading: unclear. The trigger asks whether profit stays driven by non-cash investment marks rather than operations turning positive, and the quarter answers its two halves in opposite directions: there was no mark-driven profit in Q2 because there was no profit at all, while operations improved sharply at the EBITDA level without the operating line turning positive. The grade is withheld because the evidence points both ways on the same item, not for lack of disclosure. Limit: quarterly operating cash inflow of $2,246.1M is about 3.9 times the quarter revenue and can only be composed largely of customer prepayments and deferred revenue, with non-current deferred revenue rising about $3,693.8M over the half, and must not be read as operations turning profitable.

latest.zh: 2026-08-24 提交的 Form 6-K 及附件 99.1 新闻稿（新闻稿标注阿姆斯特丹 2026-08-24，accession 0001104659-26-100347）：上述可转换优先票据发行已**完成交割**。初始购买人**全额行使**其增购选择权，额外认购 2030 档 4.50 亿美元与 2034 档 3.00 亿美元，因此 2030 档原始本金总额为 **34.5 亿美元**、2034 档为 **23.0 亿美元**，合计 **57.5 亿美元**（新闻稿标题口径为「总募资毛额约 57.5 亿美元」，正文口径为「原始本金总额」）。同日与 U.S. Bank Trust Company, N.A. 作为受托人签署两份契约（Indenture，均标注 2026-08-24）。本次新闻稿**未披露净募资金额**；定价新闻稿（2026-08-19）当时对选择权全额行使情形的估计为约 56.8 亿美元，属当时的估计值而非本次披露。换股规模（以约 1,580 万股 A 类普通股换取 2029 与 2031 两档存量可转债各 4.00 亿美元原始本金）与定价时公布一致，非本次新增。募集资金用途表述与定价时相同，仍在数据中心建设与扩建、全栈 AI 云投资、版图扩张、含 GPU 在内的关键部件采购之外**并列一般公司用途**。评级：unclear。交割这一腿现已由一手源坐实（此前 `unclear` 的主要理由之一被消除），但本触发条件问的是「『>90% 已锁定』的 2026 资本开支（$200-250 亿）是否在更紧资本市场中失效」，而发行人在本次披露中**仍未重述该已锁定比例**；57.5 亿美元相对 $200-250 亿区间约为 23%-29%，且募集用途并未全额专款专用。因此证据既不证明该资金框架已失效，也不足以重新验证其仍然成立，评级维持 unclear。本次不重算估值、稀释或净现金，保留 2026-07-30 收盘 $188.43 的历史估值边界。
latest.en: Form 6-K furnished 2026-08-24 with Exhibit 99.1 (press release dated Amsterdam, August 24, 2026; accession 0001104659-26-100347): the convertible senior notes offering has **closed**. The initial purchasers exercised their options **in full**, purchasing an additional US$450M of 2030 Notes and US$300M of 2034 Notes, so the aggregate original principal amount is **US$3.45B** for the 2030 Notes and **US$2.3B** for the 2034 Notes, **US$5.75B** in total (the release headlines this as aggregate gross proceeds of approximately US$5.75B and states it in the body as total aggregate original principal amount). Two indentures, each dated August 24, 2026, were entered into with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association as trustee. This release **discloses no net-proceeds figure**; the pricing release of 2026-08-19 estimated about US$5.68B for the full-exercise case, which is that release's estimate rather than a disclosure made here. The exchange size — approximately 15.8M Class A ordinary shares for US$400M of original principal of each of the 2029 and 2031 series — is unchanged from pricing and is not new here. Use-of-proceeds language is also unchanged and still lists **general corporate purposes** alongside data-center construction and build-out, full-stack AI cloud investment, footprint expansion and procurement of key components including GPUs. Reading: unclear. The settlement leg is now established by a primary source, removing one of the prior grounds for `unclear`, but the trigger asks whether the '>90% secured' 2026 capex (US$20-25B) breaks in a tighter capital market, and the issuer **still does not restate that secured percentage** in this disclosure. US$5.75B is roughly 23%-29% of the US$20-25B program and the proceeds are not fully earmarked. The evidence therefore neither proves the funding frame has broken nor re-verifies that it remains intact, so the grade stays unclear. Valuation, dilution and net cash are not recomputed; the historical valuation boundary remains the July 30, 2026 close of US$188.43.

title: Arista Networks 深度研究报告 - AI 集群开放以太网 fabric 的系统软件卖铲人
titleEn: Arista Networks Deep Research Report - The Open Ethernet Fabric of AI Clusters
summary: AI 集群网络层首次覆盖：Arista 是开放以太网/AI spine/scale-out 网络的系统软件卖铲人，正面回答 NVIDIA Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink 一体化 vs Broadcom merchant silicon + Arista EOS/CloudVision/800G Ethernet 生态的路线之争。Q1 2026 营收 $2.709B(+35.1%)、GAAP/非GAAP营业利润率 42.7%/47.8%、非GAAP EPS $0.87、经营现金流 $1.69B；Q2 指引营收约 $2.8B。FY2025 Cloud and AI Titans/AI Specialty Providers 占收入 48%/20%，Core AI/Cloud/Data Center Networking 占 65%。但两大匿名终端客户合计约 42% 收入(26%/16%)、高度依赖 Broadcom merchant silicon，且 Jun 29 2026 市值约 $206.6B、约 58x TTM GAAP P/E、约 49x 当前非GAAP EPS运行率。neutral-watch / 中等确信：高质量，但大多已定价。
highlights: AI 集群网络层补位：ANET 不是光模块/光纤层，而是开放以太网交换系统、EOS、CloudVision、遥测与 AI fabric 控制点；可交叉校验 NVDA/AVGO/AAOI/GLW/VRT/CRWV
Q1 2026 营收 $2.709B(+35.1%)、非GAAP营业利润率 47.8%、非GAAP EPS $0.87、经营现金流 $1.69B；现金+可交易证券约 $12.35B、基本无债，Q2 指引收入约 $2.8B
路线之争：NVIDIA 一体化网络栈(Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink) vs Broadcom merchant silicon + Arista EOS/CloudVision/800G Ethernet；ANET 更像 Broadcom 生态客户/伙伴，而非直接替代
neutral-watch / 中等确信：价格约 $171.02、约 21x EV/TTM 收入，市场已要求多年高 20% 至 30% 中段增长与优秀利润率，等待更好价格或更强开放以太网份额证据
summaryEn: Initial coverage of the AI cluster networking layer: Arista is the open Ethernet / AI spine / scale-out systems-software pick-and-shovel, directly testing NVIDIA Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink integration vs Broadcom merchant silicon + Arista EOS/CloudVision/800G Ethernet. Q1 2026 revenue was $2.709B (+35.1%), GAAP/non-GAAP operating margin 42.7%/47.8%, non-GAAP EPS $0.87, and operating cash flow $1.69B; Q2 guide is about $2.8B revenue. FY2025 Cloud and AI Titans / AI Specialty Providers were 48%/20% of revenue, and Core AI/Cloud/Data Center Networking was 65%. But two anonymous end customers were ~42% of revenue (26%/16%), Arista is highly reliant on Broadcom merchant silicon, and at the Jun 29 2026 market cap of ~$206.6B the stock trades around 58x TTM GAAP earnings and ~49x current non-GAAP EPS run-rate. Neutral-watch / medium conviction: high quality, but mostly priced in.

stanceRationale.zh: 在 $171.02、约 21x EV/TTM 收入上，市场大致要求未来数年收入维持约 30% 至 38% 复合增长并保持优秀利润率；我们的基准情景接近这个区间低端，因此维持中性观察。
stanceRationale.en: At $171.02 and about 21x EV/TTM revenue, the market is underwriting roughly roughly 30% to 38% revenue CAGR for several years with elite margins; our base case is close to the low end of that range, so the stance remains neutral watch.

upgrade.zh: 若 Q2/Q3 财报使收入增速保持在高 20% 以上、非 GAAP 营业利润率维持 45% 以上、递延收入/RPO 扩张，并且客户证据显示开放以太网在 AI 后端网络份额提升且集中度未进一步上升，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if Q2/Q3 results keep revenue growth above the high-20s, non-GAAP operating margin stays above 45%, deferred revenue/RPO expands, and customer evidence shows open Ethernet gaining AI back-end share without higher concentration.

downgrade.zh: 若收入增速跌破隐含的高 20% 路径、非 GAAP 营业利润率在缺少明确投资解释的情况下低于 40%、头部客户集中度恶化，或 NVIDIA 一体化网络在 AI 后端拿到更清楚份额，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if revenue growth falls below the implied high-20s path, non-GAAP operating margin drops below 40% without clear investment explanation, top-customer concentration worsens, or NVIDIA integrated networking takes clearer AI back-end share.

title: CoreWeave 深度研究报告 - AI 建设的风险锚：真实需求还是杠杆与循环融资？
titleEn: CoreWeave Deep Research Report - The AI Buildout's Risk Anchor: Real Demand or Leverage & Circular Financing?
summary: 2026-08-13 监测更新：CoreWeave 2026 年二季度收入 $2,575M（同比 +112%），RPO $103.7B、公司口径 revenue backlog 约 $104B；总有息负债 $35.6B、经营租赁负债 $16.3B、现金 $5,524M。客户集中度明显下降，前三大客户占收入 36%／26%／10%，去年同期为单一客户 71%。收入转化改善，但 backlog 仍约为单季收入 40 倍，且 NVIDIA 需求兜底在本次申报中未被重述，因此 real-demand-vs-financing 严格判为 unclear。此次仅更新监测事实；未重算估值，bearish-avoid／中确信仍沿用 2026-07-30 收盘 $73.90 的完整裁定。
highlights: 2026-07-31 完整裁定：$73.90（2026-07-30 收盘）；维持 bearish-avoid / 中确信，本次监测未重算估值
2026Q2 收入 $2,575M（同比 +112%），RPO $103.7B、公司口径 backlog 约 $104B，且不含 Q3 初逾 $25B 净新增客户承诺
前三大客户占收入 36%／26%／10%，去年同期为单一客户 71%；集中度显著下降但仍高
总有息负债 $35.6B、经营租赁负债 $16.3B、现金 $5,524M；高杠杆与期限错配仍是核心风险
监测：revenue-quality-circularity within；real-demand-vs-financing、solvency-gpu-life-stress、self-build-pricing-crack 均 unclear
summaryEn: August 13, 2026 monitoring update: CoreWeave reported Q2 2026 revenue of $2,575M (+112% YoY), RPO of $103.7B and company-defined revenue backlog of about $104B. Total indebtedness was $35.6B, operating lease liabilities were $16.3B and cash was $5,524M. Concentration fell materially: the top three customers were 36% / 26% / 10% of revenue versus one customer at 71% a year earlier. Revenue conversion improved, but backlog remains about 40 times quarterly revenue and the NVIDIA demand backstop was not restated in this filing, so real-demand-vs-financing is strictly unclear. This is a monitoring-only update; valuation was not recomputed, and bearish-avoid / medium conviction remains the full adjudication anchored to the July 30, 2026 close of $73.90.

metric.zh: 真实需求 vs 融资（Pillar 1）

trigger.zh: 确认收入持续落后收入 backlog，且大比例订单由供应商兜底/单一客户支撑
trigger.en: recognized revenue keeps lagging revenue backlog; a material share of bookings is supplier-backstopped/single-customer

latest.zh: 2026 年二季度（2026-08-11 公布业绩，2026-08-12 提交 10-Q）：收入 $2,575M，对一季度 $2,078M、去年同期 $1,212M（同比 +112%）。2026-06-30 未履约 RPO 为 $103.7B，公司口径 revenue backlog 约 $104B，且不含 Q3 初新增的逾 $25B 净客户承诺；41% RPO 预计在截至 2028-06-30 的头 24 个月确认。收入转化改善，backlog 对单季收入的倍数由约 47 倍收敛至约 40 倍，但已确认收入仍大幅落后于 backlog；前三大客户仍占 36%／26%／10%，Meta 与 OpenAI 的具名承诺分别最高约 $21.0B 与 $6.5B。NVIDIA 合约产能兜底在本次申报中未被重述。读数为 unclear：收入追赶有所改善，但触发条件的 backlog 落后分支仍有实质证据，供应商兜底分支则缺少本期重述，不能据此判为 within。证据边界：revenue backlog 是含估计金额的公司自定义指标，不等同于 RPO；文件不披露利用率或 GPU 租赁 ASP。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (results released August 11, 2026; Form 10-Q filed August 12): revenue was $2,575M versus $2,078M in Q1 and $1,212M a year earlier (+112% YoY). Unsatisfied RPO was $103.7B at June 30, 2026 and company-defined revenue backlog was about $104B, excluding more than $25B of net new customer commitments added in early Q3; 41% of RPO is expected to be recognized in the first 24 months through June 30, 2028. Conversion improved and backlog-to-quarterly-revenue narrowed from about 47x to about 40x, but recognized revenue still materially lags backlog; the top three customers remained 36% / 26% / 10%, and named Meta and OpenAI commitments were up to about $21.0B and $6.5B. The NVIDIA contracted capacity backstop was not restated in this filing. Reading: unclear. Revenue catch-up improved, but the backlog-lag clause still has material evidence while the supplier-backstop clause lacks a current restatement, so the item cannot be graded within. Evidence limits: revenue backlog is a company-defined measure that includes estimates and is not the same caliber as RPO; neither utilization nor GPU rental ASP is disclosed.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-Q3 backlog 转化与 RPO 披露 / Q3 backlog conversion and RPO disclosures

trigger.zh: 前二客户维持约 2/3 以上收入，NVIDIA 仍是合约化需求兜底
trigger.en: top-2 customers stay >~2/3 of revenue; NVIDIA remains a contracted demand backstop

latest.zh: 2026-08-12 提交的 10-Q：截至 2026-06-30 的三个月，前三大客户分别占收入 36%、26%、10%，无其他客户达到 10%；而截至 2025-06-30 的三个月为单一客户占 71%。前两大客户合计 62%，低于本触发条件约三分之二的门槛。10-Q 将 NVIDIA 描述为其基础设施所用全部 GPU 的供应商、2026 年 1 月以每股 $87.20 认购约 2,300 万股 A 类普通股（总额 $2.0B）的投资人，以及 2026 年 1 月合作框架的对手方，但本次申报未重述任何合约性需求兜底。已披露的具名客户承诺为 OpenAI 最高约 $6.5B（至 2031-05-31）与 Meta 初始最高约 $21.0B。按合取解读本监测项自身的触发条件：量化分支已明确低于门槛，兜底分支在本次申报中亦无证据，两者均不成立，读数为 within。证据边界：集中度以未具名的 Customer A／B／C 百分比披露，36% 与 26% 客户的身份未由申报文件确立。
latest.en: Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-12: for the three months ended 2026-06-30 the top three customers were 36%, 26% and 10% of revenue with no other customer at 10% or more, against a single top customer at 71% for the three months ended 2025-06-30. The top two therefore sum to 62%, below this trigger's roughly two-thirds threshold. The 10-Q describes NVIDIA as the supplier of all GPUs used in the infrastructure today, as a January 2026 purchaser of approximately 23 million Class A shares at $87.20 per share for $2.0B, and as a January 2026 collaboration-framework counterparty, but does not restate any contracted demand backstop in this filing. Named customer commitments disclosed are OpenAI up to approximately $6.5B through 2031-05-31 and Meta initially up to approximately $21.0B. Read conjunctively against this item's own trigger, the quantitative clause is decisively below its threshold and the backstop clause is unevidenced in this filing, so neither holds and the reading is within. Evidence limit: concentration is disclosed as unnamed Customer A/B/C percentages, so the filing does not establish which customers the 36% and 26% shares belong to.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-Q3 客户集中度 % 与关联方披露 / Q3 concentration and related-party disclosures

metric.zh: GPU 寿命压力下的偿付能力（Pillar 3）

trigger.zh: 按『GPU 寿命=3 年』压力测算，24 个月债务+租赁/采购义务超过合约+流动性覆盖
trigger.en: 24-month debt service + lease/purchase commitments exceed contracted + liquid coverage under a 'GPU life = 3 years' stress

latest.zh: 2026-08-12 提交的 10-Q：2026-06-30 总有息负债 $35.6B（前一读数约 $24.9B），另有 $10.0B 未提取额度；债务本金到期表为 2026 年剩余 $4,413M、2027 年 $6,184M、2028 年 $4,416M、2029 年 $2,421M、2030 年 $3,221M、其后 $14,896M，合计 $35,551M。经营租赁负债 $16.3B，融资租赁负债合计 $221M；现金及等价物 $5,524M，另有受限现金流动 $873M、非流动 $507M。二季度利息净支出 $640M（合约利息 $592M，资本化利息 $79M），去年同期 $267M。截至 2028-06-30 的 24 个月内已签约收入仅以 RPO 的 41%（约 $42.5B）形式披露。读数为 unclear：本监测项的触发条件要求在“GPU 使用寿命 3 年”的压力情景下，把 24 个月的还本付息加租赁与采购承诺，与已签约加可动用流动性的覆盖度作比较；而申报文件按自然年度而非 24 个月窗口披露本金，未提供任何 GPU 使用寿命敏感性或残值假设，且 RPO 是收入口径而非现金毛利口径，因此该压力测试无法由已披露输入计算得出。此处withheld的理由是压力测试本身的证据不足，而非各分项数据缺失。
latest.en: Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-12: total indebtedness was $35.6B at 2026-06-30 against about $24.9B in the prior reading, with $10.0B of undrawn availability. Scheduled principal payments are $4,413M for the remainder of 2026, $6,184M in 2027, $4,416M in 2028, $2,421M in 2029, $3,221M in 2030 and $14,896M thereafter, totalling $35,551M. Operating lease liabilities are $16.3B and finance lease liabilities total $221M; cash and equivalents are $5,524M with restricted cash of $873M current and $507M non-current. Q2 interest expense net was $640M, comprising $592M of contractual interest less $79M of capitalized interest, against $267M a year earlier. Contracted revenue over the 24 months to 2028-06-30 is disclosed only as 41% of $103.7B of RPO, about $42.5B. Reading: unclear. This item's trigger requires 24-month debt service plus lease and purchase commitments to be set against contracted plus liquid coverage under a GPU-life-equals-three-years stress, and the filing discloses principal by calendar year rather than over a 24-month window, provides no GPU useful-life sensitivity or residual-value assumption, and states RPO as revenue rather than cash margin, so that stress cannot be computed from the disclosed inputs. The grade is withheld for evidence insufficiency on the stress itself, not because the individual components are unavailable.

monitoring.nextCheck: 到期结构、利息覆盖与折旧政策的进一步披露 / further maturity, coverage and depreciation-policy disclosure

trigger.zh: 头部客户公开削减承诺，或 GPU 租金 ASP 随利用率下滑
trigger.en: a top customer publicly cuts commitments, or GPU rental ASPs fall alongside utilization

latest.zh: 2026-08-11 业绩与 2026-08-12 提交的 10-Q：期内没有任何主要客户削减承诺。10-Q 载明 OpenAI 承诺最高约 $6.5B（至 2031-05-31）、Meta 初始承诺最高约 $21.0B；新闻稿称 Q3 初新增逾 $250 亿净新增客户承诺，并点名 Bentley Systems、Caterpillar、Grammarly、Isomorphic Labs、Sunday Robotics 等新客户，以及 Cognition、Databricks、Hudson River Trading、Periodic Labs、Rescale、Runway ML 等既有客户扩容。季内 active power 增加近 500MW 至 1.5GW，contracted power 增至约 3.7GW。读数为 unclear：本触发条件为析取（主要客户公开削减承诺，或 GPU 租金 ASP 随利用率一同下滑），第一分支已明确为否（承诺是扩张而非削减），但新闻稿与 10-Q 均未披露 GPU 租金 ASP 或利用率，第二分支无法检验，因此整个析取式未定。
latest.en: Q2 2026 results 2026-08-11 and Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-12: no top customer reduced its commitments in the period. The 10-Q states OpenAI committed up to approximately $6.5B through 2031-05-31 and Meta initially committed up to approximately $21.0B, and the release states more than $25B of net new customer commitments were added in early Q3, naming new customers including Bentley Systems, Caterpillar, Grammarly, Isomorphic Labs and Sunday Robotics and expanded relationships including Cognition, Databricks, Hudson River Trading, Periodic Labs, Rescale and Runway ML. Active power grew by nearly 500MW during the quarter to 1.5GW and total contracted power to approximately 3.7GW. Reading: unclear. This trigger is disjunctive — a top customer publicly cuts commitments, or GPU rental ASPs fall alongside utilization — and its first clause is decisively negative because commitments expanded rather than being cut, but neither the release nor the 10-Q discloses GPU rental ASPs or utilization, so the second clause cannot be tested and the disjunction as a whole is undetermined.

monitoring.nextCheck: 微软/OpenAI 产能表态、租金 ASP 与利用率 / capacity commentary, ASP and utilization

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定以当前价格复核。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $73.90，市值约 $33.1B，但在约 $32.9B 净债务上 EV 约 $66.0B（较锚点仅约 -8%）：空头论点锚定在 EV 与结构上——backlog 转化、GPU 残值、再融资窗口须同时成立——而非"股票太贵"，因此在当前价格下依然成立，维持 bearish-avoid。
stanceRationale.en: Re-checked 2026-07-31 at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-07-30 close of $73.90, market cap is about $33.1B but EV is about $66.0B on ~$32.9B net debt (only ~-8% from the anchor): the bear case is EV- and structure-anchored — backlog conversion, GPU residual value and the refinancing window must hold together — not a claim that the stock is expensive, so it survives at the current price and bearish-avoid holds.

benchmarkRationale.en: VRT is a data-center power/cooling equipment maker, not a REIT, so the datacenter-facility layer default (SRVR, a data-center REIT basket) is the wrong yardstick. summary: 【2026-08-18 立场重新裁定：VRT 于 2026-08-17 收于 $292.43，较 07-31 裁定锚点两周反弹 +28.5%（指引未变，纯倍数再扩张），市值约 $112.6B、按上调后指引约 43.6x 前瞻调整后 EPS，反向倍数框架隐含约 20% EPS 复合增速——回到基准情景区间上沿、安全边际归零；按所有者 Q1 裁定，立场由观望中性下调为谨慎（中确信）。】2026-07-30 监测更新（Q2 2026，季度截至 2026-06-30）：净销售额 $32.74亿（+24%、有机 +18%），调整后营业利润率 22.6%（+410bps），摊薄 EPS $1.27（+53%）、调整后摊薄 EPS $1.52（+60%），经营现金流 $11.0亿、调整后 FCF $9.25亿（+234%）。管理层全面上调 FY2026 指引：净销售额 $138-142亿（有机 +31%）、调整后 EPS $6.65-6.75、调整后 FCF $24-26亿。该财报未量化本季订单/backlog。估值与立场已于 2026-08-18 按当前收盘重新裁定。数据中心电力与热管理（含液冷）卖铲人，位于『电从哪来』(GEV/Bloom)与『芯片』(NVDA/AVGO)之间，是 AI 建设速度最实时的『仪表盘』。Q1 2026 营收$26.5亿(+30%，有机+23%、美洲有机+44%)、调整后营业利润率20.8%(+430bps)、调整后EPS $1.17(+83%)、调整后FCF $6.53亿(+147%)；最新披露的 Q4 2025 backlog $150亿(+109%)、book-to-bill ~2.9x。按 2026-08-17 收盘 $292.43：市值约 $112.6B、EV 约 $112.7B、P/S(TTM) 约 9.8x、约 43.6x 前瞻调整后 EPS（$6.65-6.75 口径；滚动 GAAP 约 65x），反向倍数框架（三年向约 32x 正常化、8% 要求回报）隐含约 20% EPS 复合增速——恰在基准情景高十位数至低二十位数区间上沿，且约 43.6x 已高于牛市情景自设的 35-40x 可维持区间。谨慎 / 中确信：价格再度把基准情景的乐观一端当作前提，负预期差重新出现；高 beta 订单簿与未量化的订单/backlog 披露是主要风险。

summaryEn: [2026-08-18 stance re-adjudication: VRT closed at $292.43 on 2026-08-17, +28.5% in two weeks from the 07-31 adjudication anchor (guidance unchanged — pure multiple re-expansion), for about $112.6B market cap and ~43.6x the raised forward adjusted-EPS guide; the reverse-multiple frame implies roughly 20% EPS CAGR — back at the top of the base-case band, with the safety margin gone; under the owner's Q1 ruling the stance moves from neutral-watch down to cautious (medium conviction).] July 30, 2026 monitoring update (Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026): net sales were $3.274B (+24%, +18% organic), adjusted operating margin 22.6% (+410bps), diluted EPS $1.27 (+53%) and adjusted diluted EPS $1.52 (+60%), operating cash flow $1.10B, and adjusted FCF $925M (+234%). Management raised FY2026 guidance across all metrics: net sales $13.8-14.2B (+31% organic), adjusted EPS $6.65-6.75, and adjusted FCF $2.4-2.6B. The release did not quantify this quarter's orders/backlog. The valuation and stance were re-adjudicated 2026-08-18 at the current close. Power & thermal (incl. liquid cooling) pick-and-shovel for data centers, sitting between 'where power comes from' (GEV/Bloom) and 'the chips' (NVDA/AVGO) — the most real-time 'dashboard' of AI buildout velocity. Q1 2026 revenue $2.65B (+30%, +23% organic, Americas +44%), adj operating margin 20.8% (+430bps), adj EPS $1.17 (+83%), adj FCF $653M (+147%); latest disclosed Q4 2025 backlog was $15.0B (+109%) with book-to-bill ~2.9x. At the 2026-08-17 close of $292.43: about $112.6B market cap, EV about $112.7B, P/S (TTM) about 9.8x, ~43.6x the raised forward adjusted-EPS guide ($6.65-6.75 basis; trailing GAAP ~65x); the reverse-multiple frame (normalize toward ~32x over three years at an 8% required return) implies roughly 20% EPS CAGR — at the very top of the base case's high-teens-to-low-20s band, and ~43.6x is above even the bull scenario's own 35-40x holding range. Cautious / medium conviction: the price once again requires the optimistic side of the base case, so the negative expectation gap has re-opened; the high-beta order book and the unquantified orders/backlog disclosure are the main risks.

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-08-18 按所有者 Q1 裁定重新裁定。按 2026-08-17 收盘 $292.43（较 07-31 裁定锚点两周 +28.5%，指引未变、纯倍数再扩张；市值约 $112.6B），按上调后 FY2026 指引（$6.65-6.75）前瞻约 43.6x；反向倍数框架（三年向约 32x 正常化、8% 要求回报）隐含约 20% EPS 复合增速——恰在基准情景高十位数至低二十位数区间上沿：基准情景中值兑现也只挣到约 8% 的要求回报、没有安全边际，且约 43.6x 已高于牛市情景自设的 35-40x 可维持区间；按 20/50/30 权重加权后预期差重新转负（与 6 月末谨慎裁定同构、程度较轻），orders/backlog 证伪条件自 Q4 2025 以来仍未被检验——立场由观望中性下调为谨慎。
stanceRationale.en: Re-adjudicated 2026-08-18 under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-08-17 close of $292.43 (+28.5% in two weeks from the 07-31 adjudication anchor with guidance unchanged — pure multiple re-expansion; about $112.6B cap) and about 43.6x the raised FY2026 guide ($6.65-6.75), the reverse-multiple frame (normalize toward ~32x over three years at an 8% required return) implies roughly 20% EPS CAGR — at the very top of the base case's high-teens-to-low-20s band: even a base-midpoint delivery earns only about the 8% required return with no margin of safety, and ~43.6x is above the bull scenario's own 35-40x holding range; on the 20/50/30 weights the expectation gap re-opens negative (the same shape as the late-June cautious call, at a less extreme level) while the orders/backlog falsifier remains untested since Q4 2025 — the stance moves from neutral-watch down to cautious.

title: NVIDIA 深度研究报告 - AI 计算中枢的高质量与高预期
titleEn: NVIDIA Deep Research Report - The AI Compute Hub, High Quality Meets High Expectations
summary: v5 回填：NVIDIA 仍是 AI compute profit pool 的中枢，Q1 FY2027 营收 $81.6B、Data Center $75.2B，且 China data-center revenue 归零后仍兑现强增长。以 $195.04、约 $4.74T 市值和 mid-20s forward P/E 计，市场定价的不是泛泛 AI CAGR，而是 GPU+networking+systems+software 继续保护盈利分母。30% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 20% 熊市情景给出温和正偏斜，因此改为偏多 / 中确信；风险仍是 hyperscaler capex、自定义 ASIC、中国和循环融资减值。
summaryEn: July 7, 2026 v5 update: NVIDIA remains the center of the AI compute profit pool. Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6B and Data Center was $75.2B even with China data-center revenue at zero. At $195.04, about $4.74T market cap, and a mid-20s forward P/E, the market is underwriting GPU+networking+systems+software protection of the earnings denominator, not a generic AI CAGR. A 30% bull / 50% base / 20% bear grid gives modest positive skew, so stance moves to constructive / medium conviction; the risks remain hyperscaler capex, custom ASICs, China, and circular-financing impairments.
highlights: Q1 FY2027 营收 $81.6B（+85% YoY），数据中心 $75.2B（+92%），且在中国数据中心收入归零前提下完成；Q2 FY2027 指引营收 $91.0B
毛利率回到 75%；新增 $80B 回购 + 季度股息 $0.01→$0.25，FCF 信号强；GAAP EPS $2.39 含 $15.9B 股权未实现收益，须以非 GAAP $1.87 为准
护城河三重叠加：CUDA 生态 + 全栈系统（GPU+NVLink+网络）+ 年度节奏；结构性威胁来自自定义 ASIC（Broadcom）多于 AMD
股价约 $195.74、市值约 $4.76 万亿（全球第一），但远期 P/E 约 25x 低于 AMD 约 58x；风险在盈利预期分母而非倍数。中性/观察

latest.zh: CRWV：$20 亿@$87 + $63 亿产能兜底；NBIS：$20 亿战略投资。2026-08-17 Form 8-K 新增更大且不同类型的敞口：NVIDIA 就俄亥俄 PORTS-Pike 园区约 4.25 GW IT 负荷租约与出租方 SB Energy 签署多项剩余价值担保，承租方为 OpenAI Group PBC 关联方，初始承诺项下付款义务累计上限 1,050 亿美元；附件 99.1 另披露 NVIDIA 将向 SB Energy 投资 15 亿美元，并可自行决定另行支持约 3.8 GW（新闻稿口径 3.75 IT-GW）追加产能。评级为 unclear：8-K 仅称各项协议通常在相应租约起租时生效，付款还取决于 ready-for-service 等条件（预计自 2028 年起），且未披露既有 CRWV/NBIS 安排减值或 PORTS-Pike 触发事件；但 1,050 亿美元是重大或有敞口，完整协议尚未公开，OpenAI 又是财务与偿付能力不可公开核验的私营交易对手。该上限不是已发生支出、采购订单、收入或 NVIDIA 资本开支承诺。
latest.en: CRWV: $2B at $87 + $6.3B capacity backstop; NBIS: $2B strategic investment. A larger and structurally different exposure was disclosed in NVIDIA's 2026-08-17 Form 8-K: multiple residual value guaranties with lessor SB Energy cover leases for approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at PORTS-Pike, with an OpenAI Group PBC affiliate as tenant and NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation cumulatively capped at US$105B for its initial commitment. Exhibit 99.1 also says NVIDIA will invest US$1.5B in SB Energy and may in its sole discretion support approximately 3.8 GW more (3.75 IT-GW in the release). Graded unclear: the 8-K says an Agreement generally becomes effective on the applicable lease commencement and payment remains subject to conditions including ready-for-service, expected from 2028; it discloses neither impairment of the existing CRWV/NBIS arrangements nor a PORTS-Pike Trigger Event. But US$105B is a material contingent exposure, the full agreements are not public, and OpenAI is a private counterparty whose financial condition and repayment capacity cannot be publicly verified. The cap is not spending incurred, a purchase order, revenue, or an NVIDIA capex commitment.

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $195.04、约 $4.74T 市值和 mid-20s forward P/E 计，市场定价的是 accelerator profit pool 持续扩张，而不只是泛泛的 AI CAGR；我们的基准情景认为 rack/system attach、networking/software moat 与年度平台节奏仍能保护盈利分母，同时 custom ASIC 和 China 风险尚未足以抵消该优势。
stanceRationale.en: At $195.04, roughly $4.74T market cap, and a mid-20s forward P/E, the market is pricing continued accelerator profit-pool expansion rather than a generic AI CAGR; our base case sees rack/system attach, networking/software moat, and the annual platform cadence still protecting the earnings denominator, while custom ASIC and China risks are not yet large enough to offset that advantage.

upgrade.zh: 升级触发条件：若 Q2 FY2027 兑现 $91.0B revenue guide、Data Center sequential slope 与 75% non-GAAP gross margin 同时保持，rack/system attach 与 networking/software attach 扩大 profit pool，且 ASIC/China/circular-financing 风险没有抬头，则上调至 bullish。
upgrade.en: Move to bullish if Q2 FY2027 delivers the $91.0B revenue guide, Data Center sequential slope and 75% non-GAAP gross margin both hold, rack/system attach and networking/software attach expand the profit pool, and ASIC/China/circular-financing risks do not rise.

downgrade.zh: 降级触发条件：若 hyperscaler capex 连续转弱、Data Center revenue 环比失速、custom ASIC 在推理/成熟负载持续夺取增量 profit pool，或中国/投资组合减值重置盈利分母，则下调至 neutral-watch 或 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or cautious if hyperscaler capex weakens for consecutive quarters, Data Center revenue stalls sequentially, custom ASICs keep taking incremental profit pool in inference/mature workloads, or China / portfolio impairments reset the earnings denominator.

title: AAOI 深度研究报告 - AI数据中心光模块高弹性与估值重定价
titleEn: AAOI Deep Research Report - AI Data Center Optics High Beta and Valuation Re-Rating
summary: 2026-08-22 监测与估值更新：AAOI 于 2026-08-21 新设最高 $600M ATM，但协议并不要求公司出售股份，未用额度不等同于已执行稀释；另据 424B5，5 月 ATM 在 2026-06-30 后已售出 332,428 股、总收款约 $49.2M。按 2026-08-21 收盘 $124.82 与 424B5 披露的 2026-08-20 流通股 84,906,289 股，市值约 $106.0 亿；沿用 Q2 10-Q 的 $277.7M 净现金口径，企业价值约 $103.2 亿，EV/TTM Sales 约 17.3x、EV/年化 Q3 指引中点约 9.5x。立场维持谨慎/中确信：新 ATM 强化稀释与融资纪律的监测证据，但经营现金流触发腿仍因 H1 为负、推导 Q2 单季为正而不明，且 Q3 交付尚未落地。2026-08-23 将 cash-burn-dilution 触发条件重写为单季可裁定口径（单季经营现金流为负叠加收入/股环比下降），读数与立场不变，首个裁定点为 Q3 10-Q。
summaryEn: August 22, 2026 monitoring and valuation update: AAOI established a new ATM for up to $600M on August 21, but the agreement does not require share sales and unused capacity is not executed dilution. The 424B5 separately says the May ATM sold 332,428 shares after June 30 for about $49.2M of gross proceeds. At the August 21 close of $124.82 and the 84,906,289 shares outstanding disclosed as of August 20 in the 424B5, market cap is about $10.60B; using the Q2 10-Q's $277.7M net-cash frame gives enterprise value of about $10.32B, EV/TTM Sales of about 17.3x and EV/annualized-Q3-guide-midpoint of about 9.5x. Stance stays cautious / medium conviction: the new ATM strengthens the dilution-and-financing-discipline evidence, but the operating-cash-flow trigger leg remains unclear because H1 was negative while derived Q2 was positive, and Q3 delivery has not landed. On August 23 the cash-burn-dilution trigger was rewritten into an adjudicable single-quarter frame (single-quarter operating cash flow negative combined with revenue per share declining Q/Q); the reading and stance are unchanged and the first adjudication point is the Q3 10-Q.
highlights: 含 Q2 的 TTM 收入约 $596.0M，EV/TTM Sales 约 17.3x；EV/年化 Q3 指引中点约 9.5x（分母为自推年化指引，非已报实绩）
Q2 收入 $191.9M 落在指引内、Q3 指引 $255-290M；但 GAAP 毛利率 27.7% 同比环比双降，非 GAAP 毛利率 29.8%
8 月 21 日新设最高 $600M ATM；未用额度不是已执行稀释，但 5 月 ATM 在 6 月 30 日后已售出 332,428 股、总收款约 $49.2M
立场维持谨慎/中确信：融资与稀释监测证据增强，现金流触发腿仍不明；升降级触发器继续使用 Q3 交付口径

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-08-22 重锚（按 2026-08-21 收盘 $124.82）：Q2 后的执行支柱仍未销——毛利率同比环比双降、H1 经营现金流为负（推导 Q2 单季仅约 +$11.6M）、Digicomm 集中度高；8 月 21 日新设最高 $600M ATM，且 5 月 ATM 在 6 月 30 日后已实际售出 332,428 股、总收款约 $49.2M，进一步强化融资与稀释纪律监测。按 84,906,289 股和 Q2 净现金口径，EV/TTM 约 17.3x、EV/年化 Q3 指引中点约 9.5x。价格较 8 月 17 日回落 19.4% 扩大估值容错，但没有解决执行证据，也未触发 Q3 交付口径的升降级条件，故维持谨慎/中确信。
stanceRationale.en: 2026-08-22 re-anchor at the 2026-08-21 close of $124.82: the post-Q2 execution legs remain open - gross margin fell both Y/Y and Q/Q, H1 operating cash flow was negative (derived Q2 was only about +$11.6M), and Digicomm concentration remains high. The August 21 ATM for up to $600M, plus 332,428 shares actually sold after June 30 under the May ATM for about $49.2M of gross proceeds, strengthens the financing-and-dilution-discipline evidence. On 84,906,289 shares and the Q2 net-cash frame, EV/TTM is about 17.3x and EV/annualized-Q3-guide-midpoint about 9.5x. The 19.4% decline from August 17 widens valuation tolerance but resolves none of the execution evidence and does not fire either Q3 delivery trigger, so cautious / medium conviction is retained.

upgrade.zh: （2026-08-18 切换为 Q3 交付口径；Q2 口径已裁定——收入 $191.9M 未达 $198M 上沿、Q3 指引显示阶跃，升级条件未满足。）若 Q3 收入落在 $255-290M 指引区间内或更高、非 GAAP 毛利率达到指引上沿 30.5% 或突破 31%，经营现金流按单季口径持续为正且增发节奏放缓，同时集中度披露显示数据中心客户结构改善，则上调至 neutral-watch 或 constructive。
upgrade.en: (Switched to the Q3 delivery frame on 2026-08-18; the Q2 legs are adjudicated - revenue of $191.9M missed the $198M upper bound while Q3 guidance shows the step-up, so the upgrade did not trigger.) Move to neutral-watch or constructive if Q3 revenue lands inside or above the $255-290M guide, non-GAAP gross margin reaches the 30.5% top of the guide or breaks above 31%, operating cash flow stays positive on a single-quarter basis while the issuance pace slows, and concentration disclosures show an improving datacenter customer mix.

downgrade.zh: （2026-08-18 切换为 Q3 交付口径；Q2 口径已裁定——收入落在指引内、Q3 指引不保守，降级条件未触发。）若 Q3 收入低于 $255M 指引下沿或毛利率跌破 29% 指引下沿、单季口径经营现金流重新转负叠加增发继续快于收入证明，或 Digicomm/单一大客户订单节奏出现波动，则下调至 bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: (Switched to the Q3 delivery frame on 2026-08-18; the Q2 legs are adjudicated - revenue landed inside the guide and Q3 guidance is not cautious, so the downgrade did not trigger.) Move to bearish-avoid if Q3 revenue falls below the $255M guide floor or gross margin breaks below the 29% guide floor, single-quarter operating cash flow turns negative again while issuance keeps outpacing revenue proof, or order-cadence swings emerge at Digicomm or another single large customer.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：倍数算术已失效；谨慎改以执行风险为依据，在当前价格下成立。

The four execution legs are unchanged; on the new frame EV/TTM is ~21.5x and EV/annualized-Q3-guide-midpoint ~11.8x, so the late-July valuation cushion has been repriced away. Cautious holds at $154.89 on execution risk - more firmly than at the $90 level; downgrade triggers did not fire, conviction stays medium.

note.zh: 8 月 21 日收盘重锚并纳入新 ATM：EV/TTM 约 17.3x、EV/年化 Q3 指引中点约 9.5x。价格回落增加容错，但新融资能力与季后实际增发强化执行风险；Q3 交付触发器均未触发，维持谨慎/中确信。
note.en: Re-anchored at the August 21 close and incorporated the new ATM: EV/TTM is about 17.3x and EV/annualized-Q3-guide-midpoint about 9.5x. The lower price adds tolerance, but new financing capacity and actual post-quarter issuance strengthen execution risk; neither Q3 delivery trigger fired, so cautious / medium conviction is retained.

trigger.zh: Q2 $180-198M 指引与 Q3 产能上线兑现
trigger.en: Q2 $180-198M guide delivered and Q3 capacity step-up lands

latest.zh: 2026 Q2（2026-08-06 盘后发布）：收入 $191.9M，落在 $180-198M 指引区间内；数据中心收入 $107.7M（2025 Q2 为 $44.8M，同比 +140%），CATV 收入 $80.6M。公司称 800G 出货量环比翻倍以上（未量化只数），总制造产能接近每月 20 万只，并预计到 2026 年底具备每月约 65 万只 800G 与 1.6T 产品的生产能力；Q3 指引收入 $255-290M、非 GAAP 毛利率 29%-30.5%。评级为阈内：本项触发条件的第一条腿（交付 Q2 $180-198M 指引）已兑现。证据边界：第二条腿（Q3 产能上线）尚未落地——$255-290M 是指引，每月 65 万只是公司陈述的年底产能计划而非已安装产能或已订订单；公司所称「需求将持续超过产能至 2027 年中」是管理层评论，未附订单、积压或合同量化。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (released after the close on 2026-08-06): revenue was $191.9M, inside the $180-198M guide; datacenter revenue was $107.7M (Q2 2025: $44.8M, +140% YoY) and CATV revenue $80.6M. The company says 800G shipment volume more than doubled sequentially (units not quantified), total manufacturing capacity is approaching 200,000 units per month, and it expects to be capable of producing about 650,000 pieces per month of 800G and 1.6T product by the end of 2026; Q3 is guided to $255-290M of revenue at a 29%-30.5% non-GAAP gross margin. Graded within: the first leg of this item's trigger - delivering the $180-198M Q2 guide - was met. Evidence limits: the second leg, the Q3 capacity step-up, has not landed - $255-290M is guidance, and the 650,000/month figure is a stated year-end capability plan rather than installed capacity or booked orders; 'demand will continue to outpace our production capacity through mid-2027' is management commentary with no order, backlog or contract quantification.

latest.zh: 2026-08-21 8-K、424B5 与 Equity Distribution Agreement：AAOI 新设可不时出售最高 $600M 普通股的 ATM，代理佣金最高为总售价的 2.0%；协议明确只有公司发出 placement notice 后才产生具体配售义务，公司可暂停销售或终止协议，因此未用额度不是已执行稀释。与此同时，424B5 披露 5 月 ATM 在 2026-06-30 后已售出 332,428 股、总收款约 $49.2M；2026-08-20 流通股为 84,906,289 股。按文件假设价 $129.10 全额发行 $600M 对应约 4.65M 股、约为当前股本的 5.5%，但这只是文件的全额假设，不能写成已发行。现金流腿仍沿用已提交 Q2 10-Q：H1 经营现金流 −$73.781M，而两份季报相减得 Q2 单季约 +$11.6M（本报告推导）。评级维持读数不明：增发扩大一腿被新容量及季后实际销售进一步确认；经营现金流一腿仍因 H1 与单季口径方向相反且触发条件未规定周期而无法裁定。2026-08-23 触发条件修订：原措辞自 08-06 起连续两次因未规定计量周期而无法裁定，现于 Q3 披露前重写为单季两腿——现金流腿＝单季经营现金流为负（推导口径同前）；稀释腿＝收入/股（单季收入÷10-Q 封面流通股）环比下降；两腿同时成立记 breached。基线（本报告推导）：Q1 约 $1.88/股（$151.2M÷80,242,767 股，Q1 单季收入由 H1 $343.1M 减 Q2 $191.9M 得出）、Q2 约 $2.27/股（$191.9M÷84,569,237 股）。按新措辞回看 Q2 两腿均不成立，但不追溯改判，读数维持不明，首个正式裁定点为 Q3 10-Q；封面流通股与 Q3 指引的约 9,280 万前瞻加权稀释股口径不可混用。
latest.en: The August 21, 2026 8-K, 424B5 and Equity Distribution Agreement establish a new ATM under which AAOI may sell up to $600M of common stock from time to time, at agent commissions of up to 2.0% of gross sales. The agreement creates placement obligations only after the company delivers a placement notice and lets the company suspend sales or terminate the agreement, so unused capacity is not executed dilution. Separately, the 424B5 says the May ATM sold 332,428 shares after June 30 for about $49.2M of gross proceeds, and reports 84,906,289 shares outstanding as of August 20. A full $600M sale at the filing's assumed $129.10 price equates to about 4.65M shares, roughly 5.5% of the current share count, but that is the filing's full-utilization assumption, not issued shares. The cash-flow leg still rests on the filed Q2 10-Q: H1 operating cash flow was -$73.781M while subtracting the two quarter-to-date filings gives derived Q2-only cash flow of about +$11.6M. The reading stays unclear: the issuance-expansion leg is further confirmed by new capacity and actual post-quarter sales, but the cash-flow leg remains directionally split across H1 and derived-quarter frames and the trigger specifies no measurement period. Trigger revised 2026-08-23: the old wording had been unadjudicable on two consecutive checks since 08-06 for want of a measurement period, and is rewritten ahead of any Q3 disclosure as two single-quarter legs - the cash-flow leg = single-quarter operating cash flow negative (same derived frame as before), and the dilution leg = revenue per share (single-quarter revenue / 10-Q cover share count) declining Q/Q; both legs met together grade breached. Baselines (derived by this report): about $1.88/share for Q1 ($151.2M / 80,242,767 shares, with Q1 single-quarter revenue obtained as H1 $343.1M minus Q2 $191.9M) and about $2.27/share for Q2 ($191.9M / 84,569,237 shares). Read back against Q2, neither leg is met, but this pass does not re-grade retroactively - the reading stays unclear and the first formal adjudication point is the Q3 10-Q; cover share counts must not be mixed with the roughly 92.8M forward weighted diluted shares used in the Q3 guide.

trigger.zh: 单一大客户订单节奏波动
trigger.en: order cadence swings at the single large customer

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 10-Q（2026-08-06）首次给出可对照的集中度披露：截至 2026-06-30，Digicomm 占应收账款总额约 67.2%；2026 上半年来自 Digicomm 的收入约 $147.0M，占合并收入约 42.8%，且主要来自 CATV 产品类别。公司称已向 Digicomm 提供长于常规的付款条件以保证其备货，历史回款记录良好，并预计随数据中心业务相对增长，Digicomm 的应收账款集中度将下降。评级为阈内：本项触发条件是单一大客户订单节奏出现波动，本期无此类披露。但读数方向与本报告原有表述不同——已披露的最大集中度出现在 CATV 分销商 Digicomm，而非数据中心的超大规模客户；公司未按客户披露数据中心收入，因此不能从数据中心分部收入 $107.7M（同比 +140%）推断任何单一超大规模客户的订单节奏。
latest.en: The Q2 2026 10-Q (2026-08-06) gives the first concentration disclosure that can be checked against this item: at 2026-06-30 Digicomm represented approximately 67.2% of total accounts receivable, and H1 2026 revenue from Digicomm was approximately $147.0M, or about 42.8% of consolidated revenue, primarily in the CATV product category. The company says it has extended longer than typical payment terms to Digicomm so it can hold adequate inventory, that its collection experience has been good, and that it expects Digicomm accounts-receivable concentration to decline as the datacenter business grows relative to it. Graded within: this item's trigger is an order-cadence swing at the single large customer, and no such swing is disclosed. The reading does, however, point somewhere other than this report's original framing - the largest disclosed concentration sits with the CATV distributor Digicomm, not with the datacenter hyperscaler - and because the company does not disclose datacenter revenue by customer, no single hyperscaler's order cadence can be inferred from the $107.7M (+140% YoY) datacenter segment figure.

latest.en: 2026-08-22 full valuation re-anchor at the 2026-08-21 close of $124.82: the share count uses the 84,906,289 shares outstanding as of August 20 disclosed in the 424B5, giving market cap of about $10.60B. Using Q2 10-Q cash of $499.7M against $222.0M of debt and debt-like liabilities gives about $277.7M of net cash and EV of about $10.32B; this EV neither adds the post-June-30 $49.2M of gross proceeds to cash nor treats unused new ATM capacity as cash or shares. TTM revenue including Q2 is about $596.0M, putting EV/TTM Sales at about 17.3x and EV/annualized-Q3-guide-midpoint at about 9.5x. The reading stays within: the 19.4% price decline from the historical August 17 anchor widens tolerance, but this item's trigger is multiple compression on a ramp miss, Q3 has not landed, and the price move itself is neither a ramp failure nor a stance signal.

stanceRationale.en: At $981.98, roughly $264B market cap, and about 44x 2026E adjusted EBITDA, the market already capitalizes gas-turbine slots, the $163B backlog, grid capex, and the margin ramp; a 20% bull / 50% base / 30% bear grid shows very high asset quality but a mildly negative skew from valuation and AI-capex crowding.

upgrade.zh: 仅在完成当前估值复核后，如果Q3/Q4订单和backlog继续增长、63 GW slot预留转为设备backlog且合计数向≥125 GW推进，调整后EBITDA利润率高于12-14%指引区间且Wind亏损明显收窄，同时估值倍数不再扩张，则上调至neutral-watch或constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or constructive only after a current valuation review if Q3/Q4 orders and backlog keep growing, the 63 GW of Q2 slot reservations convert into equipment backlog while the combined total progresses toward >=125 GW, adjusted EBITDA margin moves above the 12-14% guide range with clear Wind loss reduction, and the valuation multiple does not expand further.

downgrade.zh: 在完成当前论点/估值复核后，如果数据中心订单或slot转化放缓、利润率爬坡停滞在12-14%以下、Wind亏损未能向维持不变的FY2026指引改善，或AI capex预期下修导致明确标注日期的约45-48x EV/2026E EBITDA重新定价，则下调至bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid after a current thesis/valuation review if data-center orders or slot conversion slow, the margin ramp stalls below the 12-14% guide range, Wind losses fail to improve toward the maintained FY2026 guide, or AI capex expectations are cut and the dated roughly 45-48x EV/2026E EBITDA multiple re-rates.

latest.en: The FY2026 Form 10-K filed 2026-08-17 puts NBM economics into a filing for the first time: the long-term agreements commit specified product volumes over multi-year periods, use fixed and variable pricing, and are supported by customer financial guarantees. At 2026-07-03, NBM remaining performance obligations were $59.8B, about 19% expected within twelve months and entirely related to NBMs; contract liabilities were $1.242B and refund liabilities $1.5B, with additional third-party collateral mechanisms available. The filing validates the direction of the old roughly $42B management framing and financial protection, but does not disclose FY2027 committed-bit coverage and delivery has not occurred. The trigger requires both filing confirmation and delivery, so the reading remains unclear.

latest.zh: Q4 FY2026（2026-08-05 发布）数据中心收入 $2,977M（环比 +103%、同比 +1,298%），FY2026 全年 $5,153M（同比 +437%）；公司披露数据中心占其 bit 出货比重由 Q4 FY2025 的 12% 升至 Q4 FY2026 的 38%。同期 Edge $5,432M（环比 +48%）、消费 $556M（环比 −32%）。放量与结构占比抬升同时成立。公司另称预期数据中心占 NAND 总 TAM 比重由 CY25 约 30% 升至 CY26 约 50%——该项为公司自有市场模型口径的前瞻预期，非已实现数据。
latest.en: Q4 FY2026 (released 2026-08-05): Datacenter revenue $2,977M, up 103% Q/Q and 1,298% Y/Y, with FY2026 revenue of $5,153M (up 437%); the company discloses Datacenter grew from 12% of its bits in Q4 FY2025 to 38% in Q4 FY2026. Over the same quarter Edge was $5,432M (up 48% Q/Q) and Consumer $556M (down 32% Q/Q). Both the ramp and the rising structural share hold. The company separately expects Datacenter's share of total NAND TAM to expand from about 30% in CY25 to about 50% in CY26 — a forward expectation on the company's own market model, not realised data.

The 12-15x frame implies $119.12-$148.90 of sustainable EPS, still below the $157 Q4 non-GAAP annualized and $180 Q1-guide midpoint annualized, so the reading stays within the frame. The requirement is now 1.68-2.10x the FY2026 non-GAAP average of $70.88 and the 12x end is about 94.8% of Q4 annualized, leaving a thinner normalization buffer. The existing roughly $1,884 downgrade threshold has not fired.

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-08-18 按当前价格与 FY2026 Form 10-K 重新推导。按 2026-08-17 收盘 $1,786.85 与 146,419,001 股，市值约 $2,616.3 亿；FY2026 P/S 12.92x、非 GAAP P/E 25.21x、FCF 收益率 4.39%。12-15x 通周期框架隐含可持续 EPS $119.12-148.90，仍低于 Q4 非 GAAP 年化 $157 与 Q1 指引中点年化 $180，约 $1,884 的降级阈值尚未触发，因此算术仍不支持谨慎；但区间已达 FY2026 平均 $70.88 的 1.68-2.10 倍，缓冲很薄。10-K 确认 NBM 多年期数量、固定/浮动定价、$598 亿 RPO 与财务担保，证据集改善；但升级条件还要求 FY2027 有意义的数量覆盖、Q1 兑现与行业供给纪律，尚未全部满足，维持观望中性/中确信。
stanceRationale.en: Re-derived on 2026-08-18 at the current price and against the FY2026 Form 10-K. At the 2026-08-17 close of $1,786.85 and 146,419,001 shares, market cap is about $261.6B; FY2026 P/S is 12.92x, non-GAAP P/E 25.21x, and FCF yield 4.39%. A 12-15x through-cycle frame implies $119.12-$148.90 of sustainable EPS, still below the $157 Q4 non-GAAP annualized and $180 Q1-guide midpoint annualized. The roughly $1,884 downgrade threshold has not fired, so the arithmetic still does not support cautious, although the 1.68-2.10x band versus FY2026 average EPS of $70.88 leaves little cushion. The 10-K improves the evidence set by confirming multi-year NBM volumes, fixed and variable pricing, $59.8B of RPO, and financial guarantees. The upgrade path also requires meaningful FY2027 coverage, Q1 delivery, and industry supply discipline; those legs are not all met, so neutral-watch / medium holds.

upgrade.zh: 若文件确认 NBM 对 FY2027 有意义的数量覆盖与财务保护、Q1 FY2027 兑现收入 $103-108 亿与非 GAAP 毛利率 83-85% 指引，且 NAND 合同价与行业产能仍显示供给纪律，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if filings confirm meaningful FY2027 NBM volume coverage and financial protection, Q1 FY2027 delivers the $10.3-10.8B revenue and 83-85% non-GAAP gross-margin guide, and NAND contract prices plus industry capacity still show supply discipline.

downgrade.zh: 若 NAND 合同价连续两个周期转弱、毛利率无结构解释地跌破 70%、NBM 条款不及预期、SanDisk/铠侠新增产能指向供给过剩，或价格升破约 $1,884 使 12x 隐含可持续 EPS 不再低于 Q4 非 GAAP 年化 $157，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if NAND contract prices weaken for two consecutive periods, gross margin falls below 70% without a mix explanation, NBM terms disappoint, SanDisk/Kioxia capacity additions point to oversupply, or the price rises above roughly $1,884 so the 12x-implied sustainable EPS no longer sits below the $157 Q4 non-GAAP annualized.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：$1,279.96 下隐含可持续 EPS 约 $85-107，仍低于顶峰指引，谨慎调整为观望中性。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling: at $1,279.96 implied sustainable EPS (~$85-107) is still below the peak guide; cautious moves to neutral-watch.

note.zh: 价格与 10-K 重锚：2026-08-17 收盘 $1,786.85 下，12-15x 框架隐含 EPS $119.12-148.90，12x 端约为 Q4 年化的 94.8%，但尚未跨过约 $1,884 的降级阈值。10-K 确认 $598 亿 NBM RPO、数量承诺、定价机制与财务担保；FY2027 bit 覆盖和 Q1 交付未验证，维持观望中性/中确信。
note.en: Price and 10-K re-anchor: at the 2026-08-17 close of $1,786.85, the 12-15x frame implies $119.12-$148.90 of EPS and the 12x end is about 94.8% of Q4 annualized, but the roughly $1,884 downgrade threshold has not fired. The 10-K confirms $59.8B of NBM RPO, volume commitments, pricing mechanisms, and financial guarantees; FY2027 bit coverage and Q1 delivery remain unverified, so neutral-watch / medium holds.

GAAP盈利质量未确立：经营亏损同比走阔至$(75.9)M，$5.6M单季净利主要来自$98.5M证券未实现收益；H1仍净亏$(120.3)M
独立估值锚点：TEM 2026-08-24收盘$66.17、市值约$119.4亿、P/S(TTM)约8.3x、EV/2026E EBITDA约192x；反向倍数隐含约38%三年营收CAGR，高于约25%指引
Personalis每股$16.25待完成交易仍未并入；维持谨慎/中确信，重点监测Q3增长、经营亏损与交易对价
summaryEn: Updated 2026-08-25 (FDA clearance for Tempus ECG-PH, plus a valuation re-anchor to the 2026-08-24 close): on 2026-08-24 the company announced FDA 510(k) clearance for Tempus ECG-PH (pulmonary hypertension), the third cleared device in its cardiovascular portfolio. The release disclosed no revenue, pricing, or reimbursement guidance, and FY2026 guidance of $1.595-1.605B revenue and about $65M adjusted EBITDA is unchanged. Q2 fundamentals carry over: revenue $382.5M (+21.6% YoY), operating loss widened to $(75.9)M, and $5.6M of GAAP net income came mainly from $98.5M of unrealized securities gains. Re-anchored to TEM's 2026-08-24 close of $66.17 and the Q2 Form 10-Q cover-page count of about 180.43M shares as of 2026-07-24: approximately $11.94B market cap, 8.3x TTM P/S, and about 192x EV/2026E EBITDA; Personalis remains pending. Reverse-multiple math now implies roughly 38% three-year revenue CAGR — above the company's ~25% guide and its 21.6% latest actual quarter, so the execution cushion has gone negative; the stance stays cautious / medium conviction.

stanceRationale.zh: 以2026-08-24收盘$66.17、约$119.4亿市值计，TTM P/S约8.3x、EV/2026E EBITDA约192x。若三年后倍数回归4.0x并要求8%年化回报，当前价格隐含约38%营收CAGR，已高于公司约25%的FY2026指引与21.6%的最近实际季度；Q2经营亏损仍同比走阔。本次倍数扩张完全来自价格（经营输入未变），2026-08-24的ECG-PH清除未附带任何收入指引，无法在数字上支撑该扩张，故估值张力较上一版更紧。
stanceRationale.en: At the 2026-08-24 close of $66.17 and about $11.94B of market cap, TTM P/S is roughly 8.3x and EV/2026E EBITDA about 192x. If the multiple normalizes to 4.0x over three years with an 8% hurdle, the price implies roughly 38% revenue CAGR — above the company's ~25% FY2026 guide and its 21.6% latest actual quarter — while the Q2 operating loss was still widening year over year. The multiple expansion is entirely price-driven (operating inputs unchanged), and the 2026-08-24 ECG-PH clearance carried no revenue guidance, so it cannot numerically support the expansion; valuation tension is tighter than in the prior version.

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定重新裁定。按 2026-07-31 KRX 收盘 ₩1,718,000（市值约 ₩1,219.7 万亿，约 $8,530 亿），P/S（TTM）约 6.5x——经反弹后回到 2 月 6.3x 起点附近；旧谨慎立场依据的约 28x TTM P/E / 约 16x P/S 算术已不存在，立场调整为观望中性。分母仍是 76% 营业利润率下的周期顶点收入，顶点持久性问题使其停留在中性而非看多；TTM P/E 因净利润桥接未披露仍不予重算，下一验证点 Q3 2026（2026-10-27）。
stanceRationale.en: Re-adjudicated 2026-07-31 under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-07-31 KRX close of ₩1,718,000 (about ₩1,219.7T market cap, roughly $853B), P/S (TTM) is about 6.5x — back near February's 6.3x starting point after the rebound; the ~28x TTM P/E / ~16x P/S arithmetic behind the cautious stance is gone, so the stance moves to neutral-watch. The denominator is still peak-cycle revenue at a 76% operating margin, and that durability question keeps it at neutral rather than constructive; TTM P/E remains un-recomputable (net-profit bridge undisclosed), next test Q3 2026 (2026-10-27).

upgrade.zh: 若 Q2/H2 财报显示 HBM ASP 与出货继续上行、营业利润率仍接近 70%、Samsung/Micron HBM4 认证未追近，且股价不再扩张到更高 P/S，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if Q2/H2 results show HBM ASPs and shipments still rising, operating margin stays near 70%, Samsung/Micron HBM4 qualification does not close the gap, and the stock does not expand to a higher P/S multiple.

downgrade.zh: 若营业利润率明显从 72% 回落，或 ASP/订单开始显示 2027 供给追上需求，则下调至 cautious；若 HBM4 份额或 NVIDIA 主供地位被 Samsung/Micron 侵蚀，则下调至 bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if operating margin falls materially from 72% or ASP/order data starts to show 2027 supply catching demand; move to bearish-avoid if HBM4 share or NVIDIA primary-supplier status is eroded by Samsung/Micron.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：₩1,718,000 下 P/S 约 6.5x，旧 28x/16x 算术消失，谨慎调整为观望中性；顶点持久性使其不转看多。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling: at ₩1,718,000 (P/S ~6.5x) the old 28x/16x arithmetic is gone; cautious moves to neutral-watch, capped by peak-cycle durability.

title: Almonty Industries 深度研究报告 - 西方钨供应链稀缺资产的兑现考验
titleEn: Almonty Industries Deep Research Report - Western Tungsten Scarcity Asset Execution Test
summary: 2026-08-18 立场重锚：ALM 于 2026-08-17 收于 $16.36，较 2026-07-30 锚点 $11.67 上涨 40.2%。按 288,480,750 股（MD&A 日期 2026-08-11，含 CDI）重算：市值约 $47.2 亿；TTM 收入 C$85,803 千元（约 US$6,180 万，按 2026-08-14 USD/CAD 1.3875），P/S（TTM）约 76x；按可转债面值口径净债务约 US$6,100 万，企业价值约 $47.8 亿、EV/Sales 约 77x（IFRS 账面口径为净现金 US$2.909 亿、EV 约 $44.3 亿、约 72x）。倍数温和上升（约 66x → 约 76x），因为二季度收入把分母顶了上去——但分部附注（附注 16）显示这笔收入几乎全部来自 Panasqueira：二季度 Sangdong 分部收入仅 C$64 千元、Panasqueira C$42,925 千元；上半年 Sangdong 收入 C$120 千元、资本开支 C$44,794 千元。溢价买的是 Sangdong，而 Sangdong 迄今确认的收入接近于零。维持谨慎／中确信：升级条款为合取且「产能利用率与现金成本」无披露，降级条款为析取且无一条触发（APT 约 US$3,087/MTU 远高于 $400 门槛，2026-08-17 董事会转为授权最多 US$3 亿回购而非增发）。已报期仍为 Q2 2026（2026-08-17 的 6-K 是回购新闻稿，非新财报期）。
highlights: 倍数温和上升（约 66x → 约 76x）：涨幅被二季度收入顶掉了分母，而不是估值被重估
分部附注：二季度 Sangdong 收入仅 C$64 千元、Panasqueira C$42,925 千元；上半年 Sangdong 收入 C$120 千元 vs 资本开支 C$44,794 千元
维持谨慎 / 中确信：升级合取缺「利用率与现金成本」披露，降级析取无一条触发
2026-08-17 授权最多 US$3 亿 / 1,440 万股回购（36 个月）；可转债转股价 US$27.40 高出收盘 67.5%，financing-dilution 评 within
summaryEn: August 18, 2026 stance re-anchor: ALM closed at $16.36 on August 17, 2026, up 40.2% from the July 30 anchor of $11.67. Recomputed on 288,480,750 shares (MD&A dated August 11, 2026, including CDIs): market cap about $4.72B; TTM revenue of C$85,803 thousand (about US$61.8M at the August 14 USD/CAD rate of 1.3875) puts P/S (TTM) at about 76x; net debt of about US$61M on the face-value convertible caliber gives an enterprise value of about $4.78B and EV/Sales of about 77x (on the IFRS carrying caliber it is net cash of US$290.9M, EV about $4.43B and about 72x). The multiple rose moderately (about 66x to about 76x) because Q2 revenue lifted the denominator rather than the stock re-rating. The segment note (Note 16) shows that revenue is almost entirely Panasqueira: Q2 segment revenue was C$64 thousand at Sangdong versus C$42,925 thousand at Panasqueira, and H1 Sangdong revenue of C$120 thousand sat against C$44,794 thousand of Sangdong capital expenditure. The premium is being paid for Sangdong, which has recognized almost no revenue to date. Cautious / medium conviction holds: the upgrade clause is a conjunction and the plant-utilization and cash-cost leg has no disclosure, while the downgrade clause is a disjunction and no leg fires (APT is about US$3,087/MTU against a US$400 threshold, and on August 17 the board authorized up to US$300 million of repurchases rather than new issuance). The reported period remains Q2 2026; the August 17 Form 6-K is a buyback press release, not a new financial period.

trigger.zh: 矿山未按计划放量 —— 当前估值的第一前提失效
trigger.en: the mine misses its ramp plan — the first premise of the current valuation breaks

latest.zh: 2026 年二季度（新闻稿日期 2026-08-11，2026-08-12 随 6-K 提交）分部附注（附注 16）按矿山单列，这是此前该条目未引用的披露：二季度 Sangdong 分部收入 C$64 千元、生产成本 C$54 千元、矿业经营利润 C$10 千元，同期 Panasqueira 分部收入 C$42,925 千元、矿业经营利润 C$26,491 千元；上半年 Sangdong 收入 C$120 千元（2025 上半年 C$26 千元）、资本开支 C$44,794 千元、分部总资产 C$228,380 千元。即公司整体 +498% 的收入增长与 C$26,103 千元矿业经营利润几乎全部来自 Panasqueira 在钨价高位的兑现，不是 Sangdong 爬坡的兑现。更正上一轮表述：公司确实按分部披露 Sangdong 的收入、成本、资本开支与资产；未披露的是吨/MTU 产量、回收率、单位现金成本与季度爬坡时程。读数维持 unclear 而非 breached，理由有二：其一，触发条件问的是「未按计划放量」，而公司从未公布可对照的季度爬坡计划，MD&A 现口径亦称一期「仍处于试车与爬坡阶段」，试车期收入接近零并不等于偏离计划；其二，分部收入衡量的是已确认销售而非产量，与全公司销量口径一样不能直接读成产出。真正需要的是 Sangdong 的绝对产量与单位成本。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (release dated August 11 and furnished on Form 6-K filed August 12, 2026): the segment note (Note 16) breaks results out by mine, a disclosure this item had not previously cited. Q2 Sangdong segment revenue was C$64 thousand on production costs of C$54 thousand for mining income of C$10 thousand, against Panasqueira segment revenue of C$42,925 thousand and mining income of C$26,491 thousand; H1 Sangdong revenue was C$120 thousand (H1 2025: C$26 thousand) against C$44,794 thousand of Sangdong capital expenditure and segment total assets of C$228,380 thousand. The company-wide +498% revenue growth and C$26,103 thousand of mining income are therefore almost entirely Panasqueira realizing high tungsten prices, not a Sangdong ramp. Correcting the prior wording: the company does disclose Sangdong revenue, cost, capital expenditure and assets by segment; what it does not disclose is tonnes/MTU produced, recovery, unit cash cost or a quarterly ramp schedule. The reading stays unclear rather than breached for two reasons. First, the trigger asks whether the mine misses its ramp plan, and no comparable quarterly ramp plan has ever been published, while the MD&A's current wording still describes Phase I as in commissioning and ramp-up, so near-zero revenue during commissioning is not by itself a deviation from plan. Second, segment revenue measures recognized sales, not production, and like the company-wide volume figure it cannot be read directly as output. Absolute Sangdong production and unit cost remain the missing evidence.

monitoring.nextCheck: Sangdong 分部收入与绝对产量、单位现金成本、爬坡里程碑 / Sangdong segment revenue plus absolute output, unit cash cost and ramp milestones

trigger.zh: 钨价回落令估值前提失效
trigger.en: tungsten prices fall, undermining the valuation premise

latest.zh: 2026 年二季度（新闻稿日期 2026-08-11，2026-08-12 随 6-K 提交）：MD&A 所引欧洲 APT Metal Bulletin 周报价自 2025 年 1 月 US$330/MTU 升至 2026 年 6 月底 US$3,075/MTU，平均中间价自 2026 年 1 月初 US$862.5/MTU 升至 2026-08-07 约 US$3,087/MTU。季度收入 C$42,989 千元，同比 +498%；公司整体 WO3 MTU 销量环比减少 21.1%，同时部分 3 月发货在 4 月确认，故不能把收入环比变化纯归因于价格。2026-07-14 GTP 长期承购协议延长六年、合约总量提高 40%、全部合约量价格提高约 6.3%。严格对照“钨价下跌”的触发条件，公开报价上涨，读数为 within。边界：APT 报价不是 Almonty 的本季实现价格，公司未披露实现单价。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (release dated August 11 and furnished on Form 6-K filed August 12, 2026): the European APT Metal Bulletin quotation cited in the MD&A rose from US$330/MTU in January 2025 to US$3,075/MTU at June 2026 month-end, while the average mid-price rose from US$862.5/MTU in early January 2026 to about US$3,087/MTU on August 7. Quarterly revenue was C$42,989 thousand, up 498% YoY; company-wide WO3 MTUs sold fell 21.1% sequentially, while some March shipments were recognized in April, so sequential revenue cannot be attributed purely to price. On July 14, the GTP offtake was extended six years, contracted volume increased 40% and pricing improved about 6.3%. Graded strictly against the trigger of falling tungsten prices, the published quotation rose, so the reading is within. Limit: the APT quotation is not Almonty's realized price, which is not disclosed for the quarter.
