metric.zh: Plansee/GTP 承购执行与客户回款
metric.en: Plansee/GTP offtake execution and customer collections

trigger.zh: 承购交付与客户回款按合同节奏落地，或 Plansee/GTP 回款延迟、存货积压
trigger.en: offtake deliveries and customer payments land on the contracted cadence, or Plansee/GTP collections slip and inventory builds

latest.zh: 2026 年二季度报表（2026-08-12 随 6-K 提交）首次给出可核对的营运资本证据：应收账款 C$13,128 千元（2025 年末 C$3,085 千元），存货 C$8,664 千元（2025 年末 C$9,418 千元，为下降而非积压），递延收入 2026-06-30 为零（2026-03-31 为 C$3,442 千元，已在二季度确认），上半年经营活动现金流 +C$31,606 千元（2025 上半年 −C$14,917 千元）；按二季度收入 C$42,989 千元折算，应收周转约 28 天。合并层面看不到回款延迟或存货积压。但触发条件点名的是 Plansee/GTP：公司未按交易对手拆分交付量、合约节奏达成率或应收账龄，且分部附注显示 Sangdong 上半年收入仅 C$120 千元，意味着 Sangdong 侧的承购交付尚未形成有意义的履约与回款记录。读数为 unclear：缺的是交易对手层面的交付量对合约节奏、应收账龄，以及 Sangdong 承购的首个规模化交付批次。
latest.en: The Q2 2026 statements (furnished on Form 6-K filed August 12, 2026) give the first checkable working-capital evidence: trade receivables of C$13,128 thousand (year-end 2025: C$3,085 thousand), inventories of C$8,664 thousand (year-end 2025: C$9,418 thousand, a decline rather than a build), deferred revenue of nil at June 30, 2026 (C$3,442 thousand at March 31, 2026, recognized in Q2), and H1 operating cash flow of +C$31,606 thousand (H1 2025: -C$14,917 thousand); against Q2 revenue of C$42,989 thousand that is roughly 28 days of receivables. At the consolidated level there is no visible collection slip or inventory build. But the trigger names Plansee/GTP specifically, and the company does not split delivery volumes, contracted-cadence attainment or receivables ageing by counterparty, while the segment note shows H1 Sangdong revenue of only C$120 thousand, meaning the Sangdong side of the offtake has no meaningful delivery or collection record yet. Reading: unclear. The missing evidence is counterparty-level delivery volume against contracted cadence, receivables ageing, and a first at-scale Sangdong offtake delivery.

monitoring.nextCheck: 交易对手层面的承购交付、应收账龄与 Sangdong 首个规模化交付 / counterparty-level offtake deliveries, receivables ageing and the first at-scale Sangdong delivery

trigger.zh: 放量前的额外融资显著稀释股东
trigger.en: pre-ramp financings dilute shareholders materially

latest.zh: 按 2026-08-17 收盘 $16.36、288,480,750 股（MD&A 日期 2026-08-11，含 CDI）计，市值约 $47.2 亿。股本自 2025 年末 262,776,228 股增至 2026-06-30 的 288,109,013 股，上半年 +9.6%，低于熊市论点所引「一年约 50%」的节奏。2026 年 6 月的 US$8 亿 2.25% 可转换优先票据以现金可交割方式发行（公司保留现金结算权，转股权按 IAS 32 计为衍生负债），并配套 US$9,480 万上限看涨期权（上限价 US$41.36）对冲稀释；初始转股价 US$27.40，较 $16.36 高 67.5%，全额转股对应约 2,920 万股、约合现有股本的 10.1%，当前深度价外。2026-08-17 董事会转向反向操作：授权 36 个月内回购最多 14,400,000 股（约为 2026-08-14 已发行股份的 5%）、总额上限 US$3 亿。读数为 within：触发条件问的是放量前融资是否显著稀释股东，本报告期公司以现金可交割可转债加上限看涨期权替代股权融资，期后进一步授权回购而非增发。边界：US$3 亿与 1,440 万股两个上限隐含约 US$20.83 的平均买入价（对上限的算术推算，非公司指引），高于 2026-08-14 收盘约 38%；授权不等于实际执行，回购进度需按季核对。
latest.en: At the August 17, 2026 close of $16.36 on 288,480,750 shares (MD&A dated August 11, 2026, including CDIs), market cap is about $4.72B. Share count rose from 262,776,228 at year-end 2025 to 288,109,013 at June 30, 2026, up 9.6% in H1 and below the roughly 50%-a-year pace cited in the bear case. The June 2026 US$800 million 2.25% convertible senior notes are cash-settleable at the company's option (the conversion feature is carried as a derivative liability under IAS 32) and were paired with a US$94.8 million capped call struck to a US$41.36 cap to offset dilution; the initial conversion price of US$27.40 sits 67.5% above $16.36, and full share settlement would be about 29.2 million shares or 10.1% of the current count, so it is well out of the money. On August 17, 2026 the board moved in the opposite direction, authorizing the repurchase of up to 14,400,000 shares (about 5% of shares outstanding as of August 14, 2026) for up to US$300 million over 36 months. Reading: within. The trigger asks whether pre-ramp financing dilutes shareholders materially; in the reported period the company substituted a cash-settleable convertible plus a capped call for equity, and after quarter end authorized repurchases rather than issuance. Limits: the US$300 million and 14.4 million share caps imply an average purchase price of about US$20.83 (arithmetic on the two caps, not company guidance), roughly 38% above the August 14 close, and an authorization is not execution — actual repurchase progress must be checked each quarter.

monitoring.nextCheck: 融资公告与实际回购执行进度 / financing announcements and actual repurchase execution

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-08-18 按所有者 Q1 裁定以当前价格重新推导。按 2026-08-17 收盘 $16.36（+40.2%）、288,480,750 股：市值约 $47.2 亿，TTM 收入 C$85,803 千元（约 US$6,180 万）对应 P/S 约 76x，可转债面值口径 EV 约 $47.8 亿、EV/Sales 约 77x。关键在于倍数温和上升（约 66x → 约 76x）：涨幅被二季度收入顶掉了分母，而非估值被重估——若沿用旧的约 US$5,000 万 TTM 分母，$16.36 对应约 94x。但分部附注把这笔收入的归属讲清楚了：二季度 Sangdong 分部收入 C$64 千元、Panasqueira C$42,925 千元；上半年 Sangdong 收入 C$120 千元对应资本开支 C$44,794 千元。也就是说，顶起分母的现金流来自 Panasqueira 的钨价兑现，而 $47.2 亿市值的溢价买的仍是 Sangdong——后者迄今确认收入接近于零。立场依据（矿山特定执行风险略大于非中国钨稀缺期权）因此不但未被证伪，反而拿到了更硬的证据；同时为这份未兑现的执行多付了 40.2%，预期差是走阔而非收敛。两侧确实有改善——C$12 亿现金、Panasqueira 首个显著盈利季度、以现金可交割可转债与回购授权替代股权融资——但都不作用于 Sangdong 本身的产量与单位成本，故确信度维持中。
stanceRationale.en: Re-derived 2026-08-18 at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the August 17, 2026 close of $16.36 (+40.2%) on 288,480,750 shares: market cap is about $4.72B, TTM revenue of C$85,803 thousand (about US$61.8M) puts P/S at about 76x, and on the face-value convertible caliber enterprise value is about $4.78B for EV/Sales of about 77x. The point is that the multiple rose moderately (about 66x to about 76x): Q2 revenue lifted the denominator rather than the stock re-rating — on the old roughly US$50M TTM denominator, $16.36 would be about 94x. But the segment note settles where that revenue comes from: Q2 segment revenue was C$64 thousand at Sangdong against C$42,925 thousand at Panasqueira, and H1 Sangdong revenue of C$120 thousand sat against C$44,794 thousand of Sangdong capital expenditure. The cash flow lifting the denominator is Panasqueira realizing tungsten prices, while the premium inside a $4.72B market cap is still being paid for Sangdong, which has recognized almost no revenue to date. The stance's basis — mine-specific execution risk slightly outweighing the non-China tungsten scarcity option — is therefore not falsified but better evidenced, and the same unproven execution now costs 40.2% more, so the expectation gap widened rather than closed. Genuine improvements exist on the other side — C$1.2 billion of cash, Panasqueira's first materially profitable quarter, and a cash-settleable convertible plus a repurchase authorization in place of equity issuance — but none of them touch Sangdong's own output or unit cost, so conviction stays medium.

upgrade.zh: 若 Sangdong 按 H2 2026 节奏确认商业收入、选矿厂利用率和现金成本达到管理层框架、APT 价格维持 $400+/MTU，且可转债/客户回款没有带来额外稀释压力，则上调至 neutral-watch 或 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or constructive if Sangdong confirms commercial revenue on the H2 2026 cadence, plant utilization and cash cost hit management's frame, APT holds above $400/MTU, and convertibles / customer collections do not create extra dilution pressure.

downgrade.zh: 若 Sangdong 爬坡低于计划、现金成本或回收率偏离、APT 价格跌破 $400/MTU 并持续、Plansee/GTP 包销回款延迟，或新增融资条款继续稀释普通股，则下调至 bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid if Sangdong ramp trails plan, cash cost or recovery deviates, APT falls below $400/MTU and stays there, Plansee / GTP offtake cash collection slips, or new financing terms keep diluting common shareholders.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定复核：立场依据是 Sangdong 执行风险而非倍数，在 $11.67 下成立，维持谨慎。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling re-check: the stance rests on Sangdong execution risk, not the multiple; it holds at $11.67, cautious stays.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定重锚（2026-08-17 收盘 $16.36，+40.2%）：市值约 $47.2 亿、P/S（TTM）约 76x、EV 约 $47.8 亿。倍数温和上升（约 66x → 约 76x）是因为二季度收入顶起了分母；而分部附注显示这笔收入几乎全是 Panasqueira（二季度 Sangdong C$64 千元 vs Panasqueira C$42,925 千元，上半年 Sangdong 收入 C$120 千元对资本开支 C$44,794 千元）。溢价买的仍是尚未兑现的 Sangdong，价格却高了 40.2%，预期差走阔。升级为合取、缺利用率与现金成本披露；降级为析取、无一条触发（APT 约 US$3,087/MTU，2026-08-17 授权 US$3 亿回购而非增发）。维持谨慎／中确信。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling re-anchor (August 17, 2026 close of $16.36, +40.2%): market cap about $4.72B, P/S (TTM) about 76x, EV about $4.78B. The multiple rose moderately (about 66x to about 76x) because Q2 revenue lifted the denominator; the segment note shows that revenue is almost entirely Panasqueira (Q2 Sangdong C$64 thousand versus Panasqueira C$42,925 thousand; H1 Sangdong revenue of C$120 thousand against C$44,794 thousand of capital expenditure). The premium still buys an unproven Sangdong, now at a 40.2% higher price, so the expectation gap widened. The upgrade clause is a conjunction and lacks utilization and cash-cost disclosure; the downgrade clause is a disjunction and no leg fires (APT about US$3,087/MTU, and on August 17 the board authorized US$300 million of repurchases rather than new issuance). Cautious / medium conviction holds.

summary: 2026H1 全周期重写，把 Amazon 升级为 AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的 dashboard 节点。2026 Q2（截至 06-30、07-30 盘后发布）：营收 $200.606B（+20%），AWS $42.232B（+37%、18 季最快、年化运行率 $169B）、分部营业利润 $16.621B / 利润率 39.4%，合并营业利润 $27.461B、利润率创纪录 13.7%，广告 +26%。净利润 $62.647B 含 $53.415B 非经营性其他收益（主要为 Anthropic 重估），不代表经营盈利。TTM 经营现金流 $161.403B，但 PP&E 净购置 $169.007B 使 TTM 自由现金流降至 -$7.604B；据电话会报道全年现金资本开支指引由约 $200B 上调至约 $220B，其中约 $20B 归因于内存涨价而非产能，AWS backlog 达 $496B。2026-08-13 S-4/A 补充了待交割 Globalstar 收购的公司级卫星 / 频谱可选性，但监管与 C-3 授权仍待完成，且该交易不构成现有 AI 链信号。估值锚为 2026-07-30 收盘 $235.50，该价格早于盘后财报数小时：市值约 $2.539T、窄口径 EV 约 $2.545T、EV/TTM 销售额约 3.28x（含长期租赁约 3.40x）。30/40/30 情景网格在这个新闻前锚点上读出温和为正的预期差，立场偏多、中确信。
summaryEn: 2026H1 full-cycle rewrite that promotes Amazon into the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer as its dashboard node. Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, reported after the July 30 close): revenue $200.606B (+20%); AWS $42.232B (+37%, fastest in 18 quarters, a $169B annualized run rate) with $16.621B segment operating income at a 39.4% margin; consolidated operating income $27.461B at a record 13.7% margin; advertising +26%. Net income of $62.647B includes $53.415B of non-operating other income, primarily Anthropic marks, and is not an operating-earnings measure. TTM operating cash flow was $161.403B, but $169.007B of net PP&E purchases drove TTM free cash flow to -$7.604B; per earnings-call coverage the full-year cash-capex guide was raised from about $200B to about $220B with roughly $20B attributed to higher memory prices rather than capacity, and the AWS backlog reached $496B. The August 13 S-4/A adds company-level satellite / spectrum optionality from the pending Globalstar acquisition, but regulatory and C-3 authorisations remain outstanding and the transaction is not an existing AI-chain signal. The valuation anchor is the 2026-07-30 close of $235.50, set hours before the after-close release: market cap about $2.539T, narrow EV about $2.545T, EV/TTM sales about 3.28x (about 3.40x including long-term leases). The 30/40/30 grid reads a modestly positive expectation gap at that pre-news anchor; the stance is constructive with medium conviction.

metric.zh: Trainium 对商用加速器的替代

trigger.en: Trainium deployment materially outruns the current commitment cadence and displaces merchant-GPU share inside AWS, or conversely Trainium commitments are delayed, cut, or cancelled

latest.zh: 官方财报稿：芯片业务年化收入运行率超过 $25B、三位数增长；Anthropic 与 OpenAI 各自做出多年期多吉瓦级 Trainium 承诺；Graviton5 全面上市、覆盖前 1,000 大 EC2 客户的 98%、收入承诺环比增长近 3 倍。据电话会报道，Trainium 收入承诺超过 $225B，OpenAI 承诺约 2 GW 并自 2027 年起爬坡。尚无可用于分级的部署量或份额披露
latest.en: official release: the chips business exceeded a $25B annual revenue run rate at triple-digit growth; Anthropic and OpenAI each made multi-year, multi-gigawatt Trainium commitments; Graviton5 reached general availability at 98% of the top 1,000 EC2 customers with revenue commitments up nearly 3x sequentially. Per call coverage, Trainium revenue commitments exceed $225B and OpenAI committed to roughly 2 GW ramping from 2027. No deployment-volume or share disclosure exists yet to grade against

monitoring.nextCheck: Trainium 部署披露与 OpenAI 自 2027 年起的爬坡 / Trainium deployment disclosures and the OpenAI ramp from 2027

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $235.50（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市值约 $2.539T、EV/TTM 销售额约 3.28x（含长期租赁约 3.40x）、市值/TTM 经营现金流约 15.7x；18.9x 的 GAAP 市盈率因投资重估而不具决策价值。关键在于这个锚点比盘后财报早了数小时：它没有包含 AWS +37%、39.4% 分部利润率、$496B backlog，也没有包含上调后的约 $220B 资本开支与 -$7.604B 的 TTM 自由现金流。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格在这个新闻前锚点上读出温和为正的预期差 —— 足以支持偏多，但负面项在结构上比表面更糟（约 $20B 的资本开支增量买不到产能，39.4% 是折旧浪潮前的数字），因此不到 bullish。
stanceRationale.en: At $235.50 (2026-07-30 close) market cap is about $2.539T, EV/TTM sales about 3.28x (about 3.40x including long-term leases), and price/TTM operating cash flow about 15.7x; the 18.9x GAAP P/E is not decision-useful because of investment marks. What matters is that this anchor was set hours before the after-close release: it contains neither AWS +37%, the 39.4% segment margin, and the $496B backlog, nor the raised ~$220B capex guide and the -$7.604B TTM free cash flow. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid reads a modestly positive expectation gap at that pre-news anchor - enough for constructive, but not bullish, because the negatives are structurally worse than they look: roughly $20B of the capex increase buys no capacity, and the 39.4% margin is a pre-depreciation-wave figure.

upgrade.zh: 追溯自由现金流在 2026 年见底并于 2027 年内转正，同时 AWS 维持 30% 以上增速与 37% 以上分部利润率，$496B backlog 在 AWS 报告收入中可见地转化，且 2027 资本开支指引把产能与投入成本通胀分开列示，则上调至 bullish。
upgrade.en: TTM free cash flow troughs in 2026 and turns positive during 2027 while AWS holds growth above 30% with a segment margin above 37%, the $496B backlog converts visibly into reported AWS revenue, and the 2027 capex guide separates capacity from input-cost inflation - upgrade to bullish.

downgrade.zh: AWS 增速减至 20% 中段而资本开支仍在上行、AWS 分部利润率跌破 35%、追溯自由现金流在 2027 年前持续低于 -$25B 且长期债务仍在增长，或 Anthropic 相关重估出现实质性回撤而公司仍未披露该头寸规模，则下调至 neutral-watch。
downgrade.en: AWS growth decelerates to the mid-20s while capex still rises, the AWS segment margin breaks below 35%, TTM free cash flow stays below -$25B into 2027 with long-term debt still growing, or an Anthropic-related mark reverses materially without disclosure of the position's size - downgrade to neutral-watch.

stanceRationale.en: Re-derived 2026-08-18 at the current price under the Q1 policy. downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid if Q4 / FY2027 revenue remains below Q3, Luminia / Infinite Grid remain non-binding, gross margin stays below 20%, cash covers fewer than 3 quarters, or another discounted financing is required.

None of the cautious legs — sequential contraction, dilution, losses, runway — is repaired by the move; the Infinite Grid stake disclosed in the 08-11 S-3 is alignment, not order conversion, and no upgrade condition has been met. benchmarkRationale.en: COPX is the resources-side expression of AI electrification in this book, and the resources layer default is COPX itself — self-benchmarking would score 0.0 forever. Scored against the book default SMH instead, to measure this resources leg against the semiconductor core beta; the question is not copper-vs-copper-miners.

latest.zh: 多年期 6GW 协议仍是核心锚点；在 2026-08-04 Q2 2026 电话会上，AMD 称 Helios（MI450 机架系统）正被 Anthropic、Cirrascale、HUMAIN、Meta、Microsoft、OpenAI、Oracle、Tensorwave、Vultr 等部署，与 Anthropic 的合作提及最多 2GW 的 MI450——这些均为已宣布的部署计划，而非已披露的出货量或已完成出货。H2 2026 的核心检验（首个 1GW 是否按期出货）尚未落定。
latest.en: The multi-year 6GW deal remains the anchor; on the 2026-08-04 Q2 2026 call AMD described Helios (MI450 rack systems) as being deployed by Anthropic, Cirrascale, HUMAIN, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle, Tensorwave, Vultr and others, with the Anthropic partnership referencing up to 2GW of MI450 - these are stated deployment plans, not disclosed shipment volumes or completed shipments. The core H2 2026 test (first 1GW shipping on schedule) is not yet resolved.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-H2 出货确认 / H2 shipment confirmation

trigger.zh: DC 增速失速将直接打击高预期定价
trigger.en: a DC growth stall directly hits the high-expectations pricing

latest.zh: 2026-08-04 Q2 2026 业绩（季度截至 2026-06-27）：季度收入 $11.5B（同比 +50%，GAAP），数据中心分部 $6.7B（同比 +107%、约占总收入 58%）；GAAP 毛利率 54%、非 GAAP 56%；GAAP 稀释每股收益 $1.38、非 GAAP $1.66。Q3 2026 指引收入约 $13B（±$300M）、非 GAAP 毛利率约 56%。数据中心增速由 Q1 的 +57% 进一步加速至 +107%，未见增长失速。
latest.en: 2026-08-04 Q2 2026 results (quarter ended 2026-06-27): quarterly revenue $11.5B (+50% YoY, GAAP) and Data Center segment $6.7B (+107% YoY, about 58% of total revenue); GAAP gross margin 54% / non-GAAP 56%; GAAP diluted EPS $1.38 / non-GAAP $1.66. Q3 2026 guided to revenue of about $13B (±$300M) and non-GAAP gross margin of about 56%. Data-center growth accelerated from +57% in Q1 to +107%, with no growth stall.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-Q3 财报与数据中心增速 / Q3 earnings and Data Center growth

metric.zh: ROCm 迁移证据与 Helios 机架级价格性能窗口
metric.en: ROCm migration evidence and the Helios rack-level price-performance window

trigger.zh: ROCm 出现可审计的客户迁移案例，或迁移证据持续缺位、且定制 ASIC 与 NVIDIA Rubin 压缩 AMD 的机架级价格性能窗口
trigger.en: ROCm produces auditable customer-migration cases, or migration evidence stays absent while custom ASICs and NVIDIA Rubin compress AMD's rack-level price-performance window

latest.zh: CUDA 约 400 万开发者，ROCm 2026 年目标 10 万（约 1/40）；实际性能差距由约 40-50% 收窄至约 10-30%，AMD 通常需低于 NVIDIA 约 15-40% 定价成交；2025 年 NVIDIA AI 加速器份额约 86-90%，AMD 数据中心份额同比反而少约 1 个百分点
latest.en: CUDA has roughly 4M developers against ROCm's 100K target for 2026 (about 1/40); the real-world performance gap narrowed from roughly 40-50% to roughly 10-30%, and AMD typically prices roughly 15-40% below NVIDIA to win deals. NVIDIA's AI accelerator share was roughly 86-90% in 2025, while AMD lost about one point of data-center share year over year

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-H2 迁移案例与 Helios/MI450 出货证据 / H2 2026 migration cases and Helios/MI450 shipment evidence

trigger.zh: 约 23.4x EV/TTM Sales、价格接近 bull case 下沿时的倍数压缩
trigger.en: multiple compression from ~23.4x EV/TTM Sales with price near the bull-case floor

latest.zh: 2026-07-31 估值重锚（非财报，仅价格）：2026-07-30 收盘 $485.39（较 2026-06-18 旧锚点 $537.37 跌约 9.7%）；市值约 $801B、EV 约 $792B，EV/TTM Sales 约 21.2x（旧口径约 23.4x）、EV/Forward Sales 约 15.8-17.3x、约 89x 年化 Q1 非 GAAP EPS、FCF 收益率约 1.3%。2026-08-04 Q2 业绩只作为事实监测纳入，尚未重算这些倍数、情景网格、立场或确信度；下一步是用当前价格进行完整估值复核。
latest.en: 2026-07-31 valuation re-anchor (price-only, not an earnings update): AMD closed at $485.39 on 2026-07-30 (about -9.7% from the old 2026-06-18 anchor of $537.37); market cap about $801B, EV about $792B, EV/TTM Sales about 21.2x (old caliber about 23.4x), EV/Forward Sales about 15.8-17.3x, about 89x annualized Q1 non-GAAP EPS, and FCF yield about 1.3%. The 2026-08-04 Q2 print is incorporated only as factual monitoring and these multiples, the scenario grid, stance, and conviction have not been recomputed; the next step is a full valuation review using a current price.

monitoring.nextCheck: Q2 后的完整估值复核 / full valuation re-adjudication after Q2

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $485.39、约 $7,920 亿 EV 和约 21.2x EV/TTM Sales 计，市场依然把 Meta/Helios、MI450、ROCm 改善、Data Center 增速和利润率扩张放进价格：按 Q1 Non-GAAP EPS 年化约 89x、即使按 FY2026 $6.00 仍约 81x、FCF 收益率仅约 1.3%。基准情景同意基本面变强，但这些证据仍不足以覆盖当前 multiple，预期差仍偏负。需要指出：倍数由 23.4x 降至 21.2x 完全来自股价下跌，并非升级触发条件所要求的“被收入分母消化”，因此不构成上调理由。
stanceRationale.en: At the $485.39 close on 2026-07-30, roughly $792B EV, and about 21.2x EV/TTM Sales, the market still prices Meta/Helios, MI450, ROCm improvement, Data Center growth, and margin expansion: annualized Q1 non-GAAP EPS is about 89x, about 81x even on $6.00 of FY2026 EPS, and the FCF yield is only about 1.3%. The base case agrees fundamentals are stronger, but that evidence still does not cover the current multiple, so the expectation gap stays negative. Note explicitly that the fall from 23.4x to 21.2x comes entirely from a lower share price and is not the absorption 'by the revenue denominator' the upgrade trigger requires, so it is not a reason to upgrade.

upgrade.zh: 若 2026H2 首个 1GW Meta deployment 按期出货并进入收入、Data Center 增速和 56%+ non-GAAP gross margin 同时兑现，ROCm/Helios 证明可重复客户迁移，且 EV/TTM Sales 从当前约 21.2x 被收入分母消化（股价下跌造成的倍数下降不算），则上调至 neutral-watch 或 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or constructive if the first 1GW Meta deployment ships on schedule in H2 2026 and enters revenue, Data Center growth and 56%+ non-GAAP gross margin both deliver, ROCm/Helios prove repeatable customer migration, and EV/TTM Sales is absorbed from the current roughly 21.2x by the revenue denominator (a multiple decline caused by a falling share price does not count).

downgrade.zh: 若 Meta 1GW 或 6GW 路径延期/缩小、Data Center 增速低于公司整体、ROCm 没有可审计迁移证据，或 custom ASIC/NVIDIA Rubin 压缩 AMD 的 rack-level 性价比窗口，则下调至 bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid if the Meta 1GW or 6GW path is delayed/reduced, Data Center growth falls below company-level growth, ROCm lacks auditable migration evidence, or custom ASICs / NVIDIA Rubin compress AMD's rack-level price-performance window.

title: 金盘科技深度研究报告 - AI电力设备的高估值兑现考验

summary: 2026-08-21 半年报监测更新：金盘科技 H1 2026 营收 35.56 亿元（同比 +12.73%）、归母净利 3.03 亿元（+14.23%）；数据中心收入 12.65 亿元（+122.57%）、期末在手订单 50.92 亿元，但 SST 仍仅披露样机与研发进展。同期经营现金流转为 -0.24 亿元，应收及合同资产较期初 +5.91%，回款质量尚不能判定，因此相关读数均为 unclear。估值没有重算；中性／观察、中确信仍沿用 2026-07-31 收盘 64.30 元的历史裁定。
highlights: 数据中心收入 12.65 亿元（+122.57%）、在手订单 50.92 亿元；SST 仅见样机与研发披露

估值未重算：中性/观察、中确信仍是 2026-07-31 收盘 64.30 元的历史裁定
summaryEn: August 21, 2026 H1 monitoring update: Jinpan reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 3.556B (+12.73% YoY) and parent net profit of RMB 303M (+14.23%). Data-center revenue reached RMB 1.265B (+122.57%) with RMB 5.092B of period-end backlog, while SST disclosure remains limited to prototypes and R&D progress. Operating cash flow turned negative at RMB 23.76M and receivables plus contract assets rose 5.91% from period start; collection quality therefore remains unestablished and both relevant readings are unclear. Valuation was not recomputed; neutral/watch, medium conviction remains the historical adjudication anchored to the July 31, 2026 close of RMB 64.30.

trigger.zh: AIDC、SST 与海外扩张的订单转化为确认收入
trigger.en: AIDC, SST, and overseas expansion convert into recognized revenue

latest.zh: 2026-08-21 披露的《2026 年半年度报告》（未经审计，报告期截至 2026-06-30）：数据中心新签订单 38.69 亿元（同比 +336.25%）、收入 12.65 亿元（+122.57%）、期末在手订单 50.92 亿元（+179.07%）；海外新签订单 41.90 亿元（+270.69%）、收入 14.81 亿元（+68.30%）、期末在手订单 62.39 亿元（+122.65%）。公司整体收入 35.56 亿元（+12.73%），在手订单 106.97 亿元（+41.87%）。评级：unclear。AIDC 与海外已有确认收入，但半年报对 SST 仅披露 10kV/2.4MW 样机完成设计生产、13.8kV 北美样机送测及研发投入，没有披露 SST 商业订单或确认收入；缺少披露不能推断为零。订单和在手订单是发行人口径，报告未披露交付排期、客户名称或可撤销条款，不能视为已确认收入或锁定产能；数据中心与海外口径可能重叠，不可相加。
latest.en: The 2026 Semi-Annual Report disclosed 2026-08-21 (unaudited, period ended 2026-06-30) reports data-center new orders of RMB 3.869B (+336.25% YoY), revenue of RMB 1.265B (+122.57%) and period-end backlog of RMB 5.092B (+179.07%); overseas new orders were RMB 4.190B (+270.69%), revenue RMB 1.481B (+68.30%) and backlog RMB 6.239B (+122.65%). Company-wide revenue was RMB 3.556B (+12.73%) and backlog RMB 10.697B (+41.87%). Reading: unclear. AIDC and overseas expansion produced recognized revenue, but the filing discloses only a completed 10kV/2.4MW SST prototype, a 13.8kV North America prototype sent for testing and R&D spending; it does not disclose SST commercial orders or recognized revenue, and absence of disclosure is not evidence of zero. Orders and backlog are issuer-defined, with no delivery schedule, named customers or cancellation terms, and the data-center and overseas categories may overlap.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 年三季度报告 / 2026 Q3 report

trigger.zh: 应收账款回款与经营现金流验证不达标
trigger.en: receivables collection and operating cash flow fail verification

latest.zh: 2026-08-21 披露的半年报：经营活动现金流净额为 -23,762,688.51 元，上年同期为 +234,788,194.63 元，同比 -110.12%；发行人称转负扩大了营运资金缺口并阶段性抬升资金调配压力。应收账款及合同资产为 33.62 亿元，较期初 +5.91%；合同负债 7.12 亿元（较上年末 +36.31%），货币资金 -34.62%，短期借款 +90.76%。评级：unclear。现金流验证不达标，但 +5.91% 是半年环比口径，不能与收入同比直接比较，且报告未披露应收周转天数，因此触发条件中的回款质量一侧尚不能判定；这不足以在没有完整当前估值和立场复核时落为 breached。
latest.en: The semi-annual report disclosed 2026-08-21 shows net operating cash flow of RMB -23.76M versus RMB +234.79M a year earlier, down 110.12%; the issuer says the swing widened its working-capital gap and temporarily raised funding-allocation pressure. Receivables plus contract assets were RMB 3.362B, up 5.91% from period start; contract liabilities were RMB 712M (+36.31% from year-end), cash fell 34.62% and short-term borrowings rose 90.76%. Reading: unclear. Cash-flow verification failed, but the 5.91% receivables measure is half-over-half and not comparable with revenue growth on a year-over-year basis, and no receivable-days figure is disclosed. The collection-quality half of the trigger is therefore unestablished, which is insufficient to record breached without a complete current valuation and stance review.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 年三季度报告的回款与经营现金流 / collections and operating cash flow in the 2026 Q3 report

trigger.zh: 增长不及预期时约 88x Q1 年化 P/E 压缩
trigger.en: the ~88x annualized-Q1 P/E compresses if growth disappoints

latest.zh: 历史估值快照（2026-07-31）：收盘 RMB 64.30、市值约 RMB 29.6B，按 Q1 年化口径 P/E 约 66x、P/S 约 4.9x。2026 H1 实际业绩已经取代 Q1 年化分母，但本次监测更新没有使用当前价格、最新股本和 H1 分母完成估值重建，因此不得把该倍数当作当前值，也不据此改变中性／观察、中确信立场。
latest.en: Historical valuation snapshot (2026-07-31): close RMB 64.30, market cap about RMB 29.6B, with a Q1-annualized P/E of about 66x and P/S of about 4.9x. Actual H1 2026 results now supersede the Q1-annualized denominator, but this monitoring update does not perform a current-price valuation rebuild using the latest share count and H1 denominator. The multiple must not be treated as current and does not change the neutral/watch, medium-conviction stance.

monitoring.nextCheck: 完整 H1 当前价格估值重建 / full H1 current-price valuation rebuild

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-31 收盘 64.30 元、约 296 亿元市值、Q1 年化约 66x P/E 和约 4.9x P/S 计，市场仍在为 AIDC/SST/海外扩张和 H 股融资改善预付成功率，但幅度较旧锚点明显下降：乐观情景的 350-400 亿元目标市值重新高出现价约 18-35%，悲观情景的 140-200 亿元跌幅收窄至约 -32%~-53%。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格仍显示基准情景接近市场隐含，且 SST 订单、应收回款与现金流转化三项验证一件未到，保持中性观察。
stanceRationale.en: At the RMB 64.30 close on 2026-07-31, roughly RMB 29.6B market cap, about 66x Q1-annualized P/E, and about 4.9x P/S, the market is still pre-paying for AIDC / SST / overseas expansion and H-share financing improvement, but much less than at the old anchor: the upside scenario's RMB 35-40B target sits about 18-35% above the current price again, and the downside scenario's RMB 14-20B narrows to about -32% to -53%. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid still leaves the base case close to market-implied expectations, and none of the three validations — SST orders, receivable collection, cash conversion — has arrived, so the stance remains neutral watch.

upgrade.zh: 若 2026 H1/H2 报告确认 AIDC 收入继续 100%+ 增长、SST 获得 10-15 亿元级可交付订单、应收周转降至 110 天以内且经营现金流/净利超过 80%，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to constructive if 2026 H1/H2 reports confirm AIDC revenue still growing 100%+, SST wins RMB 1.0-1.5B of deliverable orders, receivable days fall below 110, and operating cash flow / net profit exceeds 80%.

downgrade.zh: 若 AIDC 增速跌破 100%、SST 仍无大额订单、海外工厂延迟超过 6 个月、毛利率低于 24%，或应收账款继续快于收入增长，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to cautious if AIDC growth falls below 100%, SST still has no large orders, overseas plants slip more than 6 months, gross margin falls below 24%, or receivables keep growing faster than revenue.

titleEn: Oklo Deep Research Report - Pre-Commercial Nuclear Optionality Meets AI Power Demand
summary: 【2026-08-08 当前价格重新裁定：OKLO 于 2026-08-07 收于 $48.42；按 2026-08-04 在外流通股 186,017,650 股，股权价值约 $90.1 亿，扣除 $30.06 亿现金及有价债务证券并加回约 $0.7M 长期债务后，EV 约 $60.0 亿。相对约 $126 亿网格加权项目参考，算术仍有约 40% 正偏斜；但客户管线全为非约束性、2028 首堆与 2029 燃料交付存在时序张力、首堆资本成本未披露，维持看多 / 低确信。】Q2 10-Q 同时确认 Groves 同位素试验堆首次临界、Aurora-INL PDSA 获批、上半年 ATM 净募资 $18.52 亿；这些是技术与资金里程碑，不是商业供电或约束性合同。

stance改为偏多/低确信：偏多来自正偏斜，低确信来自零收入、无运行首堆和高执行风险

summaryEn: [2026-08-08 current-price re-adjudication: OKLO closed at $48.42 on 2026-08-07. Using 186,017,650 shares outstanding at 2026-08-04 gives about $9.01B equity value; subtracting $3.006B of cash and marketable debt securities and adding about $0.7M of long-term debt gives about $6.00B EV. Against the ~$12.6B grid-weighted project reference the arithmetic still has about 40% positive skew, but the customer pipeline remains entirely non-binding, the 2028 first-powerhouse target conflicts with a 2029 fuel-delivery start, and first-powerhouse capital cost is undisclosed, so constructive / low conviction holds.] The Q2 10-Q also confirms Groves isotope-test-reactor criticality, Aurora-INL PDSA approval, and $1.852B of first-half net ATM proceeds; these are technical and financing milestones, not commercial power or binding contracts.

previousAnnualReport.summaryEn: Archived pre-rerun 2026H1 baseline preserving the February pipeline, target-price, first-reactor, and zero-revenue valuation framework.

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-08-08 按当前价格完整复核。按 2026-08-07 收盘 $48.42 与 2026-08-04 在外流通股 186,017,650 股，股权价值约 $90.1 亿；扣除 $30.06 亿现金及有价债务证券并加回约 $0.7M 长期债务后，EV 约 $60.0 亿。相对约 $126 亿网格加权项目市值参考，算术仍有约 40% 正偏斜；但客户管线全为非约束性、2028 首堆与 2029 燃料交付有时序张力、首堆资本成本未披露，维持看多 / 低确信。
stanceRationale.en: Re-checked 2026-08-08 at the current price. At the 2026-08-07 close of $48.42 and 186,017,650 shares outstanding at 2026-08-04, equity value is about $9.01B; subtracting $3.006B of cash and marketable debt securities and adding about $0.7M of long-term debt gives about $6.00B EV. Against the ~$12.6B grid-weighted project-cap reference the arithmetic still has about 40% positive skew, but the customer pipeline is entirely non-binding, the 2028 first-powerhouse target conflicts with a 2029 fuel-delivery start, and first-powerhouse capital cost is undisclosed, so constructive / low conviction holds.

upgrade.zh: 只有当NRC许可、Idaho首堆执行、HALEU/燃料安排，以及至少一个Meta/Switch类型约束性客户结构同时推进，且没有以更差条款强制稀释融资时，才上调至bullish。
upgrade.en: Move to bullish only if NRC licensing, Idaho first-reactor execution, HALEU / fuel arrangements, and at least one Meta / Switch-type binding customer structure all advance together without forcing dilutive financing at worse terms.

downgrade.zh: 若NRC审查停滞、首堆成本或进度失控、燃料供应仍未解决、标杆客户下调承诺，或季度现金消耗/稀释在缺少里程碑的情况下上升，则下调至cautious或bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: Move to cautious or bearish-avoid if NRC review stalls, first-reactor cost or schedule breaks, fuel supply remains unresolved, a marquee customer reduces commitment, or quarterly cash burn / dilution rises without milestone progress.

trigger.zh: 许可里程碑推进或受阻 —— 首要验证点
trigger.en: licensing milestones advance or stall — the primary gate

latest.zh: 2026-08-07 提交的 Q2 2026 10-Q：里程碑推进，但路径需分清。首堆 Aurora-INL 走的是 **DOE** 授权而非 NRC 许可——DOE 已于 2026-06-11 批准其初步文件化安全分析（PDSA）。DOE 另于 2026-07-23 批准 Groves 同位素试验堆启动，该堆已于 2026-08-05 达到首次临界（DOE 反应堆试点计划下首个在私有土地上临界的反应堆），但它是同位素试验堆、不是 Aurora 电源堆。NRC 侧目前仅有：爱达荷放射化学实验室的材料许可，以及田纳西燃料回收设施的预申请阶段沟通。
latest.en: Q2 2026 Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-07: milestones advanced, but the pathways must be kept distinct. The first powerhouse, Aurora-INL, is being pursued under **DOE** authorization rather than NRC licensing — DOE approved its Preliminary Documented Safety Analysis on 2026-06-11. DOE separately granted startup authorization for the Groves Isotope Test Reactor on 2026-07-23, and Groves achieved first criticality on 2026-08-05 (the first reactor under the DOE Reactor Pilot Program to reach criticality on private land) — but Groves is a radioisotope test reactor, not an Aurora powerhouse. On the NRC side there is so far only a materials licence for the Idaho Radiochemistry Laboratory and pre-application engagement on the Tennessee fuel-recycling facility.

latest.zh: 2026-08-07 提交的 Q2 2026 10-Q 表述首堆部署目标为 **2028 年**，并自陈这是『雄心目标』，面临供应链、施工、宏观与设计等一系列复杂度；本报告下方关键数据表记录的旧目标为『2027 年底 - 2028 年初』，两者口径不一致，且 10-Q 未披露任何首堆资本成本数字。因此『成本超支』一腿完全未受检验，『时间线滑坡』一腿指向旧区间的偏晚端。
latest.en: The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-07 states a first-powerhouse deployment target of **2028**, self-described as an ambitious target set against a range of supply-chain, construction, macroeconomic and design complexities. The Quick Stats table below records the older target as late 2027 to early 2028, so the two calibres do not line up, and the 10-Q discloses no first-plant capital cost at all. The cost-overrun leg is therefore entirely untested, and the schedule leg points to the later end of the previously recorded range.

trigger.zh: 燃料获取安排不落地
trigger.en: fuel-supply arrangements fail to land

latest.zh: 2026-08-07 提交的 Q2 2026 10-Q：燃料安排在推进但未落地为约束性供应。与 Centrus 的**意向书**拟供应足以支持最多五台 Aurora 电源堆多年所需的国产 HALEU，**交付预计自 2029 年开始**，仍需谈判并签署正式供应协议，可能包含预付款，用于支持规划中的俄亥俄州南部 1.2GW 电力园区。另有 DOE 授予的 5 公吨 HALEU 燃料（自 INL 已辐照 EBR-II 燃料回收）用于爱达荷商用 Aurora；Aurora 燃料制造设施已获 DOE 多项安全审批并入选 DOE 燃料线试点计划（FLPP）。证据边界：2029 年起的交付晚于 2028 年首堆目标，且核心商业供应仍为非约束性意向书。
latest.en: Q2 2026 Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-07: fuel arrangements are advancing but have not landed as binding supply. The **letter of intent** with Centrus contemplates domestically produced HALEU sufficient for multiple years of fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses, with **deliveries expected to begin in 2029**, still subject to negotiation and execution of a definitive supply agreement, possibly including prepayments, in support of the planned 1.2-GW southern Ohio power campus. Separately, DOE awarded five metric tons of HALEU recovered from previously irradiated EBR-II fuel at INL for a commercial Aurora powerhouse in Idaho, and the Aurora Fuel Fabrication Facility has cleared several DOE safety approvals and was selected under the DOE Fuel Line Pilot Program. Evidence limits: a 2029 delivery start sits after the 2028 first-powerhouse target, and the core commercial supply is still a non-binding letter of intent.

latest.zh: 2026-08-07 提交的 Q2 2026 10-Q：管线仍为非约束性，未披露任何具约束力的 PPA 转化。10-Q 列示与 Equinix、Diamondback Energy、Prometheus Hyperscale 的**非约束性意向书**；国防创新单元代表空军部**初步选定** Oklo 为 Eielson 空军基地供电供热（规划至少 5 MWe）；另与 TVA 就新设施及未来售电进行评估。本监测项的触发条件为『需求转化为具约束力合同』，本季未满足。
latest.en: Q2 2026 Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-07: the pipeline remains non-binding and no binding PPA conversion was disclosed. The 10-Q lists **non-binding letters of intent** with Equinix, Diamondback Energy and Prometheus Hyperscale; a **tentative** selection by the Defense Innovation Unit on behalf of the Department of the Air Force for Eielson Air Force Base (an Aurora-derived powerhouse planned at at least 5 MWe); and an evaluation with TVA covering a new facility and potential future power sales. This item's trigger is demand converting into binding contracts, and that did not happen this quarter.

latest.zh: 2026-08-07 提交的 Q2 2026 10-Q：消耗与摊薄同时上升，但本季**有**已披露的里程碑进展（Groves 启动授权与首次临界、Aurora-INL PDSA 批准），故本项触发条件『在里程碑无进展的情况下上升』未满足。上半年：经营活动现金流出 $65,459K、净亏损 $81,601K、经营亏损 $124,166K、股权激励 $29,944K、累计亏损 $322,373K；Q2 单季净亏损 $48,536K、每股 $(0.28)。2026-06-30 现金、现金等价物与有价债务证券 $3,006,289K（约 $30.1 亿）。摊薄：上半年 ATM 合计发行 23,088,406 股，毛额 $1,880,239K、净额 $1,851,944K，平均净价 $81.44（2025 ATM 计划 12,376,352 股 @ $96.95；2026 ATM 计划 10,712,054 股 @ $63.51）；股本自 2025-12-31 的 160,514,103 股增至 2026-06-30 的 185,090,155 股，2026-08-04 为 186,017,650 股。口径提示：现金已远高于本报告关键数据表的『~$1.2B（Q3 2025）』与 2026-07-31 企业价值算式使用的『约 $22 亿』，该估值算术已被取代但本次未重算。
latest.en: Q2 2026 Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-07: burn and dilution both rose, but the quarter **did** carry disclosed milestone progress (Groves startup authorization and first criticality, Aurora-INL PDSA approval), so this item's trigger — a rise *without* milestone progress — was not met. First half: net cash used in operating activities $65,459K, net loss $81,601K, loss from operations $124,166K, stock-based compensation $29,944K, accumulated deficit $322,373K; Q2 alone had a net loss of $48,536K, or $(0.28) per share. Cash, cash equivalents and marketable debt securities were $3,006,289K (about $3.01B) at 2026-06-30. Dilution: 23,088,406 shares were issued under the ATM programs in the first half for $1,880,239K gross and $1,851,944K net at an average net price of $81.44 (2025 ATM Program 12,376,352 shares at $96.95; 2026 ATM Program 10,712,054 shares at $63.51); shares outstanding went from 160,514,103 at 2025-12-31 to 185,090,155 at 2026-06-30, and 186,017,650 as of 2026-08-04. Caliber note: cash is now far above both the Quick Stats line of about $1.2B (Q3 2025) and the about-$2.2B figure used in the 2026-07-31 enterprise-value arithmetic; that valuation arithmetic is superseded but was deliberately not recomputed here.

title: Broadcom 深度研究报告 - 自定义 AI 硅的卖铲人与 VMware 现金机器
titleEn: Broadcom Deep Research Report - The Pick-and-Shovel of Custom AI Silicon, Plus a VMware Cash Machine
summary: 自定义 AI 硅（XPU）最大的卖铲人，正是 NVIDIA 报告点名的最深结构性威胁的承接方；同时握有 VMware 软件现金机器。Q2 FY2026 营收 $22.19B（+48%），AI 半导体 $10.8B（+143%），AI backlog >$30B，FY2027 AI 目标 >$1000 亿；Google/Meta/字节/Anthropic/OpenAI/Fujitsu 等客户项目与 $73B backlog 属公开报道/市场拆解口径，非全部官方确认。但收入兑现后置到 FY2027、客户高度集中、总债务 $64.9B、净债务约 $45B。市值约 $1.84 万亿、远期 P/E 约 34x，介于 NVIDIA ~25x 与 AMD ~58x 之间。neutral-watch / 中等确信：世界级卖铲人，但 FY2027 分母大多已被定价。
summaryEn: The biggest pick-and-shovel of custom AI silicon (XPUs) - the very threat named in the NVIDIA report - plus a VMware software cash machine. Q2 FY2026 revenue $22.19B (+48%), AI semis $10.8B (+143%), AI backlog >$30B, FY2027 AI target >$100B; customer programs such as Google/Meta/ByteDance/Anthropic/OpenAI/Fujitsu and the $73B backlog are public-reporting / market-breakdown inputs, not all official confirmations. Delivery is back-loaded to FY2027, customers are concentrated, total debt is $64.9B and net debt is roughly $45B. Market cap ~$1.84T, forward P/E ~34x, between NVIDIA ~25x and AMD ~58x. Neutral-watch / medium conviction: a world-class pick-and-shovel, but the FY2027 denominator is mostly priced in.
highlights: FY2027 AI 半导体目标 >$1000 亿；公开报道涉及 Google/Meta/字节/Anthropic/OpenAI/Fujitsu 等 XPU 项目与 $73B backlog 估算——但兑现后置到 FY2027、客户高度集中，非全部为官方确认订单
两台引擎：AI 定制硅增长 + VMware 软件现金（非 GAAP 营业利润率 67%、FCF 占收入 46%）；总债务 $64.9B、Q2 期末现金 $19.63B，净债务约 $45B
neutral-watch / 中等确信：$387.84、约 24-25x EV/TTM sales 已定价通向 FY2027 >$100B AI 收入的顺利路径，等待更硬的 XPU 兑现和 backlog 转化证据

stanceRationale.zh: 在 $387.84、约 24-25x EV/TTM sales 上，市场已经定价了通向 FY2027 >$100B AI 半导体的顺利路径和持续的 VMware 现金质量；我们的基准情景同意方向，但保留交付滑坡、客户集中和债务调整后倍数压力。
stanceRationale.en: At $387.84 and roughly 24-25x EV/TTM sales, the market already prices a clean path toward >$100B FY2027 AI semis plus durable VMware cash; our base case agrees on direction but leaves room for delivery slippage, customer concentration, and debt-adjusted multiple pressure.

upgrade.zh: 若 Q3/Q4 AI 半导体收入和 backlog 转化确认通向 FY2027 >$100B AI 收入的路径、至少一个新增 XPU 客户获得官方确认、VMware 留存保持稳定，且 net debt/EBITDA 持续下降，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if Q3/Q4 AI semi revenue and backlog conversion confirm the path toward >$100B FY2027 AI revenue, at least one additional XPU customer is officially confirmed, VMware retention remains stable, and net debt/EBITDA keeps falling.

downgrade.zh: 若主要 XPU 客户滑坡或切换、AI backlog 停止扩张、VMware 流失显性化，或 FY2027 AI 收入可见度变弱时债务调整后的 EV 仍居高不下，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if a major XPU customer slips or switches, AI backlog stops expanding, VMware churn becomes visible, or debt-adjusted EV remains elevated while FY2027 AI revenue visibility weakens.

title: TSMC 深度研究报告 - AI 基建链的先进制程与封装公共约束
titleEn: TSMC Deep Research Report - The Advanced-Node and Packaging Constraint in AI Infrastructure
summary: AI 基础设施书 foundry 层补位：TSMC 是整条链最硬的制造瓶颈，而不是又一个芯片设计公司。2026Q2 收入 US$40.20B（同比 +33.7%）落在指引区间上沿，毛利率 67.7% 高于 65.5-67.5% 指引；2nm 首次贡献 3% wafer revenue、7nm 及以下占 77%，HPC 占收入 66%。管理层把全年收入增速展望上调至略高于 40%，并把 2026 capex 从原 $52-56B 区间上调至 $60-64B；Q3 指引 US$44.6-45.8B。2026-07-31 重新锚定：ADR $403.31（2026-07-30 收盘）、约 $2.09T 市值、约 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales，隐含收入 CAGR 要求降至约 17%，低于未变的 20-22% 基准情景，预期差转为温和正向，立场由中性观察上调为偏多 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Foundry-layer coverage for the AI-infrastructure book: TSMC is the hard manufacturing bottleneck in the chain, not another chip designer. Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B (+33.7% YoY), at the top of guidance, with gross margin of 67.7% above the 65.5-67.5% guide; 2nm contributed 3% of wafer revenue for the first time, 7nm-and-below reached 77%, and HPC was 66% of revenue. Management lifted full-year revenue growth to slightly above 40% and raised 2026 capex from the prior $52-56B range to $60-64B, while guiding Q3 revenue to US$44.6-45.8B. Re-anchored on 2026-07-31: the ADR closed at $403.31 on 2026-07-30, about $2.09T market cap and about 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales, cutting the implied revenue CAGR requirement to roughly 17% — below the unchanged 20-22% base case. The expectation gap turns modestly positive, so the stance moves from neutral watch to constructive / medium conviction.
highlights: foundry 层补位：TSMC 是 AI 基建链的制造公共约束，用先进制程、CoWoS/3DFabric、N3/N2 和客户排产验证 AI 需求是否真的穿透到上游制造瓶颈
2026Q2 收入 US$40.20B（同比 +33.7%）、毛利率 67.7%、营业利润率 60.3%；Q3 指引 US$44.6-45.8B，全年收入增速展望上调至略高于 40%
Q2 财报显示 HPC 占收入 66%（环比 +20%），7nm 及以下先进节点占 wafer revenue 77%、2nm 首次贡献 3%；2026 capex 从原 $52-56B 区间上调至 $60-64B
2026-07-30 收盘 ADR $403.31、市值约 $2.09T、约 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales，隐含要求约 17% 收入 CAGR，低于 20-22% 基准情景；立场上调为偏多 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 ADR 收盘 $403.31、约 $2.09T 市值和约 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales 计，代入本报告自身的反推公式（三年内向约 10x 正常化、要求回报 8%），隐含收入 CAGR 约 17%，低于旧锚点的约 21%。基准情景本身未变（2026 增速超 30%、2027-2028 约 20-22% CAGR、毛利率大体 60% 以上），因此由“与要求接近”转为“明显高于要求”，预期差转正。确信度保持中等：本次改善来自价格而非新的经营证据，月度收入与 Q3 确认才是进一步提升确信度的依据。
stanceRationale.en: At the $403.31 ADR close on 2026-07-30, about $2.09T market cap and about 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales, this report's own reverse-multiple formula (normalising toward about 10x over three years at an 8% required return) implies roughly 17% revenue CAGR, down from about 21% at the old anchor. The base case is unchanged (2026 growth above 30%, about 20-22% CAGR through 2028, gross margin mostly above 60%), so it moves from close to the requirement to clearly above it and the expectation gap turns positive. Conviction stays medium: the improvement is price-driven rather than evidence-driven, and monthly revenue plus Q3 confirmation are what would raise it further.

upgrade.zh: 如果月度收入、Q3 财报、N3/N2 mix 与 CoWoS 评论确认 base case 持续高于约 17% 的隐含 CAGR，同时毛利率维持 60%+ 且估值倍数没有重新扩张，则上调至 bullish。
upgrade.en: Move to bullish if monthly revenue, Q3 results, N3 / N2 mix, and CoWoS commentary confirm the base case is holding above the roughly 17% implied CAGR while gross margin remains above 60% and the valuation multiple does not re-expand.

downgrade.zh: 如果月度收入或 Q3 财报低于全年轨迹，或先进节点/封装紧张度缓解，则下调至 neutral-watch；如果海外 fab / N2 成本把结构性毛利率路径压到 60% 以下（打破溢价本身而非只是暂停），则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch if monthly revenue or Q3 results fall below the full-year trajectory or advanced-node / packaging tightness eases; move to cautious if overseas fab / N2 costs push the structural gross-margin path below 60%, which would break the premium rather than merely pause it.

latest.en: July 2026 monthly revenue (6-K filed 2026-08-10): consolidated net revenue was NT$467,580M, up 5.6% from June 2026 (NT$442,680M) and up 44.7% on July 2025 (NT$323,166M); January-July 2026 totalled NT$2,872,064M, up 37.0% year over year. The monthly release reports revenue only and carries no node mix, margin or customer detail. The most recent mix reading remains Q2 2026 (2026-07-16): revenue US$40.20B (+33.7% YoY) at the top of the $39.0-40.2B guidance range, 7nm-and-below at 77% of wafer revenue (74% in Q1), HPC up 20% QoQ to 66% of revenue, and Q3 guidance of US$44.6-45.8B. Graded against this item's own trigger, which asks whether 7nm-and-below mix or monthly revenue falls materially below the Q3 / full-year trajectory: July monthly revenue rose both sequentially and year over year, so neither branch fired.

title: Micron Technology 深度研究报告 - AI memory 周期的 HBM/DRAM/NAND 仪表盘
titleEn: Micron Technology Deep Research Report - HBM, DRAM, and NAND Dashboard for the AI Memory Cycle
summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：MU 于 2026-07-30 收于 $874.66，较 07-29 低点反弹 +18.4%、较原锚点 -10.3%，市值约 $987.9B；按所有者 Q1 裁定按当前价格复核，维持谨慎（中确信）——隐含可持续 EPS 约 $58-73 仍高于网格加权约 $53，负预期差收窄但仍成立。】AI 基础设施书 memory-storage 层补位：Micron 是 HBM、DDR5、数据中心 SSD 和长期供货协议共同构成的 AI 供给瓶颈仪表盘。FY2026 Q3 收入 $41.46B、毛利率约 84.6%、营业利润 $33.32B、净利润 $28.24B，Q4 指引收入 $49-51B、调整后 EPS $30-32、毛利率约 86%。HBM 产能公开报道显示已售罄至 2026，16 个战略客户协议中 14 个最低合同收入约 $100B、约 $22B 现金存款/承诺。2026-07-07 v5 更新：以 $975.56（2026-07-02 收盘，旧锚点）、市值约 $1.10T 计，20% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 30% 熊市情景网格给出温和负偏斜，判断改为谨慎 / 中确信。2026-07-09 官方公告最多 $3B 的美国供应链投入、拟向 GlobalWafers 融资 $500M 并签 10 年 300mm 原始硅片协议，强化长期供给响应证据，但不代表新增 bit supply 已上线，也不刷新 2026-07-02 估值快照。
summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: MU closed at $874.66 on 2026-07-30, +18.4% off the 07-29 low and -10.3% from its old anchor, for about $987.9B market cap; re-checked at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling, cautious (medium conviction) holds — implied sustainable EPS of ~$58-73 still exceeds the grid-weighted ~$53, a narrowed but intact negative gap.] Memory-storage coverage for the AI-infrastructure book: Micron is the dashboard for HBM, DDR5, data-center SSDs, and long-term supply agreements as AI supply constraints move into memory. FY2026 Q3 revenue was $41.46B, gross margin about 84.6%, operating income $33.32B, and net income $28.24B; Q4 guidance is $49-51B revenue, $30-32 adjusted EPS, and about 86% gross margin. Public reports say HBM capacity is sold out through 2026, and 14 of 16 strategic customer agreements have about $100B of minimum contract revenue plus roughly $22B deposits / commitments. July 7, 2026 v5 update: at $975.56 (Jul 2, 2026 close, old anchor) and about $1.10T market cap, a 20% bull / 50% base / 30% bear grid moves the stance to cautious / medium conviction. Micron's official 2026-07-09 release adds up to $3B of U.S. supply-chain investment, proposed $500M GlobalWafers financing, and a 10-year 300mm raw-wafer agreement; this strengthens long-term supply-response evidence without putting new bit supply online or refreshing the 2026-07-02 valuation snapshot.
highlights: memory-storage 层补位：MU 用 HBM sold-out、DRAM/NAND 价格、数据中心 SSD 和 SCA 长期协议校验 AI 需求是否穿透到 memory bit/带宽/价格
16 个 SCA 中 14 个最低合同收入约 $100B，约 $22B 存款/承诺；公开报道显示 HBM 产能售罄至 2026，且只能满足约 50%-66% 客户需求
按 $874.66（2026-07-30 收盘）：市值约 $987.9B、TTM P/E 约 19.7x（Q4 年化 run-rate 约 7.1x）；隐含可持续 EPS 约 $58-73 仍高于我们约 $53 的加权值，负偏斜收窄但未消失——维持谨慎 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定以当前价格复核。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $874.66（市值约 $987.9B、EV 约 $968.3B），TTM P/E 约 19.7x、Q4 年化 run-rate P/E 约 7.1x；12-15x 通周期框架隐含可持续 EPS 约 $58-73，仍高于网格加权的约 $53——"内存均值回归风险未被完全定价"的谨慎前提收窄但在当前价格下仍成立，维持谨慎/中确信，下一验证点 2026-09-23。
stanceRationale.en: Re-checked 2026-07-31 at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-07-30 close of $874.66 (about $987.9B cap, $968.3B EV), TTM P/E is about 19.7x and the Q4-annualized run-rate P/E about 7.1x; the 12-15x through-cycle frame implies about $58-73 of sustainable EPS, still above the grid-weighted ~$53 — the cautious premise (memory mean-reversion risk not fully priced) is narrower than at the old anchor but still true at the current price, so cautious / medium conviction holds; next test 2026-09-23.

note.en: Owner Q1 ruling re-check: at $874.66 implied sustainable EPS ($58-73) still exceeds the weighted ~$53; the gap narrowed but holds, cautious stays.

title: Constellation Energy 深度研究报告 - AI 电力约束的核电与 Calpine 综合电力锚
titleEn: Constellation Energy Deep Research Report - Nuclear and Calpine Integrated Power Anchor for AI
summary: 2026-08-07 监测更新：CEG Q2 GAAP EPS $1.42、调整后运营 EPS $2.55，并把 2026 全年调整后运营 EPS 指引上调至 $11.50-12.50。公司新增签署 920MW、15-20 年 PPA（2029-2032 年起供；价格与 hyperscaler 占比未披露），FERC/NRC 推进 Crane 重启审批，并拟以 $860M 出售 606MW Brazos Valley 电厂。2026-07-30 的价格、倍数与情景网格保留为明确历史快照，本次不重算估值或立场；中性观察/中确信暂维持，待债务、FCF 与新指引纳入完整估值后重新裁定。
highlights: Q2 调整后运营 EPS $2.55（上年 $1.91），全年调整后运营 EPS 指引上调至 $11.50-12.50
新增 920MW 长期 PPA，期限 15-20 年、2029-2032 年起供；仅沃尔玛 176MW 具名，价格与 hyperscaler 占比未披露
FERC 批准 Crane 并网容量权转移、NRC 批准燃料许可修订；2027 重启目标不变，监管里程碑不等于并网发电
拟以 $860M 出售 606MW Brazos Valley 电厂，尚待 DOJ 批准、预计年内完成
估值冻结在 2026-07-30 历史快照；中性观察/中确信待债务、FCF 与新指引的完整估值更新重新裁定
summaryEn: August 7, 2026 monitoring update: CEG reported Q2 GAAP EPS of $1.42 and adjusted operating EPS of $2.55, and raised full-year 2026 adjusted operating EPS guidance to $11.50-12.50. It signed 920 MW of additional 15-20 year PPAs starting in 2029-2032, without disclosing price or hyperscaler share; FERC and the NRC advanced Crane restart approvals; and it agreed to sell the 606 MW Brazos Valley plant for $860M. The 2026-07-30 price, multiples, and scenario grid remain an explicitly historical snapshot, with no valuation or stance recomputation here. Neutral-watch / medium conviction holds provisionally pending a complete valuation update incorporating debt, FCF, and the new guide.

latest.zh: 2026 Q2（2026-08-06 盘前发布）：公司披露新增签署 920MW 长期购电协议，期限 15-20 年，供电起始时间分布在 2029 至 2032 年，对手方仅描述为「一组多元化的投资级客户」；其中唯一具名的是 176MW 的沃尔玛协议，该协议将带动 Dresden 核电站 30MW 扩容。评级为读数不明：本项触发条件问的是 Microsoft/Meta 等超大规模厂商 PPA 的容量、价格与起始时间三项条款是否更清晰——容量与起始时间已披露，价格未披露，而本次唯一具名的对手方并非超大规模厂商，公司也未说明这 920MW 中是否包含超大规模厂商。按本项自身的触发条件无法评级。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (released before the open on 2026-08-06): the company disclosed an additional 920 MW of long-term power purchase agreements, 15-20 years in duration, with deliveries starting between 2029 and 2032, to counterparties described only as 'a diverse set of investment grade customers'; the sole named counterparty is a 176 MW agreement with Walmart, which will enable a 30 MW capacity expansion at the Dresden Clean Energy Center. Graded unclear: this item's trigger asks whether Microsoft/Meta and other hyperscaler PPAs gain clearer capacity, price and start-date terms - capacity and start dates were disclosed, price was not, the only named counterparty is not a hyperscaler, and the company did not say whether any of the 920 MW is hyperscaler volume. It cannot be graded against its own trigger.

latest.zh: 2026 Q2（2026-08-06）：FERC 批准了公司的豁免申请，允许将宾州 Eddystone 3、4 号双燃料机组的现有并网容量权（Capacity Interconnection Rights）转移至 Crane Clean Energy Center，公司称这一决定扫清了重启的关键监管障碍并预期可加快并网供电；NRC 亦批准了 Crane 的燃料许可修订申请。公司维持 2027 年重启目标。评级为阈内：本项触发条件的两个方向是加速或延误，本季度落在加速一侧，未出现审批、成本分摊或居民电价争议导致的延误。证据边界：这两项是监管里程碑，不等于重启完成或并网发电。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (2026-08-06): FERC approved the company's waiver request to transfer existing Capacity Interconnection Rights from the dual-fuel Eddystone Units 3 and 4 in Pennsylvania to the Crane Clean Energy Center, which the company describes as clearing a critical regulatory hurdle for the restart and expects to expedite delivery to the grid; the NRC separately approved a fuel license amendment request for Crane. latest.zh: Vistra 已于 2026-08-10 提交 2026 年第二季度 10-Q（报告期至 2026-06-30），补上了 2026-08-07 财报缺失的资产负债表。2026-06-30 与 2026-03-31 的资产负债表科目对比（两个日期均取自 Vistra 的 10-Q）：含一年内到期部分的长期债务 $19,595M 对 $19,163M；未摊销溢价、折价与发行费用前的长期债务 $19,764M 对 $19,332M；短期借款 $0 对 $0；应收账款融资 $300M 对 $750M；一年内到期的远期回购义务 $613M 对 $641M；现金及现金等价物 $435M 对 $634M。上述类债务科目减去现金后，2026-06-30 合计 $20,073M，2026-03-31 合计 $19,920M，环比上升约 0.8%。上半年经营活动产生的现金为 $2,222M，2025 年上半年为 $1,171M；含核燃料采购与 LTSA 预付款的资本开支为 $1,572M，去年同期 $1,458M。严格对照本监测项自身的触发条件：类债务净额环比仅上升约 0.8%，持续经营调整后 EBITDA 同比增长逾 30%（Q2 为 $1,767M），上半年经营现金流亦同比接近翻倍；合并来看，本次披露没有显示负向分支所要求的显著杠杆或 FCF 压力。这里不是正式的净债务/EBITDA 环比计算：Vistra 并未列示“净债务”小计，EBITDA 对比口径也是同比而非环比；本报告的估值框架未变，也不因本次读数而重述。Cogentrix 收购尚未交割，触发条件中的这一腿仍未被检验，其对价亦未体现在本张资产负债表上。上半年偿还长期债务 $3,859M 含再融资，并非净债务变动。
latest.en: Vistra filed its Q2 2026 10-Q on 2026-08-10 (period ended 2026-06-30), supplying the balance sheet the 2026-08-07 release lacked. Balance-sheet lines at 2026-06-30 against 2026-03-31, both taken from Vistra 10-Q filings: long-term debt including amounts due currently $19,595M vs $19,163M; long-term debt before unamortized premiums, discounts and issuance costs $19,764M vs $19,332M; short-term borrowings $0 vs $0; accounts receivable financing $300M vs $750M; forward repurchase obligation due currently $613M vs $641M; cash and cash equivalents $435M vs $634M. Those debt-like lines less cash total $20,073M at 2026-06-30 against $19,920M at 2026-03-31, up about 0.8% quarter over quarter. First-half cash provided by operating activities was $2,222M against $1,171M in H1 2025, with capital expenditures including nuclear fuel purchases and LTSA prepayments of $1,572M against $1,458M. Graded against this item's trigger: debt-like obligations net of cash rose only about 0.8%, while Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA rose more than 30% year over year ($1,767M in Q2) and first-half operating cash flow nearly doubled year over year; taken together, the filing does not show the meaningful leverage or FCF pressure required by the negative branch. This is not a formal quarter-over-quarter net-debt/EBITDA calculation: Vistra presents no "net debt" subtotal, and the EBITDA comparison is year over year rather than quarter over quarter. The report's valuation frame is unchanged. The Cogentrix acquisition has not closed, so that leg of the trigger remains untested and none of its consideration appears on this balance sheet. First-half repayments of long-term debt of $3,859M include refinancing and are not a net-debt movement.

downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid if Cogentrix is delayed or synergies miss, Meta PPA economics disappoint, PJM/Texas capacity premiums fade, or net-debt / FCF pressure rises from capex, buybacks, fuel, or regulation.

benchmarkRationale.zh: power 层默认基准是 XLU（公用事业）。Quanta 不是公用事业公司——它没有费率基数、没有受监管回报，它的经济由在手订单、技术工人和施工利润率决定，用 XLU 计分等于在问『一家承包商有没有跑赢受监管公用事业』，与本报告的任何一句判断都不相干。实测的差距是决定性的：截至 2026-07-31，PWR 与 XLU 的日收益率相关系数在最近 252 个交易日仅 0.279、504 个交易日 0.337，而与 PAVE（Global X 美国基础设施建设 ETF）分别为 0.635 与 0.654，与 XLI 为 0.598 与 0.603；PAVE 在两个窗口上都优于 XLI，且主题上更贴近『把基础设施建起来的那批公司』。本报告的核心论点正是关于建设与并网这道工序，检验它需要一个自带施工景气 beta 的基准。代价必须写明，而且有两条：其一，PWR 本身就是 PAVE 的前三大持仓（第三方持仓数据给出的权重在 3.7-4.2% 之间且彼此不一致），因此 PWR 自身的波动会带动基准、压缩测得的超额收益；其二，2026 年初至今 PWR +56.0% 而 PAVE 仅 +17.6%，说明基准对今年这轮行情几乎没有解释力，0.635 的相关性仍留下约六成方差无法解释——PAVE 还混入了铁路、骨料、钢铁与机械，跑赢 PAVE 并不能单独证明电网 EPC 的论点。即便如此，与一个相关性只有 0.28 的公用事业指数相比，这仍是明显更诚实的计分尺。PAVE 不是本报告的 priceSymbol，未触发自基准禁令。
benchmarkRationale.en: The power layer default is XLU (utilities). Quanta is not a utility - it has no rate base and no regulated return, and its economics are backlog, craft labour and construction margin - so scoring against XLU asks 'did a contractor beat regulated utilities', which bears on no judgment in this report. The measured gap is decisive: to 2026-07-31, PWR's daily-return correlation is only 0.279 over the trailing 252 sessions and 0.337 over 504 against XLU, versus 0.635 and 0.654 against PAVE (the Global X U.S. Infrastructure Development ETF) and 0.598 and 0.603 against XLI. PAVE beats XLI on both windows and is the closer thematic match to 'the companies that physically build infrastructure'. This report's core claim is precisely about the build-and-connect step, and testing it requires a benchmark that carries construction-cycle beta. The cost is stated plainly, and it has two parts. First, PWR is itself a top-three PAVE holding (third-party holdings aggregators put the weight somewhere between 3.7% and 4.2% and disagree with each other), so part of any PWR move is transmitted into the benchmark and mutes measured alpha. Second, PWR is +56.0% year-to-date in 2026 against PAVE's +17.6%, so the benchmark explains almost none of this year's move, and a 0.635 correlation still leaves roughly 60% of variance unexplained - PAVE also bundles rails, aggregates, steel and machinery, so beating PAVE does not by itself validate the grid-EPC thesis. Even so, it is a markedly more honest yardstick than a utilities index correlated 0.28. PAVE is not this report's own priceSymbol, so the self-benchmark ban is not engaged.

title: Quanta Services 深度研究报告 - 建设与并网这一层是否卡住了 AI 数据中心通电
titleEn: Quanta Services Deep Research Report - Does the Build-and-Connect Layer Gate AI Data-Center Power?
summary: AI 基础设施书 power 层的公共约束初始覆盖：该层已有八篇报告，全部关于谁拥有电子或谁造设备，没有一篇覆盖真正把线路架起来、把变电站装好、把场地通上电的那一层。本报告提供这份读数，答案有一部分是否定的：按 2026 年披露，施工劳动力并不是绑定约束——Quanta 在收入同比 +41.2%（2026 Q2 95.57 亿美元）的同时把电力分部营业利润率从 10.1% 提到 11.5%，并在五个月内把全年收入指引从 332.5-337.5 亿美元上调到 393-397 亿美元（+17.9%，其中约 47 亿美元为内生）。绑定约束不长这样。真正指向瓶颈的是 Quanta 自己的资本配置：同一季度以 12.4 亿美元买下 Percheron（路权与许可）、Enerfab（制造加工）、PSD（可移动式变电站）与 Phalcon（数据中心电气），另设 800 kV 断路器合资公司——钱流向前端与长交期硬件。同样重要的是一个否定结论：Quanta 自 2025 Q1 起只报两个分部（可再生能源已并入电力）、不披露数据中心收入、且大量数据中心工作接单即开票从不进入在手订单，因此本书无法把 PWR 当作 AI 需求温度计。公司层面：总在手订单 534.4 亿美元（+49.1%）、12 个月 323.1 亿美元（+61.2%），且增长的是硬的那部分——剩余履约义务 +75.1%，占比由 53.5% 升至 62.8%；上半年自由现金流 10.704 亿美元高于 GAAP 净利润 6.720 亿美元；商誉加无形资产 110.850 亿美元超过股东权益 96.379 亿美元。以 2026-07-30 收盘 657.98 美元为锚（业绩后单日 +17.3%、年初至今 +56.0%），市值约 989 亿美元，按截至 2026-06-30 追溯十二个月约 74.6x 报告盈利、48.5x 调整后净利润、30.2x 企业价值/调整后 EBITDA；按 2026 年指引 39.4x 调整后每股收益、56.4x GAAP 每股收益，而同行只有 15.7-24.7x。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's power layer. The layer already holds eight reports and every one is about who owns electrons or who makes equipment; none covers the tier that physically builds the line, sets the substation and energises the site. This report supplies that reading, and part of the answer is negative: on 2026 disclosure, construction labour is not the binding constraint. Quanta grew revenue 41.2% year over year (Q2 2026 revenue of US$9.56B) while expanding Electric-segment operating margin from 10.1% to 11.5%, and raised its full-year revenue guide from US$33.25-33.75B to US$39.3-39.7B in five months (+17.9%, of which roughly US$4.7B is organic). A binding constraint does not behave that way. What does point at a bottleneck is Quanta's own capital allocation: US$1.24B in one quarter for Percheron (right-of-way and permitting), Enerfab (fabrication), PSD (transportable substations) and Phalcon (data-centre electrical), plus an 800 kV circuit-breaker joint venture - the money is going to the front end and to long-lead hardware. A second, equally important finding is negative: Quanta has reported only two segments since Q1 2025 (Renewable Energy was folded into Electric), discloses no data-centre revenue, and books and bills much data-centre work without it ever entering backlog, so this book cannot use PWR as an AI-demand thermometer. At the company level, total backlog is US$53.44B (+49.1%) and 12-month backlog US$32.31B (+61.2%), and the firm component is what grew - remaining performance obligations +75.1%, rising from 53.5% to 62.8% of backlog; H1 free cash flow of US$1,070.4M exceeds GAAP net income of US$672.0M; goodwill plus intangibles of US$11,085.0M exceed equity of US$9,637.9M. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of US$657.98 (+17.3% on the day of the print, +56.0% year-to-date), market cap is about US$98.9B at roughly 74.6x trailing reported earnings, 48.5x trailing adjusted net income and 30.2x EV/trailing adjusted EBITDA on the twelve months ended 2026-06-30, and 39.4x guided 2026 adjusted EPS against 56.4x guided GAAP EPS, versus listed peers at 15.7-24.7x. A 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid opens the initiation at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: 并网约束检验的答案是否定的：施工劳动力不卡 AI 数据中心通电——收入 +41.2% 的同时电力分部利润率从 10.1% 升到 11.5%，全年收入指引五个月内上调 17.9%
Quanta 自己的资本配置指向前端：单季 12.4 亿美元买路权与许可（Percheron）、制造加工（Enerfab）、可移动式变电站（PSD）与数据中心电气（Phalcon），另建 800 kV 断路器合资厂
本书不能把 PWR 当 AI 温度计：自 2025 Q1 只报两个分部（可再生能源已并入电力）、无数据中心收入披露、大量数据中心工作接单即开票不进在手订单
在手订单变硬而非变软：总额 534.4 亿美元（+49.1%）、12 个月 323.1 亿美元（+61.2%），剩余履约义务 +75.1% 且占比由 53.5% 升至 62.8%
股价 657.98 美元（2026-07-30 收盘、业绩后单日 +17.3%）：追溯十二个月约 74.6x 报告盈利 / 48.5x 调整后净利润 / 30.2x 企业价值-调整后 EBITDA，2026 年指引 39.4x 调整后 EPS vs 56.4x GAAP EPS，同行 15.7-24.7x；30/40/30 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

metric.zh: 在手订单的硬/软构成：剩余履约义务相对主服务协议预估订单
metric.en: Backlog composition: remaining performance obligations versus estimated MSA orders

trigger.zh: 剩余履约义务增速落后于主服务协议预估订单，或其占总在手订单比重从 62.8% 回落至约 55%
trigger.en: remaining performance obligations grow more slowly than estimated MSA orders, or the RPO share of total backlog falls from 62.8% back toward about 55%

latest.zh: 2026-06-30：总在手订单 534.4 亿美元（同比 +49.1%），12 个月 323.1 亿美元（+61.2%）；其中剩余履约义务 335.5 亿美元同比 +75.1%，主服务协议预估订单 198.9 亿美元仅 +19.2%，硬订单占比由一年前的 53.5% 升至 62.8%。　评级为阈内：本项发布的触发条件是硬订单增速落后于软订单，或其占比回落至约 55%，两者均未发生——硬的那部分增速是软的部分的近四倍。
latest.en: At 2026-06-30 total backlog was US$53.44B (+49.1% y/y) and 12-month backlog US$32.31B (+61.2%). Within that, remaining performance obligations of US$33.55B grew 75.1% while estimated MSA and short-term orders of US$19.89B grew 19.2%, lifting the firm share of backlog from 53.5% a year earlier to 62.8%. Graded within: this item's published trigger is RPO growing more slowly than MSA estimates, or the RPO share falling toward 55% - neither happened, and the firm component grew nearly four times as fast as the soft one.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 业绩的在手订单对账表（2026 年 10 月下旬）/ the Q3 2026 backlog reconciliation table, late October 2026

metric.zh: 技术工人余量：电力分部营业利润率与收入增速的组合
metric.en: Craft-labour headroom: Electric segment operating margin against revenue growth

trigger.zh: 电力分部营业利润率在追溯四个季度口径上压缩至 10% 以下，同时收入增速放缓；或管理层指引受劳动力限制的交付
trigger.en: the Electric segment's operating margin compresses below 10% on a trailing-four-quarter basis while revenue growth decelerates, or management guides to labour-constrained delivery

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 电力分部收入 78.378 亿美元（同比 +43.6%）、营业利润率 11.5%（去年同期 10.1%）；上半年 143.065 亿美元、10.2%（去年 9.2%）。地下与基础设施同期由 6.9% 升至 9.1%，全年收入指引同时被上调 17.9%。　评级为阈内：本项发布的触发条件是利润率压缩至 10% 以下且增速放缓，或管理层指引受劳动力限制——实际是利润率扩张、增速加快、指引上调，三者都与触发条件相反。需注意管理层关于四年学徒周期的说法意味着 2030 年产能由今天的招聘决定，因此本项近端为阈内并不排除远端绑定。
latest.en: Q2 2026 Electric revenue was US$7,837.8M (+43.6% y/y) at an 11.5% operating margin against 10.1% a year earlier; H1 revenue was US$14,306.5M at 10.2% against 9.2%. Underground and Infrastructure moved from 6.9% to 9.1% over the same comparison, and the full-year revenue guide was raised 17.9%. Graded within: this item's published trigger is margin compressing below 10% alongside decelerating growth, or management guiding to labour-constrained delivery - what happened is margin expansion, faster growth and a raised guide, the opposite of all three. Note that management's own roughly four-year apprenticeship framing means 2030 capacity is set by today's hiring, so a near-term within reading does not rule out a later binding constraint.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 分部利润率与收入增速（2026 年 10 月下旬）/ Q3 2026 segment margin and revenue growth, late October 2026

metric.zh: 指引上调中内生与并购贡献的分解
metric.en: The organic-versus-acquired split of any guidance raise

trigger.zh: 某次指引上调中公司自己给出的并购贡献占多数，或公司不再对并购贡献给出规模
trigger.en: the company-sized acquisition contribution is a majority of a guidance raise, or the company stops sizing the acquisition contribution at all

latest.zh: 2026-07-30 的上调把收入指引中值从 2 月的 335 亿美元抬到 395 亿美元（+60 亿）；公司自己把 Phalcon、Enerfab、Percheron、PSD 四笔并购的 2026 年贡献规模化为收入 12-14 亿美元、调整后 EBITDA 1.20-1.40 亿美元，因此约 47 亿美元（约 78%）归于既有业务。　评级为阈内：并购贡献是少数而非多数，且公司仍在给出规模。但需明确，Quanta 不公布内生增长率，上述 47 亿美元是本报告的推导而非披露——这正是本项存在的原因。
latest.en: The 2026-07-30 raise lifted the revenue guide midpoint from February's US$33.5B to US$39.5B (+US$6.0B), and the company itself sizes the FY2026 contribution of Phalcon, Enerfab, Percheron and PSD at US$1.2-1.4B of revenue and US$120-140M of adjusted EBITDA, leaving roughly US$4.7B (about 78%) attributable to the existing business. Graded within: the acquired contribution is a minority of the raise and the company is still sizing it. Note explicitly that Quanta publishes no organic growth rate, so the US$4.7B is this report's derivation rather than a disclosure - which is precisely why this item exists.

monitoring.nextCheck: 下一次指引变动及其并购贡献口径（2026 年 10 月下旬）/ the next guidance change and its acquisition-contribution disclosure, late October 2026

metric.zh: 数据中心 / 科技终端市场的收入归因披露
metric.en: Disclosure of data-centre and technology end-market revenue attribution

trigger.zh: Quanta 开始把科技/负荷中心收入或在手订单单列，或披露单一客户占收入 10% 以上；在此之前，本书对 PWR 的任何 AI 归因都无法证伪
trigger.en: Quanta begins disclosing technology or load-centre revenue or backlog as a separate line, or discloses a customer above 10% of revenue; absent that, any AI attribution to PWR in this book stays unfalsifiable

latest.zh: 截至 2026 Q2：Quanta 自 2025 Q1 起只报两个分部（电力、地下与基础设施），可再生能源基础设施解决方案分部已并入电力且历史期间重述；无数据中心或科技终端市场收入披露；无 10% 以上客户披露；管理层并表示大量数据中心工作接单即开票、从不进入在手订单。　评级为读数不明而非阈内或已触发：本项的触发条件是某项披露出现，而该披露没有出现——这既不能确认也不能否定 AI 归因，而记录这个状态正是本项的意义。
latest.en: As of Q2 2026, Quanta reports two segments (Electric, and Underground and Infrastructure); the Renewable Energy Infrastructure Solutions segment was folded into Electric from Q1 2025 with prior periods recast; there is no data-centre or technology end-market revenue disclosure and no customer disclosed above 10%; and management states that much data-centre work is booked and billed without entering backlog. Graded unclear rather than within or breached: this item's trigger is the appearance of a disclosure, and that disclosure has not appeared - which neither confirms nor refutes an AI attribution, and recording that state is the point of the item.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 年 Form 10-K 的分部与客户集中度披露（2027 年 2 月）/ segment and customer-concentration disclosure in the FY2026 Form 10-K, February 2027

metric.zh: 自由现金流对 GAAP 净利润，以及商誉加无形资产对股东权益
metric.en: Free cash flow against GAAP net income, and goodwill plus intangibles against equity

trigger.zh: 自由现金流连续两个半年度低于 GAAP 净利润，或商誉加无形资产超出股东权益 30% 以上
trigger.en: free cash flow falls below GAAP net income for two consecutive half-years, or goodwill plus intangibles exceed equity by more than 30%

latest.zh: 2026 上半年：经营现金流 14.872 亿美元、净资本开支 4.168 亿美元、自由现金流 10.704 亿美元，高于同期 GAAP 净利润 6.720 亿美元；2026-06-30 商誉 78.689 亿加其他无形资产 32.161 亿 = 110.850 亿美元，为股东权益 96.379 亿美元的约 115%（即超出 15%）。　评级为阈内：两条触发条件——连续两个半年度现金流低于净利润、无形资产超出权益 30% 以上——都未达到。但超出 15% 已意味着有形账面权益为负约 14.5 亿美元，距第二条触发线并不遥远。
latest.en: For H1 2026, operating cash flow was US$1,487.2M and net capital expenditures US$416.8M, giving free cash flow of US$1,070.4M against GAAP net income of US$672.0M. At 2026-06-30, goodwill of US$7,868.9M plus other intangibles of US$3,216.1M totalled US$11,085.0M, about 115% of the US$9,637.9M of stockholders' equity - an excess of 15%. Graded within: neither published clause is met - free cash flow exceeds net income rather than trailing it, and the intangible excess is 15% rather than above 30%. But the 15% excess already means tangible book equity is roughly negative US$1.45B, so the second clause is not far away.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 现金流量表与资产负债表（2026 年 10 月下旬）/ the Q3 2026 cash-flow statement and balance sheet, late October 2026

metric.zh: 2027 年指引相对 2030 年调整后每股收益目标的持久性
metric.en: Guidance durability: FY2027 guidance against the 2030 adjusted-EPS target

trigger.zh: 2027 年初始指引隐含的调整后每股收益增速低于十几个百分点的中段，或 2030 年目标未被重申
trigger.en: initial FY2027 guidance implies adjusted-EPS growth below the mid-teens, or the 2030 target is not reaffirmed

latest.zh: 2026 年调整后每股收益指引中值 16.70 美元，较 2025 年实际 10.75 美元 +55.3%；投资者日报道的 2030 年目标为 21.60-26.75 美元（第三方报道，该活动未报送 Form 8-K），据此从 2026 年指引起算的隐含年复合增速仅 6.6%-12.5%，低于目标搭建时所依据的 15-20%。　本项暂不评级：2027 年初始指引要到 2027 年 2 月才发布，触发条件的两条都还不可观察，初始覆盖也没有可比对象。
latest.en: The FY2026 adjusted-EPS guide midpoint of US$16.70 is +55.3% over the FY2025 actual of US$10.75. The Investor Day 2030 target reported by third parties is US$21.60-26.75 (no Form 8-K was furnished for the event), which from the 2026 guide implies a CAGR of only 6.6-12.5%, below the 15-20% the target was built on. Left ungraded: initial FY2027 guidance is not due until February 2027, so neither clause of the trigger is observable yet and an initiation has nothing to compare against.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 全年业绩与 2027 财年初始指引（2027 年 2 月）/ FY2026 results and initial FY2027 guidance, February 2027

stanceRationale.zh: 以 657.98 美元（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市场已经把这次业绩完整定价进去——单日 +17.3%、年初至今 +56.0%。经营证据是全书里最强的一档：总在手订单 534.4 亿美元且增长的是硬的那部分（剩余履约义务 +75.1%、占比 53.5% → 62.8%），电力与地下两个分部利润率同时扩张，上半年自由现金流 10.704 亿美元高于 GAAP 净利润 6.720 亿美元，杠杆 1.6x 且穆迪上调至 Baa2。因此『谨慎』是不诚实的——这里没有下行尾部。但倍数也不允许偏多：约 74.6x 追溯报告盈利、48.5x 追溯调整后净利润、30.2x 企业价值/追溯调整后 EBITDA；2026 年指引 39.4x 调整后每股收益，而同一份指引的 GAAP 口径是 56.4x，两者 43.2% 的差额正是制造增长的那些并购所产生的摊销与股权激励；做重叠业务的上市同行只有 15.7-24.7x 前瞻。30/40/30 网格在概率上对称、在幅度上刻意不对称，这本身就是结论：下行分支不是经营塌陷，而是在业务完好前提下倍数向同行压缩，仅此一项算术上约 −40%；上行分支要求盈利长进一个已经是全板块最高的倍数里。确信度定为中而非高，是因为本报告为本书而存在的那个 AI 归因问题，从 Quanta 的备案文件中根本无法回答——两个分部、无数据中心收入行、大量工作不进在手订单。
stanceRationale.en: At US$657.98 (2026-07-30 close) the market has already priced the print in full - up 17.3% on the day and 56.0% year-to-date. The operating evidence is among the strongest in this book: total backlog of US$53.44B in which the firm component is what grew (remaining performance obligations +75.1%, rising from 53.5% to 62.8% of backlog), margin expansion in both segments, H1 free cash flow of US$1,070.4M against GAAP net income of US$672.0M, leverage at 1.6x and a Moody's upgrade to Baa2. Cautious would therefore be dishonest - there is no downside tail here. But the multiple does not permit constructive either: about 74.6x trailing reported earnings, 48.5x trailing adjusted net income and 30.2x EV to trailing adjusted EBITDA, and 39.4x guided 2026 adjusted EPS against 56.4x the GAAP version of the same guidance - a 43.2% gap that is precisely the amortisation and stock compensation created by the acquisitions that manufacture the growth - while listed peers doing overlapping work sit at 15.7-24.7x forward. The 30/40/30 grid is symmetric in probability and deliberately asymmetric in magnitude, and that is the finding: the bear branch is not an operating collapse but a multiple compression toward peers on an intact business, worth roughly -40% arithmetically, while the bull branch requires earnings to grow into the highest multiple in the sector. Conviction is medium rather than high because the AI-attribution question this report exists to answer for the book is simply unanswerable from Quanta's filings - two segments, no data-centre revenue line, and much of the work never entering backlog.

upgrade.zh: 2027 年初始指引隐含调整后每股收益继续 20%+ 增长且电力分部营业利润率守在 11% 以上，创纪录的剩余履约义务在没有重大项目减值的情况下转化，剩余履约义务占总在手订单比重守在 60% 以上，且进一步指引上调中内生部分仍占多数，则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Upgrade to constructive if initial FY2027 guidance implies continued 20%+ adjusted-EPS growth with the Electric segment holding an 11%+ operating margin, the record remaining performance obligations convert without a material project charge, the RPO share of total backlog holds above 60%, and the organic component remains the majority of any further guidance raise.

downgrade.zh: 电力分部出现重大项目减值或利润率回吐、2027 年指引隐含调整后每股收益增速低于十几个百分点的中段、硬性剩余履约义务占在手订单比重回落至约 55%、并购成为某次指引上调的主要来源，或自由现金流连续两个半年度低于 GAAP 净利润而商誉与无形资产相对股东权益继续上升，则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: Downgrade to cautious on a material project charge or margin reversal in the Electric segment, FY2027 guidance implying sub-mid-teens adjusted-EPS growth, the firm RPO share of backlog falling back toward 55%, acquisitions becoming the majority of a guidance raise, or free cash flow falling below GAAP net income for two consecutive half-years while goodwill and intangibles keep rising against equity.

title: Alphabet 深度研究报告 - TPU 外部化与 capex 融资质量的架构校验
titleEn: Alphabet Deep Research Report - Architecture Check on TPU Externalization and Capex Funding Quality
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的架构校验初始覆盖：本层已有两篇公共约束（Microsoft、Meta）和一篇仪表盘（Oracle），Alphabet 承担只有它能做的买方架构检验——全球最大自研芯片项目开始向第三方出售 TPU 系统，使它同时是商用芯片的前二大客户和竞争者。2026 Q2（季度截至 2026-06-30、07-22 发布）：收入 $119.796B（+24%）、Google Cloud +82% 至 $24.768B 且分部利润率 20.7%→35.6%、Search 及其他 +17%、合并经营利润率 34.0%、收入积压 $519.5B（Cloud $513.9B）。10-Q 首次写明 Cloud 产品收入主要来自 TPU 系统销售，存货半年由 $2.439B 升至 $9.991B。但同一季度自由现金流为 −$5.855B、回购连续两季为 $0（$69.5B 授权未动用）、6 月增发股权净额 $49.6B、股本 12,088M→12,230M，FY2026 capex 指引上调至 $195-205B、2027 年将显著更高。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $333.68 为锚（财报次日 07-23 单日 −6.9%），市值约 $4.081T、约 9.2x TTM 收入、约 26.7x EV/TTM 经营利润、约 73.9x EV/TTM 自由现金流；追溯 GAAP 市盈率约 16.7x 不可用，因 Q2 每股 $9.11 中 $6.26 来自权益证券估值变动，清洗后至少约 29.7x。30% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 20% 熊市网格读出轻度正偏度但建立在预测之上，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial architecture-check coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer. The layer already carries two common-constraint reports (Microsoft, Meta) and one dashboard (Oracle); Alphabet takes the buyer-side architecture test only it can run - the largest own-silicon program in the world has begun selling TPU systems to third parties, making it simultaneously a top-two merchant-silicon customer and a merchant-silicon competitor. Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported 07-22): revenue $119.796B (+24%), Google Cloud +82% to $24.768B with segment margin going from 20.7% to 35.6%, Search and other +17%, consolidated operating margin 34.0%, revenue backlog $519.5B (Google Cloud $513.9B). The 10-Q states for the first time that Cloud product revenue comes primarily from TPU system sales, and inventory rose from $2.439B to $9.991B in six months. The same quarter produced free cash flow of -$5.855B, a second straight quarter of $0 buybacks (with $69.5B of authorization unused), a $49.6B net equity raise in June, share count rising from 12,088M to 12,230M, and an FY2026 capex guide raised to $195-205B with 2027 to be significantly higher. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of $333.68 (the stock fell 6.9% on 07-23, the session after the print), market cap is ~$4.081T at ~9.2x TTM revenue, ~26.7x EV/TTM operating income and ~73.9x EV/TTM free cash flow; the ~16.7x trailing GAAP P/E is unusable because $6.26 of Q2's $9.11 EPS came from equity-securities marks, leaving at least ~29.7x on cleaned earnings. The 30% bull / 50% base / 20% bear grid shows a mild positive skew that rests on forecasts, so the initiation opens at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: demand-risk 层架构校验：TPU 外部化对阵商用芯片，与供给侧 broadcom-2026 配对形成双向检验
TPU 成为财务对象：10-Q 写明 Cloud 产品收入主要来自 TPU 系统销售，存货半年 $2.439B→$9.991B，现有协议绝大部分收入指引在 2027 年
融资结构反转：Q2 自由现金流 −$5.855B、上半年回购 $0（$69.5B 授权未动用）、6 月增发净额 $49.6B、股本 12,088M→12,230M
股价 $333.68（2026-07-30 收盘、财报次日 −6.9%）：约 9.2x TTM 收入、约 73.9x EV/TTM 自由现金流；30/50/20 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

latest.en: The 10-Q states for the first time that Google Cloud product revenue comes primarily from TPU system sales; inventory rose from $2.439B at 2025-12-31 to $9.991B at 2026-06-30 and is defined as primarily hardware related to TPU systems for sale to enterprise customers and devices; the call said deliveries into customer data centers began this quarter with a small amount recognized, the vast majority of existing agreements landing in 2027, and TPU sales sitting inside the $513.9B Cloud backlog; no TPU unit volume or revenue line is disclosed

monitoring.nextCheck: FY2026 10-K 的 TPU 系统披露与 2027 年季度 Cloud 产品收入 / FY2026 10-K TPU system disclosure and 2027 quarterly Cloud product revenue

trigger.en: Consolidated operating margin falls below ~30%, or Cloud segment margin retraces below ~25%, with depreciation and datacenter operating costs cited as the driver

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 物业与设备折旧 $7.104B，仅为同期 capex $44.924B 的 15.8%；净物业与设备半年内自 $246.597B 升至 $321.212B；合并经营利润率 34.0%、Cloud 35.6%；管理层在电话会上称基建投入将继续以更高折旧与数据中心运营成本的形式压制损益表，且 Q3 租用第三方产能会带来温和的利润率压力
