metric.zh: 广告技术救济与 Search 上诉结果
metric.en: Ad-tech remedy and Search appeal outcome

trigger.zh: 弗吉尼亚东区判决结构性救济（剥离发布方广告技术）并在上诉后维持，或哥伦比亚特区巡回法院扩大 2025 年 12 月的 Search 救济范围
trigger.en: The Eastern District of Virginia orders a structural remedy (divestiture of publisher-side ad tech) that survives appeal, or the D.C. Circuit expands the December 2025 Search remedies

latest.zh: 广告技术案自 2025 年 11 月结案陈词后终审判决仍未作出，DOJ 的方案包含 10-Q 自述可能对业务产生重大不利影响的结构性救济；Search 案 2025 年 12 月终审为行为性救济，Google 于 2026 年 1 月上诉、DOJ 与各州于 2026 年 2 月上诉，口头辩论预计 2026 年底至 2027 年初；直接被指向的 Google Network 为 2026 Q2 收入的 6% 且在收缩；短期计提法律与监管罚款及和解 $17.4B
latest.en: The ad-tech case has been awaiting final judgment since November 2025 closing arguments, with the DOJ proposing structural remedies that the 10-Q itself says could have a material adverse effect on the business; the Search case ended in behavioural remedies in December 2025, Google appealed in January 2026 and the DOJ and state AGs in February 2026, with argument expected late 2026 or early 2027; Google Network, the most directly implicated line, was 6% of Q2 2026 revenue and shrinking; short-term accrued legal and regulatory fines and settlements were $17.4B

monitoring.nextCheck: 弗吉尼亚东区终审判决与哥伦比亚特区巡回法院口头辩论（事件驱动）/ EDVA final judgment and D.C. Circuit argument (event-driven)

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $333.68（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市场在财报次日把 Alphabet 下调了 6.9%，股价较 5 月 13 日 $398.80 的收盘高点低约 16.3%——与 Microsoft 同期 +15.5% 的跳涨恰好相反。但折价本身不等于机会：约 9.2x TTM 收入、约 26.7x EV/TTM 经营利润、约 73.9x EV/TTM 自由现金流、以及清洗后至少约 29.7x 追溯盈利，仍假设自由现金流低谷是浅而暂时的。30% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 20% 熊市网格的算术偏度轻度正向，但正向的一侧依赖 2027 年尚不可验证的事件（TPU 收入确认、自由现金流转正），负向的一侧已经印在 2026 上半年的现金流量表上（自由现金流转负、回购归零、增发 $49.6B、股本上升），因此以中性观察而非偏多开局。
stanceRationale.en: At $333.68 (2026-07-30 close) the market marked Alphabet down 6.9% on the session after the print, leaving it ~16.3% below the 2026-05-13 closing high of $398.80 - the mirror image of Microsoft's +15.5% pop over the same weeks. The de-rating is not by itself an opportunity: ~9.2x TTM revenue, ~26.7x EV/TTM operating income, ~73.9x EV/TTM free cash flow, and at least ~29.7x cleaned trailing earnings still assume the free-cash-flow trough is shallow and temporary. The 30% bull / 50% base / 20% bear grid carries a mild positive arithmetic skew, but the positive side depends on 2027 events nobody can yet verify (TPU revenue recognition, FCF turning positive) while the negative side is already printed on the H1 2026 cash-flow statement (FCF negative, buybacks at zero, $49.6B of equity issued, share count rising) - so the initiation opens at neutral-watch rather than constructive.

upgrade.zh: 季度自由现金流在 2027 年转正且 TTM 自由现金流重新扩张、Cloud 维持 50% 以上增长且 backlog 按期转化、TPU 外部收入按指引在 2027 年确认并在 Cloud 产品收入中变得可见、回购恢复且无进一步股权发行、且合并经营利润率在折旧爬坡时保持 32% 以上，则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Quarterly free cash flow turns positive during 2027 with TTM FCF re-expanding, Cloud holds above 50% growth with backlog converting on schedule, external TPU revenue recognizes in 2027 as guided and becomes visible in Cloud product revenue, buybacks resume without further equity issuance, and consolidated operating margin stays above 32% as depreciation ramps - upgrade to constructive.

downgrade.zh: TTM 自由现金流转负、或 Alphabet 动用 $40B ATM 计划或进一步增发股权、Cloud 增速跌破约 40% 且 backlog 转化滑期、合并经营利润率随折旧浪潮落地跌破约 30%、TPU 外部收入滑出 2027 年、或结构性广告技术救济被判决，则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: TTM free cash flow turns negative, or Alphabet draws the $40B ATM or issues further equity, Cloud growth decelerates below ~40% while backlog conversion slips, consolidated operating margin falls below ~30% as the depreciation wave lands, external TPU revenue slips out of 2027, or a structural ad-tech remedy is ordered - downgrade to cautious.

title: Microsoft 深度研究报告 - Azure AI 收入与 capex 吸收的需求锚
titleEn: Microsoft Deep Research Report - Demand Anchor for Azure AI Revenue vs Capex Absorption
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的需求锚初始覆盖：Microsoft 是全球最大 AI capex 买方，本书此前给 GPU/HBM/电力稀缺性打分却没有覆盖这些开支落地的资产负债表。FY2026 Q4（季度截至 2026-06-30，07-29 发布）：收入 $90.007B（+18%）、Azure 及其他云 +43% 加速、FY2026 Azure 收入首破 $100B（+41%）、商业 RPO $678B（+84%）、Q4 含融资租赁 capex $41B（+69%）、FY2026 经营现金流 $182.9B、现金 capex $115.9B、FCF 约 $67B——demand 层最强的 capex 吸收答卷。风险同样清晰：2026 年 1 月披露的 $625B RPO 中约 45% 系于 OpenAI；FY2027 Q1 capex 指引超 $50B；数据中心/办公楼寿命 15→25 年重分类把日历 2026 capex 框架由约 $190B 改列约 $175B。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $451.10 为锚（财报后单日 +15.5%），市值约 $3.35T、约 25.1x 追溯 GAAP EPS、约 10.1x FY2026 收入、约 49x EV/FY2026 FCF。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格读出略偏负到中性的预期差，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial demand-anchor coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer: Microsoft is the largest AI-capex buyer in the world, and until now the book scored GPU/HBM/power scarcity without covering the balance sheet that spending lands on. FY2026 Q4 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported 07-29): revenue $90.007B (+18%), Azure and other cloud +43% and accelerating, FY2026 Azure revenue above $100B for the first time (+41%), commercial RPO $678B (+84%), Q4 capex incl. finance leases $41B (+69%), FY2026 operating cash flow $182.9B against $115.9B cash capex leaving ~$67B FCF - the strongest capex-absorption print in the demand layer. The risks are equally clear: ~45% of the $625B RPO disclosed in January 2026 was tied to OpenAI; FY2027 Q1 capex is guided above $50B; and the 15-to-25-year useful-life reclassification moved the calendar-2026 capex frame from ~$190B to ~$175B. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of $451.10 (+15.5% on the post-earnings session), market cap is ~$3.35T at ~25.1x trailing GAAP EPS, ~10.1x FY2026 revenue, and ~49x EV/FY2026 FCF. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid reads a slightly negative-to-neutral expectation gap; the initiation opens at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: demand-risk 层需求锚：全球最大 AI capex 买方首次入册；核心读数是 Azure AI 收入 vs capex 吸收
FY2026 Q4 收入 $90.007B（+18%）、Azure +43% 加速、FY2026 Azure 收入首破 $100B、商业 RPO $678B（+84%）
吸收已被证明：FY2026 经营现金流 $182.9B、现金 capex $115.9B、FCF 约 $67B、营业利润率 46.8% 扩张、净现金约 $36.5B
风险集中：1 月披露 $625B RPO 中约 45% 系于 OpenAI；FY2027 Q1 capex 指引超 $50B；寿命 15→25 年重分类美化后续折旧口径
股价 $451.10（2026-07-30 收盘、财报后单日 +15.5%）：约 25.1x 追溯 GAAP、约 49x EV/FY2026 FCF；30/40/30 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

highlights: demand-risk 层需求锚：Meta 是 AI 基建链最大终端买方之一，决定 GPU、HBM、网络、光连接、电力、设施和 neocloud 需求是否真实

summaryEn: July 30, 2026 monitoring update (Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026): revenue was $60.80B (+28% YoY), operating income $18.775B, operating margin 31% (down from 43%), net income $15.848B (-14%), and diluted EPS $6.18; total costs were $42.026B (+55%). Operating cash flow was $31.862B (+25%), but $31.078B of capex compressed free cash flow to $0.784B (-91%); FY2026 capex guidance narrowed to $130-145B. Application-monetization is a mixed read: revenue and operating cash flow grew, while operating margin, net income, and FCF deteriorated. Demand-anchor coverage for this center's AI-infrastructure demand-risk layer: Meta is not a GPU/HBM/power/optical supplier, but one of the most important end customers in the chain. Re-anchored on 2026-07-31 to the $539.03 close of 2026-07-30: market cap is about $1.37T and EV about $1.41T, or about 6.4x TTM sales, 15.9x EV/TTM operating income, and 18.4x annualized Q1 EPS ex-tax-benefit (21.8x on annualized Q2 reported EPS). The multiple is less demanding than at the old anchor, so the stance is held at neutral-watch / medium conviction on current-price arithmetic; note the TTM window is Q2'25-Q1'26 and excludes Q2 2026, whose FCF and margin deterioration bears on the skew and is carried to a post-Q2 re-underwrite.

title: Oracle 深度研究报告 - AI 云 RPO 仪表盘与资本开支融资压力
titleEn: Oracle Deep Research Report - AI Cloud RPO Dashboard and Capex Financing Pressure
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的 RPO/backlog 仪表盘：Oracle 正从成熟数据库/企业软件公司变成高资本强度 AI 云基础设施平台。FY2026 Q4 收入 $19.18B(+21%)、OCI 收入 $5.8B(+93%)、RPO 达 $638B(+363%)，需求读数极强；但 FY2026 capex $55.66B、自由现金流 -$23.69B、FY2027 capex 指引可达 $90-95B，且公司需要约 $40B 债务+股权融资。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $127.56 计，市值约 $367B、净债务约 $124.30B、企业价值约 $492B，对应约 7.3x TTM EV/Sales 和约 21.9x EV/TTM 营业利润。20% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 40% 熊市情景网格仍给出偏负预期差，立场维持谨慎 / 中确信；关键不是订单多不多，而是 RPO 能否按期转化为高回报现金流。
summaryEn: The RPO/backlog dashboard for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer: Oracle is changing from a mature database and enterprise-software company into a capital-intensive AI-cloud infrastructure platform. FY2026 Q4 revenue was $19.18B (+21%), OCI revenue was $5.8B (+93%), and RPO reached $638B (+363%), making the demand readout very strong. But FY2026 capex was $55.66B, free cash flow was -$23.69B, FY2027 capex could reach $90-95B, and the company expects roughly $40B of debt and equity financing. At the $127.56 close on Jul 30, 2026, roughly $367B market cap, about $124.30B net debt, and about $492B enterprise value, ORCL trades at about 7.3x TTM EV/Sales and about 21.9x EV/TTM operating income. The 20% bull / 40% base / 40% bear grid still leaves a negative expectation gap, so the stance stays cautious / medium conviction: the question is not whether orders are large, but whether RPO converts into high-return cash flow on schedule.
highlights: demand-risk 层的 RPO/backlog 仪表盘：FY2026 Q4 RPO $638B(+363%，环比 +$85B)，OCI 收入 $5.8B(+93%)，验证 AI 云需求是否穿透到订单簿
现金流和融资压力同样极端：FY2026 capex $55.66B、FCF -$23.69B；FY2027 capex 指引 $90-95B，另需约 $40B 债务+股权融资，含 $20B ATM 股权发行

核心监控不是『订单多不多』，而是 RPO 转化、客户集中、OCI 毛利/ROIC、capex 是否按时变成可售 capacity，以及融资是否伤害股东
2026-07-31 重新裁定：按 2026-07-30 收盘重算后 20% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 40% 熊市网格仍偏负，立场维持谨慎 / 中确信

latest.zh: 2026-08-19 提交、最早事项日期 2026-08-18 的 Form 8-K（事项 1.01/3.02/9.01）：Marvell 披露已于 2026 年 7 月 29 日与 Google LLC 就为其开发定制半导体产品（Custom Products）签署商业协议，8-K 表述该扩大后的合作『涵盖依附于 TPU 生态的一整套定制硅项目』，列举 AI 推理加速器、存储控制器、网络接口控制器、内存接口控制器与近内存计算；并于 2026-08-18 向 Google 发行至多 58,970,907 股、行权价 $206.58 的权证，其中 1,360,867 股按季在首年等额解锁，其余按 Google 及其关联方自 FY2027 Q3 至 FY2033 结束期间的『可自由裁量』采购分 240 个等额档位解锁，每 5 亿美元 Custom Products 收入解锁一档。评级：unclear。本项触发条件是一个合取——『FY2027 数据中心收入逐季加速』**且**『AWS / Microsoft / 其他 hyperscaler 项目放量』。8-K 为第二个合取项补上了一个具名的新增 hyperscaler 项目（此前 §2 只能依据公开报道提及 Google），但**未披露任何收入、订单或采购承诺金额**，解锁所依附的采购被发行人自身定性为『可自由裁量』，因而不构成放量证据；第一个合取项在 2026-08-27 的 FY2027 Q2 财报前没有任何新证据。此前口径（公开报道框定 FY2027/FY2028 约 $11.5B / $16.5B 收入展望）保留待该次财报检验。
latest.en: Form 8-K filed 2026-08-19, date of earliest event reported 2026-08-18 (Items 1.01/3.02/9.01): Marvell disclosed that it and Google LLC entered into a commercial agreement on July 29, 2026 relating to the company's development of custom semiconductor products ('Custom Products') for Google, described in the 8-K as spanning 'a comprehensive range of custom silicon programs that attach to the TPU ecosystem,' naming AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, network interface controllers, memory interface controllers and near-memory compute; and that on 2026-08-18 it issued Google a warrant over up to 58,970,907 shares at a $206.58 exercise price, of which 1,360,867 shares vest in equal quarterly installments over the first year and the remainder vest on 'discretionary' purchases by or on behalf of Google and its affiliates from FY2027 Q3 through the end of FY2033, in 240 equal tranches, one per US$500 million of Custom Products revenue. Reading: unclear. This item's trigger is a conjunction — FY2027 data-center revenue accelerating each quarter **and** AWS / Microsoft / additional hyperscaler programs ramping. The 8-K supplies the second conjunct with a named additional hyperscaler program (§2 previously cited Google only from public reports), but it **discloses no revenue, order or purchase-commitment amount**, and the purchases the tranches attach to are characterised by the issuer itself as 'discretionary', so they are not ramp evidence. The first conjunct has no new evidence before the FY2027 Q2 print on 2026-08-27. The prior caliber — public reports framing an FY2027 / FY2028 outlook around $11.5B / $16.5B — is retained pending that print.

latest.zh: FY2026 Form 10-K（2026-08-14 提交，财年截至 2026-06-30）：10-K 将 2026-03-02 协议描述为非排他性，含数十亿美元级采购承诺与未来产能访问权，并记载另行进行的 $2B NVIDIA 投资系普通股私募配售，所得款项用于研发、未来产能与运营——属股权而非客户预付款。对照本项自身触发条件（承诺转化为 backlog、收入与产能预付款）：文件全文未披露任何经营性 backlog，也未披露可归属于该协议的产能预付款；合并合同负债 2026-06-30 为 $63M，上年度合计 $72M（由已披露的其他应计负债 $63M 加其他负债 $9M 推导，与现金流量表 -$9,307 千美元变动相互印证）。fiscal 2026 有两家客户各自贡献超过 10% 的收入，但 10-K 未指名，收入无法归属。评级为 unclear。证据边界：合同负债为合并口径，其下降不能证明不存在 NVIDIA 预付款（其他客户余额可抵销）；且截至财年末协议仅约四个月，文件本身把相关权利描述为未来权利。本次并未断言承诺未能转化——这是证据不足评级，缺的是归属与 backlog 披露。
latest.en: FY2026 Form 10-K (filed 2026-08-14, fiscal year ended 2026-06-30): the 10-K describes the 2026-03-02 agreement as non-exclusive, carrying a multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment together with future access and capacity rights, and records the separate $2B NVIDIA investment as a private placement of common stock whose proceeds support R&D, future capacity and operations — equity, not a customer prepayment. Graded against this item's own trigger, which asks whether commitments convert into backlog, revenue and capacity prepayments: the filing discloses no operational backlog anywhere, and no capacity prepayment attributable to the agreement. Consolidated contract liabilities were $63M at 2026-06-30; the prior-year total of $72M is derived from the two disclosed components ($63M within other accrued liabilities plus $9M within other liabilities) and reconciles to the cash-flow statement's -$9,307 thousand change. Two customers each contributed more than 10% of revenue in fiscal 2026, but the 10-K does not name them, so no revenue is attributable. The reading is unclear. Evidence limits: contract liabilities are a consolidated line, so a decline does not establish that no NVIDIA prepayment exists because other customers' balances can offset it, and the agreement was roughly four months old at fiscal year-end against rights the filing itself describes as future. Non-conversion is not asserted — this is an evidence-insufficiency grade, and what is missing is the attribution and the backlog disclosure.

latest.zh: FY2026 Form 10-K（2026-08-14 提交）首次按 2025-07-01 起采用的双分部结构披露分部利润：Datacenter & Communications 收入 $5,275M（+40%），分部利润 $1,330M（+47%，上财年 $904M）；Industrial 收入 $1,844M（-10%），分部利润 $423M（+4%，上财年 $407M）。据此计算 Datacenter & Communications 分部利润率约 25.2%，上年同期约 24.1%（依公司披露数字计算，两年均按重述后口径列示，定义上可比）。对照本项自身触发条件——数据中心通信收入持续增长且不稀释毛利率——两个分支均成立，维持 within。此前（2026-08-12 新闻稿）读数：第四财季 Datacenter & Communications 收入 $1,615.0M，环比 +18.6%、同比 +58.6%，全财年 $5,274.6M 对上财年 $3,755.2M；合并收入 $2,045.5M，GAAP 毛利率 38.5%（环比 +82bps、同比 +277bps），全财年 GAAP 毛利率 37.5%（+233bps）；FY2027 Q1 指引收入 $2.2-2.4B、non-GAAP 毛利率 39.5%-41.5%。证据边界：分部利润是公司自定义口径，不含股份薪酬、并购与整合费用、无形资产摊销与减值、重组费用及未分摊的公司层面研发／市场／管理费用，位置在毛利率之下，因此它只在分部利润这一行确认未稀释；公司仍不公布分部毛利率，毛利率本身的未稀释结论仍只在合并口径成立。该扩张同时伴随 Industrial 收入由 $511.1M 降至 $430.5M。
latest.en: FY2026 Form 10-K (filed 2026-08-14) discloses segment profit for the first time under the two-segment structure adopted 2025-07-01: Datacenter & Communications revenue $5,275M (+40%) with segment profit $1,330M (+47%) against $904M; Industrial revenue $1,844M (-10%) with segment profit $423M (+4%) against $407M. On those disclosed figures the Datacenter & Communications segment profit margin is about 25.2% against about 24.1% a year earlier — computed from the company's own numbers, both years stated on the recast two-segment basis, so definitionally matched. Graded against this item's own trigger — datacenter communications revenue keeps growing without diluting gross margin — both legs hold and the reading stays within. The prior reading, from the 2026-08-12 release, remains current: FY26 Q4 Datacenter & Communications revenue was $1,615.0M, up 18.6% sequentially and 58.6% year over year, with the full year at $5,274.6M against $3,755.2M; consolidated revenue was $2,045.5M at a 38.5% GAAP gross margin (+82bps sequentially, +277bps year over year) and full-year GAAP gross margin of 37.5% (+233bps); FY2027 Q1 guidance is $2.2-2.4B at a 39.5-41.5% non-GAAP gross margin. Evidence limits: segment profit is a company-defined measure excluding share-based compensation, acquisition and integration costs, intangible amortization and impairment, restructuring, and unallocated corporate R&D, marketing and G&A, and it sits below the gross-margin line, so it confirms non-dilution at the segment profit line only; the company still publishes no segment gross margin, so on gross margin proper the no-dilution leg remains established at consolidated level only. That expansion also coincided with Industrial revenue falling to $430.5M from $511.1M.

latest.zh: FY2026 全年业绩（2026-08-12）：新闻稿 Table 4 仅披露全财年现金流、未披露单季——FY2026 经营活动净现金流入 $79.5M（上财年 $633.6M），购置物业、厂房及设备 $1,102.9M（上财年 $440.8M）。沿用前一读数的“经营现金流减资本开支”口径，FY2026 自由现金流约为 -$1,023.4M，上财年约为 +$192.8M；由于未披露单季拆分，前一读数中 FY26 Q3 的 -$383M 仅在全年层面被取代。读数维持 unclear，但理由已改变：本触发条件为合取——增长依赖负自由现金流、存货／应收堆积或资本开支扩张，且倍数维持在高位——其第一个分支现已明确成立；但用以检验第二个分支的已发布倍数（约 7.4x P/S TTM、约 7.5x EV/TTM sales，均锚定 2026-07-30 收盘 $249.06）是以截至 FY26 Q3 的 TTM 为分母计算的，而本次财报正是取代该分母的事件。因此当前不存在可供检验第二分支的有效倍数，而重建倍数属于完整估值重锚，不在本次纯监测更新的授权范围内。该点已作为提案写入本次运行回执，未予应用。此处未改变任何估值、立场或确信度。
latest.en: FY2026 full-year results (2026-08-12): Table 4 of the release discloses full-year cash flows only and no quarterly split — net cash provided by operating activities was $79.5M against $633.6M in FY2025, and additions to property, plant and equipment were $1,102.9M against $440.8M. On the operating-cash-flow-less-capex convention used in the prior reading, FY2026 free cash flow was approximately -$1,023.4M against approximately +$192.8M in FY2025; because no quarterly split is published, the -$383M FY26 Q3 figure in the prior reading is superseded at the full-year level only. The reading stays unclear but the reason has changed. The trigger is conjunctive — growth relies on negative FCF, inventory or receivable build, or capex expansion, while the multiple stays elevated — and its first clause is now decisively satisfied. The published multiple against which the second clause would be tested (about 7.4x P/S on a trailing-twelve-month basis and about 7.5x EV/TTM sales, both anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of $249.06) was computed on a TTM ending FY26 Q3, which is precisely the denominator this print superseded. There is therefore no currently valid multiple against which the second clause can be evaluated, and rebuilding one would be a complete valuation re-anchor outside the scope of this monitoring-only update. It is filed as a proposal in the run receipt and is not applied. No valuation, stance or conviction is changed here.

title: Digital Realty 深度研究报告 - AI 数据中心租赁与互联需求仪表盘
titleEn: Digital Realty Deep Research Report - Leasing and Interconnection Dashboard for AI Data Centers
summary: AI 基础设施 datacenter-facility 层的租赁/互联需求校验。DLR 不直接解释 GPU、光模块或电力设备，而是验证 AI 数据中心需求是否转化为真实租约、backlog、互联节点和开发容量。2026Q2 财报（2026-07-23）：Core FFO/share（ex net promote）$2.13、cash renewal spread +25.4%；公司签下 $307M 年化 GAAP base rent 的 bookings（100% share）/ $208M（DLR share），其中 0-1MW + interconnection 贡献 $108M、占 DLR-share bookings 的 52%；季度末 signed-but-not-commenced backlog 为 record $1.9B（100% share）/ $1.4B（DLR share），但后者含约 $380M 收购相关增量，不能全部解释为本季有机签约；新签租约加权平均开租滞后从 19 个月收窄至 9 个月，future-development capacity 升至约 9GW。管理层把 2026 Core FFO/share（ex net promote）指引从 $8.00-8.10 上修至 $8.15-8.20。2026-07-31 完成此前推迟的当前价格估值复核：以 2026-07-30 收盘 $193.19 计，市值约 $69.1B、EV 约 $84.7B，对照上修后指引约 23.6x P/Core FFO、约 13.3x EV/TTM revenue，隐含要求升至约 18.3% Core FFO/share CAGR，高于中双位数的牛市情景。经营证据依然强劲，但股价跑在前面，立场由偏多调整为 neutral-watch / 中确信。
highlights: 补齐 datacenter-facility 层租赁校验：DLR 把上游 chip/neocloud/buildout 叙事接到真实租约、backlog、cross-connects 和开发容量
2026Q2（2026-07-23）Core FFO/share（ex net promote）$2.13、cash renewal spread +25.4%；2026 Core FFO/share 指引上修至 $8.15-8.20（ex net promote，Q1 为 $8.00-8.10）
Q2 bookings $307M（100% share）/$208M（DLR share），环比低于 Q1；0-1MW + interconnection $108M、占 DLR-share bookings 的 52%；backlog $1.9B/$1.4B，但 DLR-share 口径含约 $380M 收购相关增量，开租滞后收窄至 9 个月
2026-07-30 收盘 $193.19、市值约 $69.1B、EV 约 $84.7B、约 23.6x P/Core FFO，隐含要求约 18.3% Core FFO/share CAGR；需求仍强但股价已跑在基本面前面，立场下调为 neutral-watch
summaryEn: Leasing and interconnection demand check for the AI-infrastructure data-center facility layer. DLR does not directly explain GPUs, optical modules or power equipment; it tests whether AI data-center demand converts into real leases, backlog, interconnection nodes and development capacity. Q2 2026 results (July 23, 2026): Core FFO/share (excluding net promote) was $2.13 and cash renewal spreads were +25.4%. The company signed $307M of annualized GAAP base-rent bookings at 100% share, or $208M at DLR share, including $108M from 0-1MW plus interconnection, or 52% of DLR-share bookings. Signed-but-not-commenced backlog was a record $1.9B at 100% share and $1.4B at DLR share, but the latter included about $380M of acquisition-related incremental backlog and cannot be read entirely as organic quarterly leasing; the weighted-average commencement lag narrowed from 19 months to nine months and future-development capacity rose to about 9GW. Management raised 2026 Core FFO/share (excluding net promote) guidance to $8.15-8.20. The 2026-07-31 pass completed the deferred current-price valuation review: at the $193.19 close on 2026-07-30, market cap is about $69.1B and EV about $84.7B, or about 23.6x P/Core FFO and 13.3x EV/TTM revenue on the raised guide, lifting the implied requirement to roughly 18.3% Core FFO/share CAGR — above the mid-teens bull case. Operating evidence remains strong but the share price has run ahead of it, so the stance moves from constructive to neutral-watch / medium conviction.

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $193.19、市值约 $69.1B 与上修后的 $8.15-8.20 Core FFO/share 指引计，约 23.6x P/Core FFO 代入本报告自身的反推公式（三年内向约 18x 正常化、要求回报 8%），隐含要求约 18.3% Core FFO/share CAGR，高于旧框架的约 14%，也高于中双位数的牛市情景与 Q2 实际 +13.9% 的兑现速度。Q2 经营证据（0-1MW/interconnection 创纪录、renewal spread +25.4%、开租滞后收窄至 9 个月）依然强劲且在改善，因此不下调至谨慎；但价格上涨 11.5% 而指引仅上修约 1.6%，仅重定价一项就把要求推到情景集合之外，偏多不再成立。
stanceRationale.en: At the $193.19 close on 2026-07-30, about $69.1B market cap and the raised $8.15-8.20 Core FFO/share guide, about 23.6x P/Core FFO feeds this report's own reverse-multiple formula (normalising toward about 18x over three years at an 8% required return) to imply roughly 18.3% Core FFO/share CAGR — up from about 14% in the old frame, and above both the mid-teens bull case and the +13.9% delivered in Q2. Q2 operating evidence (record 0-1MW/interconnection bookings, +25.4% renewal spreads, commencement lag down to nine months) remains strong and improving, so the stance does not move to cautious; but the price rose 11.5% while the guide rose about 1.6%, and the re-rating alone pushed the requirement beyond the scenario set, so constructive no longer holds.

upgrade.zh: 若 Q3/Q4 leasing bookings 保持高位、剔除约 $380M 收购增量后 backlog 仍见开租进展、0-1MW/interconnection 需求与约 9GW future development 同时推进、净债务和利息成本没有稀释 Core FFO/share 增长，且 Core FFO/share 增速或倍数回落把差距收敛到当前约 18.3% 的隐含要求，则上调回 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move back to constructive if Q3/Q4 leasing bookings remain elevated, the backlog shows commencement progress after accounting for the roughly $380M acquisition increment, 0-1MW/interconnection demand and about 9GW of future development both advance, net debt and interest cost do not dilute Core FFO/share growth, and either faster Core FFO/share growth or a multiple reset closes the gap to the roughly 18.3% currently implied requirement.

downgrade.zh: 如果剔除收购增量后的 backlog commencement lag 继续拉长、renewal/pricing spreads 恶化、开发电力或许可推迟容量，或净债务/股本融资使 Core FFO/share 增长进一步低于约 18.3% 的隐含要求，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to cautious if acquisition-adjusted backlog commencement lag keeps stretching, renewal/pricing spreads deteriorate, power or permitting delays capacity, or net debt/equity financing pushes Core FFO/share growth further below the roughly 18.3% implied requirement.

title: MiniMax Group 深度研究报告 - 应用层需求验证与高估值压力测试
titleEn: MiniMax Group Deep Research Report - Application-Layer Demand Validation and Valuation Stress Test
summary: 首次覆盖 MiniMax 作为 AI 基础设施研究簿的应用层需求风险锚。FY2025 收入 US$79.0M、同比 +158.9%，毛利率由 12.2% 升至 25.4%，海外收入占 73%；但调整后净亏损 US$250.9M、经营现金流流出 US$279.6M。以 HK$333.80（2026-08-17 收盘）、配售后 349.235M 股和形式净现金估算，市值约 HK$116.6B、P/S 约 189.1x、EV/FY2025 Sales 约 152.3x，隐含四年收入 CAGR 约 83%，已超过 70%-80% 牛市情景上限。业务增长得到验证，但预期差在所有已发布情景下均为负，维持谨慎 / 低确信。
summaryEn: Initial coverage of MiniMax as the application-layer demand-risk anchor for the AI-infrastructure research book. FY2025 revenue was US$79.0M, up 158.9%, gross margin improved from 12.2% to 25.4%, and international revenue reached 73%. Adjusted net loss was US$250.9M and operating cash outflow was US$279.6M. At the HK$333.80 close on 2026-08-17, 349.235M post-placement shares, and estimated pro forma net cash, market capitalization is about HK$116.6B, price-to-sales about 189.1x, and EV/FY2025 sales about 152.3x, implying roughly 83% four-year revenue CAGR — above even the 70%-80% bull-case band. Growth is verified, but the expectation gap is negative under every published scenario, so the stance stays cautious / low conviction.
highlights: 2025 年前九个月 AI-native 产品平均 MAU 27.6M、付费用户 1.77M；消费产品收入占 FY2025 的 67.2%，平台/企业占 32.8%
调整后净亏损 US$250.9M、经营现金流流出 US$279.6M；研发费用约为收入 3.2 倍，商业化仍依赖外部资本
2026-08-17 收盘 HK$333.80（较 07-31 锚点 +44.8%）、市值约 HK$116.6B、P/S 约 189.1x、EV/FY2025 Sales 约 152.3x，隐含 CAGR 约 83%、已超过 70%-80% 牛市情景上限；谨慎 / 低确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-08-17 收盘 HK$333.80、配售后约 HK$116.6B 市值和约 152.3x EV/FY2025 Sales 计，代入本报告自身公式，市场隐含未来四年收入 CAGR 约 83%（2026-07-31 锚点约 62%），不仅高于 50%-60% 的基准情景，也已超过 70%-80% 的牛市情景上限，预期差在所有已发布情景下均为负。+44.8% 的重定价没有伴随任何新的发行人披露，构成谨慎判断的要件——152.3x 历史收入倍数、25.4% 毛利率、US$279.6M 经营现金流流出、IP 风险与持续稀释——无一改变；下一个基本面触点为 2026-08-26 中期业绩。
stanceRationale.en: At the HK$333.80 close on 2026-08-17, about HK$116.6B of post-placement market capitalization, and about 152.3x EV/FY2025 sales, this report's own formula implies about 82.7% four-year revenue CAGR (about 62% at the 2026-07-31 anchor), above not only the 50%-60% base case but also the top of the 70%-80% bull band, so the expectation gap is negative under every published scenario. The +44.8% repricing came with no new issuer disclosure, and none of the components of the cautious call — 152.3x historical sales, a 25.4% gross margin, US$279.6M of operating cash outflow, IP risk, and continuing dilution — has changed. The next fundamental touchpoint is the 2026-08-26 interim results.

upgrade.zh: 若后续报告显示收入增长维持 80% 以上、总毛利率超过 40%、平台占比和付费客户持续提高，经营现金消耗降至收入 100% 以下，且至少 24 个月无需再次大额股权融资，则上调至 neutral-watch 或 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or constructive if later reporting shows revenue growth above 80%, consolidated gross margin above 40%, continued platform-mix and paying-customer gains, operating cash burn below 100% of revenue, and at least 24 months without another large equity raise.

downgrade.zh: 若收入增速跌破 50%、总毛利率停留在 25% 附近、经营现金消耗继续超过收入 200%，或可转债/奖励计划后仍需追加大额配售，则下调至 bearish-avoid；重大 IP 禁令、赔偿或关键市场限制同样触发下调。
downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid if revenue growth falls below 50%, consolidated gross margin remains near 25%, operating cash burn stays above 200% of revenue, or another large placement follows the bond or awards. A material IP injunction, damages award, or key-market restriction also triggers a downgrade.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：立场须按当前价格重新推导。HK$333.80（较 07-31 锚点 +44.8%）下市值约 HK$116.6B、EV/FY2025 Sales 约 152.3x，隐含四年 CAGR 约 83%，已超过 70%-80% 牛市情景上限，负预期差反而加宽。下调条款全部是基本面读数且无新披露，价格上涨本身不构成翻转；维持谨慎 / 低确信，2026-08-26 中期业绩为下一个裁定点。

At HK$333.80 (+44.8% from the 07-31 anchor), market cap is about HK$116.6B and EV/FY2025 sales about 152.3x, implying about 83% four-year CAGR — above even the 70%-80% bull band, so the negative gap widened. All downgrade clauses are fundamental readings with no new disclosure; a price rise alone does not flip the stance. Cautious / low conviction maintained; the 2026-08-26 interims are the next adjudication point.

benchmarkRationale.zh: resources 层默认基准是 COPX（铜矿）。铜与铀由完全不同的驱动因素定价——铜看中国建筑、电网资本开支与 232 条款关税，铀看反应堆重启、长约签订与浓缩/转化产能——用 COPX 计分实际上是在问『铀有没有跑赢铜』，与本报告的任何一句判断都不相干。实测也支持：自 2026-01-28 收盘至 2026-07-30 收盘，CCJ −34.2%、URA −35.7%、COPX −13.6%；CCJ 与 URA 的日收益率相关系数 0.92，与 COPX 只有 0.74。本报告的核心论点恰恰是『Cameco 是一个被压抑的铀敞口』（实现价 66.21 美元 vs 现货 84.25 美元，现货每涨 5 美元反而使调整后净利润下降），要检验这句话，基准必须自带铀的 beta。代价必须写明：CCJ 约占 URA 的 22-23%（Oklo 另占约 5-6%），因此 CCJ 自身的波动会带动基准、压缩测得的超额收益；我们接受这份衰减，也不愿把一家铀矿商拿去和铜矿指数比。URA 不是本报告的 priceSymbol，未触发自基准禁令。
benchmarkRationale.en: The resources layer default is COPX (copper miners). Copper and uranium are priced by unrelated drivers - copper by Chinese construction, grid capex and Section 232 tariffs; uranium by reactor restarts, long-term contracting and enrichment/conversion capacity - so scoring against COPX asks 'did uranium beat copper', which bears on no judgment in this report. The measurement agrees: from the 2026-01-28 close to the 2026-07-30 close, CCJ was -34.2%, URA -35.7% and COPX -13.6%, and CCJ's daily-return correlation is 0.92 to URA against 0.74 to COPX. This report's core claim is precisely that Cameco is a muted expression of uranium (realized US$66.21/lb against an US$84.25 spot, with a US$5/lb rise in spot lowering adjusted net earnings), and testing that claim requires a benchmark that carries uranium beta. The cost is stated plainly: CCJ is roughly 22-23% of URA (Oklo is a further ~5-6%), so part of any CCJ move is transmitted into the benchmark and mutes measured alpha. We accept that muting rather than score a uranium miner against a copper index. URA is not this report's own priceSymbol, so the self-benchmark ban is not engaged.

title: Cameco 深度研究报告 - 核燃料循环对核电基荷叙事的上游约束检验
titleEn: Cameco Deep Research Report - Upstream Constraint Check on the Nuclear Baseload Story
summary: AI 基础设施书 resources 层的公共约束初始覆盖：电力层用 constellation-energy-2026 和 oklo-2026 押注核电基荷，但前者全文没有出现过『铀』字，后者把 fuel-supply 列为常设监测项却没有上游报告可对照。本报告提供这份读数，结论是否定的：按 2026 年披露，铀矿供应并非绑定约束——现货在 85 美元/磅附近横盘五个月而成交量从 1,200 万磅升至 1,800 万磅，最大的西方生产商 Cameco 自己要买走所卖量的约三分之一（2026 年交付 2,900-3,200 万磅 vs 产量 1,950-2,150 万磅），真正吃紧的是转化与浓缩（转化现货 62.50 美元/kgU 高于北美长期价 55.25 美元/kgU），而卡住先进堆的 HALEU 是 Cameco 不生产的浓缩产品——Cameco 自己的 MD&A 记录的是 Centrus 而非 Cameco 与 Oklo 签署 HALEU 商业协议。公司层面：2026 Q1（季度截至 2026-03-31、05-05 发布）收入 8.45 亿加元（+7%）、调整后 EBITDA 5.09 亿加元（+44%），但平均实现价格仅 66.21 美元/磅，而公司自己的敏感性表显示现货每涨 5 美元/磅调整后净利润反而减少 100 万加元；2026 年收入指引在 Q2 财报中上调至 33.20-35.70 亿加元，但其 34.45 亿加元中值仍低于 2025 财年的 34.82 亿加元。以 2026-07-30 收盘 88.23 美元为锚（较 1 月 28 日高点 134.09 美元低 34.2%），市值约 384 亿美元 / 539 亿加元、按截至 2026-06-30 追溯十二个月计约 152x 报告盈利、约 102x 调整后净利润、约 29.9x 企业价值/调整后 EBITDA、股息率 0.19%。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市对称网格，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。 2026-07-31 更新：Q2 已发布（净利润 0.25 亿加元、调整后净利润 0.77 亿加元、调整后 EBITDA 3.91 亿加元），铀分部指引上调、产量指引不变，不及一致预期源于 Westinghouse 转为 0.10 亿加元净亏损；同日 Westinghouse 就拟议 IPO 保密递交 Form S-1。立场维持中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's resources layer. The power layer bets on nuclear baseload through constellation-energy-2026 and oklo-2026, but the former never mentions uranium anywhere in its body and the latter carries fuel-supply as a standing monitoring item with no upstream report to grade it against. This report supplies that reading, and the answer is negative: on 2026 disclosure, uranium mine supply is not the binding constraint. Spot went sideways near US$85/lb for five months while quarterly volume rose from 12M to 18M lb, and Cameco - the largest western producer - buys roughly a third of what it sells (29-32M lb of 2026 deliveries against 19.5-21.5M lb of production). The genuinely tight steps are conversion and enrichment (conversion spot at US$62.50/kgU sits above the North American long-term price of US$55.25/kgU), and HALEU, the fuel that gates advanced reactors, is an enrichment product Cameco does not make - its own MD&A records Centrus, not Cameco, signing a HALEU agreement with Oklo. At the company level, Q1 2026 (quarter ended 2026-03-31, reported 05-05) delivered revenue of C$845M (+7%) and adjusted EBITDA of C$509M (+44%), but the average realized price was only US$66.21/lb, and Cameco's own sensitivity table shows a US$5/lb rise in spot lowering adjusted net earnings by C$1M; 2026 revenue guidance was raised on the Q2 print to C$3,320-3,570M, but its C$3,445M midpoint still sits below FY2025's C$3,482M. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of US$88.23 (34.2% below the January 28 high of US$134.09), market cap is ~US$38.4B / C$53.9B at ~152x trailing reported earnings, ~102x trailing adjusted net earnings and ~29.9x EV/trailing adjusted EBITDA on the twelve months ended 2026-06-30 and a 0.19% dividend yield. A symmetric 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid opens the initiation at neutral-watch / medium conviction. Updated 2026-07-31: Q2 landed (net earnings C$25M, adjusted net earnings C$77M, adjusted EBITDA C$391M); the uranium outlook was raised and the production outlook held, and the consensus miss came from Westinghouse swinging to a C$10M net loss. Westinghouse separately submitted a confidential draft Form S-1 for a proposed IPO the same day. Stance holds at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: 上游约束检验的答案是否定的：铀矿供应不卡核电基荷，真正紧的是转化与浓缩；HALEU 属于 Centrus/Urenco/DOE，不属于 Cameco
oklo-2026 的 fuel-supply 监测项应改按浓缩产能评级——Cameco 的 MD&A 记录的是 Centrus 与 Oklo 签 HALEU 协议；constellation-energy-2026 全文无『铀』字
2026 Q1 收入 8.45 亿加元（+7%）、调整后 EBITDA 5.09 亿加元（+44%），但实现价格仅 66.21 美元/磅 vs 现货 84.25、长期价 91.50 美元
公司自公布的敏感性：现货每涨 5 美元/磅，调整后净利润 −100 万加元、现金流 −1,600 万加元；即使现货翻两番到 160 美元，2026 实现价也只到 70 美元
股价 88.23 美元（2026-07-30 收盘、较 1 月高点 −34.2%）：按截至 2026-06-30 追溯十二个月计约 102x 调整后净利润、约 29.9x 企业价值/调整后 EBITDA、股息率 0.19%；30/40/30 对称网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

latest.en: Reported 2026-07-31 pre-market (quarter ended 2026-06-30): net earnings C$25M, adjusted net earnings C$77M, adjusted EBITDA C$391M; six months C$156M / C$281M / C$899M. Uranium segment earnings before taxes C$170M on C$252M adjusted EBITDA, 7.1M lb delivered and 3.9M lb produced (our share); fuel services earnings before taxes C$30M on C$42M adjusted EBITDA, 3.0M kgU produced and 3.6M kgU sold. The consolidated miss (US$0.13 adjusted EPS against a roughly US$0.26 consensus) is Westinghouse, which swung to a C$10M net loss to Cameco against roughly US$170M of Q2 2025 equity earnings from Dukovany. Graded within: this item's published trigger is a deterioration in realized price, deliveries or contracting against the Q1 sensitivity path, or a guidance cut — none of which happened. Realized prices improved, the uranium outlook was raised, and H1 deliveries of 14.9M lb track the unchanged 29-32M lb full-year guide. Neither the consolidated 19.5-21.5M lb outlook nor Cigar Lake's 17.5-18.0M lb (100% basis) outlook was changed; the extended Key Lake mill shutdown is scheduled for Q3 2026

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 业绩与任何运营更新公告 / Q3 2026 results and any operations update releases

stanceRationale.zh: 以 88.23 美元（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市场已经把 CCJ 从 1 月 28 日的 134.09 美元下调了 34.2%，而同期铀现货月均价只从 94.28 美元降到 85.00 美元（约 −9.9%）——股权重估幅度约为商品的三倍半，因此单纯的『泡沫』论据已经弱了很多。但折价本身不等于机会：按截至 2026-06-30 的追溯十二个月计约 152x 追溯报告盈利、约 102x 追溯调整后净利润、约 29.9x 企业价值/追溯调整后 EBITDA，加上约 15.6x 2026 年指引收入与 0.19% 的股息率，仍然假设实现价格会按期向长期价收敛、Westinghouse 的能源部计划会转化。30/40/30 的对称网格是结论而不是骑墙：两侧差在时点与证据质量而非概率——支撑上行的一切（2029-2030 空档、95.50 美元的长期价、800 亿美元的 AP1000 计划）都标注在 2028 年之后且以尚未签署的合同为前提；支撑下行的一切（倍数、上调后中值仍低于上年的 2026 年收入指引、现货每涨 5 美元反而使调整后净利润下降、被撤回的 Westinghouse 五年展望）已经印在 2026 年的备案文件里。因此初始立场为中性观察而非偏多；是中性观察而非谨慎，则因为一级矿体与净现金资产负债表消除了『谨慎』本应隐含的下行尾部。
stanceRationale.en: At US$88.23 (2026-07-30 close) the market has already marked CCJ down 34.2% from US$134.09 on January 28, while the monthly average uranium spot price fell only from US$94.28 to US$85.00 (about -9.9%) - the equity de-rated roughly three and a half times as much as the commodity, so the simple froth argument is much weaker than it was. But the de-rating is not by itself an opportunity: ~152x trailing reported earnings, ~102x trailing adjusted net earnings and ~29.9x EV/trailing adjusted EBITDA on the twelve months ended 2026-06-30, plus ~15.6x guided 2026 revenue and a 0.19% dividend yield, still assume that realized prices converge toward the term price on schedule and that Westinghouse's DOE program converts. The symmetric 30/40/30 grid is the finding rather than a hedge: the two sides differ in timing and evidence quality, not probability - everything supporting the upside (the 2029-2030 slots, the US$95.50 term price, the US$80B AP1000 program) is dated 2028 or later and conditional on contracts not yet signed, while everything supporting the downside (the multiple, 2026 revenue guidance whose midpoint is still below the prior year even after being raised, adjusted net earnings falling when spot rises US$5/lb, the withdrawn five-year Westinghouse outlook) is already printed in filings dated 2026. Hence neutral-watch rather than constructive - and neutral-watch rather than cautious, because tier-one orebodies and a roughly net-cash balance sheet remove the downside tail a cautious rating should imply.

upgrade.zh: 长期价指标在 2027 年前守在 95 美元/磅以上，同时 Cameco 以带高上限的市场挂钩条款填满 2029-2030 空档、季度实现价格开始向长期价指标收敛，Westinghouse 签署与美国政府的最终协议并交付到 3.70-4.30 亿美元指引上沿或以上，且产量在 Key Lake 接入期间守住 1,950-2,150 万磅，则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Upgrade to constructive if the long-term indicator holds above US$95/lb into 2027 while Cameco fills its 2029-2030 slots at high-ceiling market-related terms and the quarterly realized price begins converging toward the term indicator, Westinghouse signs definitive US government agreements and delivers at or above the top of its US$370-430M guide, and production holds at 19.5-21.5M lb through the Key Lake tie-in.

downgrade.zh: Q2 或后续财报显示实现价格与合同签订相对已公布的敏感性路径恶化、长期价指标回落至现货附近、2029-2030 合同簿以基准递增定价填满、Westinghouse 指引被下调或其最终协议滑出 2026 年，或一次生产中断迫使下调 1,950-2,150 万磅指引，则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: Downgrade to cautious if the Q2 or a subsequent print shows realized price and contracting deteriorating against the published sensitivity path, the long-term indicator falls back toward spot, the 2029-2030 book fills at base-escalated pricing, Westinghouse guidance is cut or its definitive agreements slip past 2026, or a production disruption forces a cut to the 19.5-21.5M lb guide.

benchmarkRationale.zh: resources 层默认基准是 COPX（铜矿）。铜与稀土之间除了「矿业」这两个字之外没有共同点：铜由中国建筑、电网资本开支与冶炼产能定价，而 MP 的 NdPr 由中国出口政策定价，并且自 2025-10-01 起还由一份 110 美元/公斤的美国政府价格下限定价。用 COPX 给 MP 计分，实际上是在问「一个由政策承保的稀土磁材平台有没有跑赢铜」，与本报告的任何一句判断都不相干。实测在其力所能及的范围内也支持这一点：2026-01-02 至 2026-07-30 共 143 个交易日，MP 与 REMX 的日收益率相关系数为 0.702，与 COPX 只有 0.537；自 2026-01-28 收盘至 2026-07-30 收盘，MP −37.8%、REMX −31.9%、COPX −13.3%。这次覆盖的弱点必须写明，因为 REMX 并没有赢下相关性比拼：XME（宽口径金属与矿业，0.758）与 URA（铀矿，0.732）都高于 REMX，而它们被否掉的理由是经济学而非测量——XME 是钢铁、煤炭与黄金，URA 与稀土之间根本不存在驱动关系，这两个读数反映的是 2026 上半年共同回撤期内共享的小盘资源 beta，而不是经济联系。因此我们是在明知它排第三的情况下选择 REMX，理由是它是唯一一个成份股与 MP 由同一组变量定价的篮子。还有两项代价：MP 自身占 REMX 的 5.74%（第三方持仓数据，2026-07-25），因此 MP 自己的波动会传导进基准、压缩测得的超额收益——严重程度远低于 CCJ 在 URA 中 22-23% 的权重，但不是零；而且 REMX 并非纯稀土篮子——前五大持仓中有两只是锂标的（Albemarle 7.72%、PLS 7.13%），前十二大中有十只在美国以外上市，其中包括本书单独覆盖的 Almonty（4.86%）与 MP 自己此前的精矿包销对手方盛和资源（3.66%）。因此用 REMX 给 MP 计分，部分是在问「MP 有没有跑赢自己层内的同行和自己以前的客户」——这对本报告是个正当问题，但它不是一把中性的市场尺子。REMX 不是本报告的 priceSymbol，未触发自基准禁令。
benchmarkRationale.en: The resources layer default is COPX (copper miners). Copper and rare earths share nothing but the word mining: copper is priced by Chinese construction, grid capex and smelter capacity, while MP's NdPr is priced by Chinese export policy and - since 2025-10-01 - by a US government price floor at US$110/kg. Scoring MP against COPX asks 'did a policy-underwritten rare-earth magnet platform beat copper', which bears on no judgment in this report. The measurement agrees as far as it goes: over 143 sessions from 2026-01-02 to 2026-07-30, MP's daily-return correlation is 0.702 to REMX against 0.537 to COPX, and from the 2026-01-28 close to the 2026-07-30 close MP was -37.8%, REMX -31.9% and COPX -13.3%. The override's weakness has to be stated plainly, because REMX did not win the correlation contest. XME (broad metals and mining, 0.758) and URA (uranium miners, 0.732) both scored higher and both were rejected on economics rather than on measurement: XME is steel, coal and gold, and URA has no driver relationship to rare earths at all - those readings are shared small-cap resource beta during a common H1-2026 drawdown, not an economic link. We are therefore knowingly taking the third-ranked correlation because it is the only basket whose constituents are priced by the same variables as MP. Two further costs: MP is itself 5.74% of REMX (third-party holdings data, 2026-07-25), so part of any MP move is transmitted into the benchmark and mutes measured alpha - far less severely than CCJ's 22-23% weight in URA, but not zero; and REMX is not a pure rare-earth basket - two of its top five holdings are lithium names (Albemarle 7.72%, PLS 7.13%) and 10 of its top 12 holdings are listed outside the United States, including Almonty (4.86%), which this book covers separately, and Shenghe Resources (3.66%), MP's own former concentrate offtake counterparty. Scoring MP against REMX therefore partly asks 'did MP beat its own layer peers and its former customer', which is a legitimate question for this report but is not a neutral market yardstick. REMX is not this report's own priceSymbol, so the self-benchmark ban is not engaged.

title: MP Materials 深度研究报告 - 稀土磁材对 AI 基建的约束检验与政府托底的真实代价
titleEn: MP Materials Deep Research Report - Rare-Earth Magnets as an AI-Buildout Constraint, and What the Government Floor Actually Cost
summary: AI 基础设施书 resources 层的第二份公共约束覆盖，检验的候选约束是钕铁硼永磁材料，结论同样是否定的：按 MP 自己的备案文件，「data center」一词在 2025 财年 10-K 与 2026 Q1 10-Q 中各出现 0 次，「artificial intelligence」在 10-K 中出现两次——一次是「physical artificial intelligence and robotics」，一次是网络安全风险因素；MP 自己点名的 AI 是具身 AI 与机器人，已具名的需求关系是通用汽车（汽车）、苹果（消费电子）与 DoW（国防），10X 工厂的全部磁体在合同上归 DoW。公司层面最被误读的是 DoW 安排：2025-07-09 的对价分摊表显示 MP 收到 5.500 亿美元现金加一项计量为 2.186 亿美元的价格下限权利，交出的证券计量为 7.686 亿美元——这份 110 美元/公斤的下限是买来的，不是赠款，且正以每季约 1,120 万美元通过折旧摊销回冲。剥掉这笔支付，Materials 分部在下限生效后的头三个期间都是负的调整后 EBITDA（2026 Q1 −550 万、2025 Q4 −1,080 万、2025 全年 −3,420 万美元），2026 Q2 则首次转正为 +1,490 万美元；截至 2026-03-31 的追溯十二个月合并调整后 EBITDA 由 5,070 万变为 −4,260 万美元。10X 在合同上是成本加成：DoW 保证每年至少 1.40 亿美元 EBITDA、并按 2% 上调，但超额部分的头 3,000 万美元归 DoW、此后再对半分——下行被移除，上行也被削掉。以 2026-07-30 收盘 41.66 美元为锚（较 2025 年 10 月高点 −57.8%，较前一日低点 +9.3%），市值约 74.2 亿美元、企业价值约 71.9 亿美元，约 28.3 倍追溯收入、20.7 倍收入加下限收入、141.8 倍追溯调整后 EBITDA，无盈利、无股息。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市对称网格，首次覆盖立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: The second common-constraint coverage in the AI-infrastructure book's resources layer. The candidate constraint is NdFeB permanent magnets and the reading is again negative: on MP's own filings, the phrase 'data center' appears zero times in both the FY2025 10-K and the Q1 2026 10-Q, and 'artificial intelligence' appears twice in the 10-K - once as 'physical artificial intelligence and robotics', once as a cybersecurity risk factor. The AI MP itself names is embodied AI and robotics; its named demand relationships are General Motors (automotive), Apple (consumer devices) and the Department of War (defense), and 100% of the 10X facility's magnets are contracted to the DoW. At the company level the most misread item is the DoW arrangement itself: the 2025-07-09 allocation table shows MP receiving US$550.0M of cash plus a price-floor right measured at US$218.6M against securities it issued measured at US$768.6M - the US$110/kg floor was purchased, not granted, and is being amortized back through D&A at about US$11.2M a quarter. Strip that payment out and the Materials segment produced negative adjusted EBITDA in the first three periods after the floor began (-US$5.5M in Q1 2026, -US$10.8M in Q4 2025, -US$34.2M in FY2025), turning positive for the first time at +US$14.9M in Q2 2026; consolidated adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended 2026-03-31 falls from US$50.7M to -US$42.6M. The 10X facility is contractually cost-plus: the DoW guarantees at least US$140M of annual EBITDA escalating at 2%, but takes the first US$30M of any excess and half of everything beyond - the downside is removed and the upside is clipped by the same counterparty. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of US$41.66 (57.8% below the October 2025 high, 9.3% above a low set the previous session), market cap is about US$7.42B and enterprise value about US$7.19B, at roughly 28.3x trailing revenue, 20.7x revenue plus floor income and 141.8x trailing adjusted EBITDA, with no earnings and no dividend. A symmetric 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid opens the initiation at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: AI 关联性检验的答案是否定的：「data center」在 2025 财年 10-K 与 2026 Q1 10-Q 中各出现 0 次；MP 自己点名的 AI 是具身 AI 与机器人，已签约需求是通用汽车、苹果与 DoW
价格下限是买来的：MP 收到 5.500 亿美元现金 + 计量 2.186 亿美元的下限权利，交出计量 7.686 亿美元的证券（优先股 4.184 亿、认股权证 2.642 亿、钐项目贷款 0.860 亿）
剥掉政府支付后 Materials 分部每一期都亏损：2026 Q1 −550 万、2025 Q4 −1,080 万、2025 全年 −3,420 万美元；追溯十二个月合并调整后 EBITDA 由 5,070 万变 −4,260 万美元
10X 是成本加成且上行被封顶：DoW 保证每年至少 1.40 亿美元 EBITDA（年增 2%），但超额的头 3,000 万归 DoW、此后对半分；NdPr 高于 110 美元/公斤的部分在 10X 满产后分走 30%
股价 41.66 美元（2026-07-30 收盘、较 2025 年 10 月高点 −57.8%）：市值约 74.2 亿美元、企业价值约 71.9 亿美元，约 28.3 倍追溯收入、141.8 倍追溯调整后 EBITDA，无盈利无股息；30/40/30 对称网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

metric.zh: 2026 Q2 的 PPA 收入及产品收入的接替程度
metric.en: Q2 2026 PPA income and how far product revenue replaces it

trigger.zh: 参考价格升破 110 美元/公斤后 PPA 收入下降，而产品收入未能大致一比一接替，使 Materials 分部剔除 PPA 后的调整后 EBITDA 仍为负；或合并调整后 EBITDA 低于 2026 Q1 的 3,660 万美元
trigger.en: PPA income falls as the benchmark rises above US$110/kg without product revenue replacing it roughly one-for-one, leaving Materials segment adjusted EBITDA excluding PPA still negative; or consolidated adjusted EBITDA falls below Q1 2026's US$36.6M

latest.zh: 2026 Q2（季度截至 2026-06-30、2026-08-06 盘后发布，Q2 10-Q 于 2026-08-07 提交）：PPA 收入 1,758 万美元，较 Q1 的 4,230 万美元下降；Materials 分部收入 9,563 万美元、分部调整后 EBITDA 3,250 万美元，剔除 PPA 后为 +1,490 万美元（Q1 为 −550 万美元）；合并调整后 EBITDA 2,849 万美元、净亏损 2,030 万美元；NdPr 产量 840 吨（同比 +41%）、NdPr 销量 1,006 吨（同比 +127%）。本项自身的触发条件由「或」连接的两条分句在本季给出相反的业务方向，故维持未评级：第一条分句未发生且朝有利方向解决——Materials 分部收入增加 2,340 万美元，对应 PPA 收入减少 2,470 万美元，大致就是该分句要求的一比一接替，且剔除 PPA 后的分部调整后 EBITDA 已由负转正；第二条分句则已发生——合并调整后 EBITDA 2,849 万美元低于该分句写明的 2026 Q1 的 3,660 万美元（2026 上半年调整后 EBITDA 6,510.3 万美元减 Q2 的 2,849.3 万美元，得 Q1 为 3,661.0 万美元，未被重述，口径一致）；该缺口的构成中包含当季 1,359 万美元的初始启动费用（Q1 为 485 万美元）与下游扩张带来的 SG&A 上升。已发布规则没有说明这种混合结果应如何评级，需先裁决资格规则；立场、确信度与 2026-07-30 的估值锚点均未改动。
latest.en: Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported after the close on 2026-08-06; Q2 10-Q filed 2026-08-07): PPA income US$17.58M, down from US$42.3M in Q1; Materials segment revenue US$95.6M and segment adjusted EBITDA US$32.5M, which is +US$14.9M excluding PPA (Q1: -US$5.5M); consolidated adjusted EBITDA US$28.5M on a US$20.3M net loss; NdPr production 840 MT (+41% YoY) and NdPr sales 1,006 MT (+127% YoY). This item's own trigger joins two clauses with 'or', and in this quarter they point in opposite business directions, so it remains ungraded: the first clause did not occur and in fact resolved favourably - Materials segment revenue rose US$23.4M against a US$24.7M decline in PPA income, roughly the one-for-one substitution the clause asks for, and Materials segment adjusted EBITDA excluding PPA turned positive; the second clause did occur - consolidated adjusted EBITDA of US$28.5M is below the Q1 2026 US$36.6M the clause names (H1 2026 adjusted EBITDA of US$65.103M less Q2's US$28.493M puts Q1 at US$36.610M, unrestated and on the same measure) - with the shortfall including US$13.59M of initial start-up costs in the quarter (Q1: US$4.85M) and higher SG&A from the downstream expansion. The published rule does not say how to grade this mixed result, so its qualification rule must be adjudicated first; stance, conviction and the 2026-07-30 valuation anchor are unchanged.

metric.zh: Independence 首批成品磁体收入与 3,000 吨扩产进度
metric.en: First finished-magnet revenue at Independence and the 3,000 MT expansion

trigger.zh: 首批成品磁体收入未能在 2026 年内确认，或公司把 Independence 3,000 吨的承诺时间表后移
trigger.en: no finished-magnet revenue is recognized during 2026, or the company moves out the Independence 3,000 MT commitment timeline

latest.zh: 钕铁硼磁体制造于 2025 年 12 月在 Independence 的商业化设备上启动；2026 Q1 磁材分部收入 2,110 万美元全部为磁材前驱体（通用汽车协议下的 NdPr 金属），分部调整后 EBITDA 960 万美元。公司在 2026-05-07 的业绩沟通中重申仍预计 2026 下半年产生首批磁体收入（来源为业绩发布与电话会报道，非备案指引）。评级为阈内：本项发布的触发条件是磁体收入滑出 2026 年或 3,000 吨时间表后移，两者均未发生；但需注意 2026 下半年尚未过去，因此这是「尚未触发」而非「已兑现」。
latest.en: NdFeB magnet manufacturing began on commercial-scale equipment at Independence in December 2025; Q1 2026 magnetics segment revenue of US$21.1M was entirely magnetic precursor (NdPr metal under the GM agreement) on US$9.6M of segment adjusted EBITDA. At the 2026-05-07 results the company reiterated that it still expects initial magnet revenue in the second half of 2026 (source: results release and earnings-call coverage, not filed guidance). Graded within: this item's published trigger is magnet revenue slipping out of 2026 or the 3,000 MT timeline moving out, neither of which has happened - but H2 2026 has not yet elapsed, so this reads as not-yet-triggered rather than delivered.

metric.zh: DoW 一揽子安排的政治与拨款可持续性
metric.en: Political and appropriation durability of the DoW package

trigger.zh: DoW 交易协议被修改、被挑战或被削弱；任何一期 PPA 应收款未能转化为现金；或 10X 的 1.40 亿美元 EBITDA 保证被重述或撤回
trigger.en: the DoW Transaction Agreements are modified, challenged or impaired; any quarterly PPA receivable fails to convert to cash; or the US$140M 10X EBITDA guarantee is restated or withdrawn

latest.zh: 2026-06-30：PPA 收入应收款为 1,758.0 万美元，2025-12-31 为 5,101.6 万美元；1,758.0 万美元恰等于 Q2 当季新计提的 PPA 收入，即 Q1 计提的 4,227 万美元政府款项已按期收现（上半年「其他应收款」为经营现金流贡献 5,867.7 万美元）。2026 Q2 10-Q 原样重述了 DoW 的保证——10X 工厂「将产生至少 1.40 亿美元的 EBITDA（按 DoW 包销协议定义，并按年递增）」——并未披露对 DoW 交易协议的任何修改。风险面仍来自公司自身披露：10-Q 前瞻性陈述章节继续列示「DoW 交易的资金与支持面临的风险、对其的挑战」以及 DoW 交易协议中肯定性与否定性条款对公司构成的限制。评级为阈内：三条触发条件目前均未发生。
latest.en: At 2026-06-30 the PPA income receivable is US$17.580M against US$51.016M at 2025-12-31; the US$17.580M is exactly the quarter's new PPA income accrual, so the US$42.27M accrued in Q1 was collected in cash on schedule (other receivables were a US$58.677M source of operating cash in H1). The Q2 2026 10-Q restates the DoW guarantee verbatim - the 10X Facility 'will generate at least $140 million of EBITDA (as defined in the DoW Offtake Agreement, and subject to annual escalation)' - and discloses no modification to the DoW Transaction Agreements. The risk side still comes from the company's own disclosure: the 10-Q forward-looking section continues to list 'risks related to the funding of and support for the DoW Transactions, to challenges thereto' and the restrictions the DoW Transaction Agreements' affirmative and negative covenants impose. Graded within: none of the three trigger clauses has occurred.

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季 10-Q 的 PPA 应收款回收情况与 DoW 协议相关披露（事件驱动）/ quarterly 10-Q PPA receivable collection and any DoW-agreement disclosure (event-driven)

metric.zh: 中国 2026-06-22 两用物项出口管制列名对建设的实际影响
metric.en: The buildout impact of China's 2026-06-22 dual-use export-control listing

trigger.zh: MP 披露 Independence、10X 或重稀土原料采购出现可归因于中国出口管制的进度延误或成本上升
trigger.en: MP discloses a schedule delay or cost increase at Independence, the 10X or in HREE feedstock sourcing attributable to Chinese export controls

latest.zh: 中国商务部于 2026-06-22 将 MP Materials、USA Rare Earth 及另外八家美国实体列入两用物项出口管制名单，禁止自中国向其出口两用物项并立即生效（来源为路透、彭博、Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 等媒体报道）。MP 此前已于 2025 年 7 月停止全部对华销售，因此该措施限制的是流入方向——磁体制造设备、烧结炉与重稀土原料；MP 的 10-K 记载 DoW 已同意协助为 10X 采购重稀土原料。评级为读数不明：MP 未就此提交 8-K、未量化任何影响，也没有可对照的备案披露，因此在下一份 10-Q 之前无法按本项自身的触发条件评级。
latest.en: China's Ministry of Commerce added MP Materials, USA Rare Earth and eight other US entities to its dual-use export-control list on 2026-06-22, prohibiting exports of dual-use items from China to them with immediate effect (source: Reuters, Bloomberg and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence coverage). MP had already ceased all sales to China in July 2025, so the measure restricts the inbound direction - magnet-making equipment, sintering furnaces and heavy-rare-earth feedstock; MP's 10-K records that the DoW has agreed to assist in procuring HREE feedstock for the 10X. Graded unclear: MP has filed no 8-K, has quantified no impact and there is no filed disclosure to compare against, so this item cannot be graded against its own trigger before the next 10-Q.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q2 与 Q3 的 10-Q 中任何归因于出口管制的进度或成本披露（事件驱动）/ any schedule or cost disclosure attributed to export controls in the Q2 and Q3 2026 10-Qs (event-driven)

metric.zh: 通往 10X 的资本开支与流动性路径

trigger.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引被显著上调至 6.0 亿美元以上、现金与短期投资合计降至约 10 亿美元以下，或在 41.66 美元锚点价格之下增发股权
trigger.en: the 2026 capex guide is raised materially above US$600M, cash plus short-term investments falls below about US$1.0B, or equity is issued below the US$41.66 anchor price

latest.zh: 2026-06-30：现金 4.291 亿美元加短期投资 10.236 亿美元合计 14.526 亿美元，对应债务本金 10.128 亿美元（2026 可转债已于 2026-04-01 到期兑付，流动部分归零）。2026 Q2 资本开支 2.303 亿美元（上半年购建固定资产现金支出 3.077 亿美元），10-Q 重申 2026 年指引不变，仍为扣除政府补助后的 5.0-6.0 亿美元；当季未进行股权融资，唯一新增股份为 2026 可转债转股的 337,741 股。公司披露截至 2026-06-30 遵守了 2.75 亿美元循环信贷（未提用）项下适用的财务条款。评级为阈内：三条触发条件目前均未发生——指引未上调至 6.0 亿美元以上、流动性远高于约 10 亿美元的门槛、且未在 41.66 美元锚点价格之下增发股权。
latest.en: At 2026-06-30, US$429.1M of cash plus US$1,023.6M of short-term investments gives US$1.4526B of liquidity against US$1,012.8M of debt principal (the 2026 convertible notes matured and were repaid on 2026-04-01, taking the current portion to nil). Q2 2026 capital expenditures were US$230.3M (H1 additions to property, plant and equipment of US$307.7M), and the 10-Q reiterates the 2026 guide unchanged at US$500-600M net of government awards; no equity was issued in the quarter, the only new shares being 337,741 on conversion of the 2026 notes. The company discloses that it was in compliance with the applicable financial covenant under its undrawn US$275.0M revolving credit facility as of 2026-06-30. Graded within: none of the three trigger clauses has occurred - the guide was not raised above US$600M, liquidity is far above the roughly US$1.0B threshold, and no equity was issued below the US$41.66 anchor price.

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季 10-Q 的流动性余额与资本开支运行率，以及任何融资公告 / quarterly 10-Q liquidity balance and capex run-rate, plus any financing announcement

stanceRationale.zh: 以 41.66 美元（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市场已经把 MP 从 2025-10-14 的 98.65 美元下调了 57.8%，锚点本身还是自前一交易日 38.10 美元低点反弹 9.3% 之后的价格——所以「泡沫」论据已经不强了。但折价不等于机会：约 71.9 亿美元企业价值对应约 28.3 倍追溯收入、20.7 倍收入加下限收入、141.8 倍追溯调整后 EBITDA，而剔除 DoW 支付后追溯调整后 EBITDA 是 −4,260 万美元，没有盈利也没有股息。30/40/30 的对称网格是结论而非骑墙，理由与 cameco-2026 不同：那里的对称来自时点，这里的对称来自结构。同一份合同同时压缩了两侧——110 美元/公斤下限、10X 每年 1.40 亿美元 EBITDA 保证与 17.4 亿美元流动性移除了左尾；而 NdPr 超额的 30%、10X 超额 EBITDA 的头 3,000 万美元加此后对半分，削掉了右尾。因此首次覆盖为中性观察而非偏多；是中性观察而非谨慎，则因为那份十年下限与保证 EBITDA 确实消除了「谨慎」本应隐含的下行尾部。确信度为中而非高：机制证据是一手且精确的（对价分摊表、包销条款、分部 EBITDA 算术），但量级证据薄弱——MP 不发布产量、收入或 EBITDA 指引，也不披露 NdPr 实现价格，成熟 EBITDA 区间依赖本报告自己的单位假设。
stanceRationale.en: At US$41.66 (2026-07-30 close) the market has already marked MP down 57.8% from US$98.65 on 2025-10-14, and the anchor is itself a 9.3% bounce off the previous session's US$38.10 low - so the froth argument is much weaker than it was. But the de-rating is not by itself an opportunity: an enterprise value of about US$7.19B is roughly 28.3x trailing revenue, 20.7x revenue plus floor income and 141.8x trailing adjusted EBITDA, while trailing adjusted EBITDA excluding the DoW payment is -US$42.6M, with no earnings and no dividend. The symmetric 30/40/30 grid is the finding rather than a hedge, and for a different reason than in cameco-2026: there the symmetry came from timing, here it comes from structure. One contract compresses both sides - a US$110/kg floor, a US$140M annual 10X EBITDA guarantee and US$1.74B of liquidity remove the left tail, while 30% of the NdPr excess plus the first US$30M and then half of all 10X excess EBITDA clip the right. Hence neutral-watch rather than constructive at initiation, and neutral-watch rather than cautious because that ten-year floor and guaranteed EBITDA genuinely remove the downside tail a cautious rating should imply. Conviction is medium rather than high: the mechanism evidence is primary and exact (the allocation table, the offtake terms, the segment EBITDA arithmetic), but the magnitude evidence is weak - MP publishes no volume, revenue or EBITDA guidance and no realized NdPr price, so the mature-EBITDA ranges rest on this report's own unit assumptions.

upgrade.zh: 2026 Q2 显示在参考价格高于 110 美元/公斤时产品收入大致一比一地接替了 PPA 收入、使 Materials 分部剔除 PPA 后的调整后 EBITDA 转正，首批成品磁体收入落在 2026 下半年，且 10X 在 5.0-6.0 亿美元资本开支包络内保持 2028 年路径、未在锚点价格之下增发股权，则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Upgrade to constructive if Q2 2026 shows product revenue replacing PPA income roughly one-for-one at a benchmark above US$110/kg so that Materials segment adjusted EBITDA excluding PPA turns positive, first finished-magnet revenue lands in the second half of 2026, and the 10X holds its 2028 path inside the US$500-600M capex envelope without equity issued below the anchor price.

downgrade.zh: DoW 一揽子安排被修改、被挑战或其拨款失效、PPA 应收款停止转化为现金；或 2026 Q2 显示 PPA 收入下降而产品收入未能接替；或 10X 滑出 2029 年、资本开支被显著上调、流动性降至约 10 亿美元以下、在锚点价格之下增发股权；或中国 2026-06-22 的出口管制列名被披露已延误建设，则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: Downgrade to cautious if the DoW package is modified, challenged or its appropriation lapses and PPA receivables stop converting to cash; or Q2 2026 shows PPA income falling without product revenue replacing it; or the 10X slips past 2029, capex is materially raised, liquidity falls below about US$1.0B, or equity is issued below the anchor price; or China's 2026-06-22 export-control listing is disclosed to have delayed the buildout.

title: Astera Labs 深度研究报告 - 机架级 fan-out 是否构成独立瓶颈的架构校验
titleEn: Astera Labs Deep Research Report - Architecture Check on Whether Rack-Scale Fan-Out Is a Distinct Bottleneck
summary: AI 基础设施书 interconnect 层的首个节点与架构校验：机架级 fan-out 是独立插槽，但尚不是独立瓶颈，因此本层应读作架构指标而非卡口约束。Astera Labs 于 2026-08-04 披露 2026 Q2 初步业绩（季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $392.4M（同比 +104%、环比 +27%）、GAAP/非 GAAP 毛利率 73.3%/73.7%、非 GAAP 每股收益 $0.80，Q3 收入指引 $540-560M；Scorpio 预计在 Q3 提前一季成为最大产品线。客户集中、认股权证冲减收入与 retimer 被集成的结构性风险仍未解除。以下估值、情景网格、立场与确信度仍是 2026-07-30 的历史快照，并未因本次监测更新重算；谨慎 / 中确信不变。
summaryEn: First node and architecture check for the AI-infrastructure book's interconnect layer: rack-scale fan-out is a distinct socket but not yet a distinct bottleneck, so the layer remains an architecture read rather than a constraint read. Astera Labs disclosed preliminary Q2 2026 results on 2026-08-04 (quarter ended 2026-06-30): revenue $392.4M (+104% YoY, +27% QoQ), GAAP/non-GAAP gross margins of 73.3%/73.7%, non-GAAP EPS of $0.80, and Q3 revenue guidance of $540-560M; Scorpio is expected to become the largest product family in Q3, one quarter early. Customer concentration, warrant contra-revenue, and retimer-integration risks remain unresolved. The valuation, scenario grid, stance, and conviction below remain the historical 2026-07-30 snapshot and were not recomputed for this monitoring update; cautious / medium conviction is unchanged.
highlights: interconnect 层首个节点：本层此前为空，ALAB 以架构校验身份开层，与 broadcom-2026 / marvell-2026 在供给侧配对
核心结论：机架级 fan-out 是独立的插槽，但不是独立的瓶颈——供应已备到年底、库存 75 天、无配给，收入无独立周期，本层应读作架构指标而非卡口约束
2026 Q2 初步业绩（2026-08-04）：收入 $392.4M（+104% YoY、+27% QoQ）、非 GAAP 毛利率 73.7%、Q3 指引 $540-560M，Scorpio 预计提前一季成为最大产品线
结构性风险：五家直接客户占 Q1 收入约 90%，第一大客户一年内 12%→29% 并持有最多 3,262,299 股、行权价 $142.82 的权证按冲减收入处理；Broadcom/NVIDIA 随时可集成掉 retiming
股价 $299.69（2026-07-30 收盘、单日 +20.0%、较 6 月高点 -38.0%）：约 50.1x EV/追溯收入、约 33x EV/CY2026E、约 192x 追溯 GAAP；20/50/30 网格，初始谨慎 / 中确信

trigger.zh: 同比收入增速降到约 40% 以下，或 Scorpio 未能如管理层所述在 2026 年底成为最大产品线
trigger.en: Year-over-year revenue growth falls below ~40%, or Scorpio fails to become the largest product line by end-2026 as management guided

latest.zh: 2026-08-04 Q2 2026 初步业绩（季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $392.4M（同比 +104%、环比 +27%），高于此前 $355–365M 指引上沿；GAAP 毛利率 73.3%、非 GAAP 73.7%；GAAP 每股收益 $0.83、非 GAAP $0.80；Q3 2026 指引 $540–560M。管理层称 Scorpio fabric 交换机将于 Q3 成为最大产品线，较此前预期提前一个季度；Aries 产品线创单季收入纪录。同比增速 +104% 远高于 ~40% 触发线、Scorpio 里程碑提前，读数维持 within。
latest.en: 2026-08-04 preliminary Q2 2026 results (quarter ended 2026-06-30): revenue $392.4M (+104% YoY, +27% QoQ), above the prior $355-365M guidance range; GAAP gross margin 73.3% / non-GAAP 73.7%; GAAP EPS $0.83 / non-GAAP $0.80; Q3 2026 guided to $540-560M. Management said Scorpio fabric switches will become the largest product family in Q3, one quarter ahead of prior expectations, and the Aries product line set a quarterly revenue record. YoY growth of +104% is far above the ~40% trigger and the Scorpio milestone is pulled forward, so the reading stays within.

latest.en: In Q1 2026 five direct customers were 29%, 21%, 16%, 12% and 12% of revenue (about 90% combined), against 12%, 26%, below 10%, 23% and below 10% a year earlier; receivables concentration was 25%, 20%, 16%, 17% and 13%; the 10-Q notes that certain listed customers are manufacturing partners buying on behalf of end customers, so direct-customer shares move with production allocation

monitoring.nextCheck: 各加速器世代的平台发布与竞争者设计导入公告（事件驱动）/ platform announcements at each accelerator generation and competitor design-win news (event-driven)

metric.en: Whether fan-out becomes a supply-constrained link

trigger.zh: EV/前瞻收入在同比增速降到约 40% 以下时仍高于约 30 倍（下调依据），或在增速保持 60% 以上时压缩到约 20 倍以下（上调依据）
trigger.en: EV/forward revenue stays above ~30x while year-over-year growth decelerates below ~40% (downgrade evidence), or compresses below ~20x while growth holds above 60% (upgrade evidence)

latest.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $299.69 计，市值约 $51.37B、企业价值约 $50.19B：约 50.1x EV/追溯收入、约 33x EV/本报告自估的 CY2026 收入、约 22x EV/CY2027E；同期 Q2 指引隐含同比约 +88%；对照 Broadcom 约 24-25x 追溯、Marvell 前瞻约 14.1x、Coherent 约 7.5x
latest.en: At the 2026-07-30 close of $299.69 market cap is ~$51.37B and enterprise value ~$50.19B: about 50.1x EV/TTM revenue, about 33x EV on this report's own CY2026 revenue estimate and about 22x on CY2027E, while the Q2 guide implies about +88% YoY; peers stand at about 24-25x trailing for Broadcom, about 14.1x forward for Marvell and about 7.5x for Coherent

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季价格账本与 Q2/Q3 收入实绩 / quarterly price ledger and Q2/Q3 revenue actuals

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $299.69（2026-07-30 收盘）计，7 月的 AI 基础设施重定价已把 ALAB 从 07-06 的 $432.74 打到 07-29 的 $249.74（-42.3%），再单日反弹 20.0%，但走完这一轮之后倍数仍以巨大差距高居本覆盖之首：约 50.1x EV/追溯收入、约 33x EV/本报告自估的 CY2026 收入、约 192x 追溯 GAAP 盈利、约 109x 最宽松的前瞻非 GAAP 口径。反推检验是裁决点——以 8% 年化走到 12 倍收入的终值，需要连续五年约 44% 的复合收入增长，不允许任何时点降速到 30% 后段以下。这不是质量判断：93% 增速、76% 毛利率、$342.8M 追溯自由现金流与 $11.8 亿净现金在全书中都属最强一档。它是偏度判断：20/50/30 网格的负偏度同时来自概率与幅度，上行需要含量、Scorpio 份额与 2027 年期权三件事按顺序做对，下行只需要增速正常化或一次集成决策。确信度中而非低，是因为单个季度关不上这么大的缺口，2026-08-05 的业绩不太可能改变算术；中而非高，是因为 2027 年 NVLink Fusion 与 UALink 收入、以及 retimer 功能能否熬过集成，都在当前披露窗口之外。
stanceRationale.en: At $299.69 (2026-07-30 close) the July AI-infrastructure repricing has already taken ALAB from $432.74 on 07-06 to $249.74 on 07-29 (-42.3%) and then 20.0% higher in a single session - and after that round trip the multiple is still the richest in this coverage by a wide margin: about 50.1x EV/TTM revenue, about 33x EV on this report's own CY2026 revenue estimate, about 192x trailing GAAP earnings and about 109x the most generous forward non-GAAP framing. The reverse test is the discriminator: earning 8% a year to a terminal 12x revenue requires roughly 44% compound revenue growth for five straight years, with no deceleration below the high 30s at any point. This is not a quality judgment - 93% growth, a 76% gross margin, $342.8M of trailing free cash flow and $1.18B of net cash are among the strongest facts in the book. It is a skew judgment: the 20/50/30 grid's negative skew comes from magnitude as well as probability, because the upside needs content, Scorpio share and the 2027 option stack to land in sequence while the downside needs only a normalizing growth rate or a single integration decision. Conviction is medium rather than low because no single quarter closes a gap this size, so the 2026-08-05 print is unlikely to change the arithmetic, and medium rather than high because 2027 NVLink Fusion and UALink revenue, and whether the retimer function survives integration, are both outside the current disclosure window.

upgrade.zh: 收入增速在 2027 年前保持 60% 以上且 Scorpio 被确认为最大产品线、NVLink Fusion 或 UALink 收入按期在 2027 年到来、权证影响过去后毛利率回到 75% 以上、第一大客户占比回落到约 25% 以下，且 EV/前瞻收入通过增长而非价格压缩到约 20 倍以下，则上调至中性观察。
upgrade.en: Revenue growth holds above 60% into 2027 with Scorpio confirmed as the largest product line, NVLink Fusion or UALink revenue arrives on schedule in 2027, gross margin returns above 75% once the warrant impact laps, the top customer's share falls back below ~25%, and EV/forward revenue compresses below ~20x through growth rather than through price - upgrade to neutral-watch.

downgrade.zh: 同比收入增速降到约 40% 以下、非 GAAP 毛利率稳定在约 70% 以下、某大客户的下一代平台放弃独立 retiming 或 PCIe 交换转用集成硅片、第一大客户超过约 35% 的收入占比，或权证冲减收入在单季超过收入的约 2%，则下调至回避。
downgrade.en: Year-over-year revenue growth decelerates below ~40%, non-GAAP gross margin settles below ~70%, a major customer's next-generation platform drops discrete retiming or PCIe switching for integrated silicon, the top customer exceeds ~35% of revenue, or warrant contra-revenue exceeds about 2% of revenue in a quarter - downgrade to bearish-avoid.

title: Amkor Technology 深度研究报告 - 先进封装的瓶颈究竟在 OSAT 还是在代工厂的架构校验
titleEn: Amkor Technology Deep Research Report - Architecture Check on Whether the Advanced-Packaging Bottleneck Sits at the OSAT or Inside the Foundry
summary: AI 基础设施书 advanced-packaging 层的首个节点与架构校验初始覆盖：该层此前节点数为零，AMKR 开层后本书 schema 不再有空层。本报告的任务是检验“先进封装是 AI 加速器供给的卡口约束”这一说法究竟落在 Amkor 所处的 OSAT 层，还是完全位于台积电 CoWoS / 3DFabric 之内。结论偏向后者：Amkor 标题上 82.0% 的“先进产品”被财报定义为倒装、内存与晶圆级加工，是一个由智能手机主导的口径（通信占收入 42%、计算含 PC 与存储仅 22%）；全网稼动率仅由 50% 区间升到 70% 区间；财报写明没有实质在手订单、客户不提供具约束力预测；Q3 收入指引 $19.5-20.5 亿对 2025 Q3 实绩 $1,987.0M 为同比 -1.9% 至 +3.2%。更具决定性的是方向相反的证据：管理层把 Q3 通信下滑归因于安卓出货量因内存供应约束下降约 20%——Amkor 当下是被内存层卡住，而不是在卡住别人。真实的狭窄例外是地理性的：美国本土先进封装产能确实稀缺，10-Q 披露 2026 年 7 月签署预付款协议、预计 2027 年收到约 $15 亿（报道指认交易对手为 NVIDIA），另约 $3 亿预付款中 $1.0 亿已到账，管理层称亚利桑那一期已完全被承诺，Apple 为锚定客户。最新已报告期间为 2026 Q2（季度截至 2026-06-30、07-27 发布、10-Q 于 07-28 提交）：收入 $1,898.0M（同比 +25.6%）、毛利率由 12.0% 拐到 16.8%、经营利润率 10.5%、EPS $0.70、EBITDA $400M，Q3 指引毛利率 18.5-19.5%、EPS $0.72-0.82。结构性风险同样清晰：Apple 占 FY2025 销售额 29.8%、Qualcomm 11.1%；2026 年资本开支指引 $25-30 亿（FY2025 为 $904.6M），追溯自由现金流 -$172.4M，FY2026E 自由现金流约 -$10 亿至 -$17 亿，管理层已预告亚利桑那稼动不足将在 2027-2028 年同时拖累毛利率与经营利润率。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $48.26 为锚（较 06-22 收盘高点 $93.55 低 48.4%，07-28 单日 -24.7%），市值约 $11.99B、企业价值约 $11.96B、约 21.6x 追溯 GAAP 市盈率、约 1.60x EV/追溯收入、约 8.6x EV/追溯 EBITDA、约 2.58x 市净率；但 EV/（EBITDA 减资本开支）为 $11.96B 除以 $24.6M。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格读出接近平衡的偏度，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: First node and initial architecture-check coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's advanced-packaging layer, which until now had zero nodes; with AMKR no layer in the book's schema is empty. The report's job is to test whether the repeatedly-cited claim that advanced packaging is the binding constraint on AI accelerator supply lands at the OSAT layer where Amkor sits, or entirely inside TSMC's CoWoS/3DFabric. The finding points mostly at the latter: Amkor's headline 82.0% "advanced products" is defined by the filing as flip chip, memory and wafer-level processing - a smartphone-led bucket (communications is 42% of revenue; computing, which includes PC/laptop and storage, is only 22%); network utilization improved merely from the 50% range into the 70% range; the filings state there is no material backlog and that customers give no binding forecasts; and Q3 revenue is guided to $1.95-2.05B against $1,987.0M actual in Q3 2025, or -1.9% to +3.2% year over year. More decisive still is evidence pointing the other way: management attributed the guided Q3 decline in communications to Android volumes falling about 20% on memory supply constraints - Amkor is currently being gated by the memory layer rather than gating anyone. The honest exception is geographic: US-located advanced packaging is genuinely scarce, and the 10-Q discloses a July 2026 advance payment agreement under which Amkor expects to receive approximately $1.5 billion in 2027 (coverage identifies the counterparty as NVIDIA), plus about $300M of other advance payments of which $100.0M has been received, with management describing Arizona Phase 1 as fully committed and Apple as anchor customer. The latest reported period is Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported 07-27, 10-Q filed 07-28): revenue $1,898.0M (+25.6% YoY), gross margin inflecting from 12.0% to 16.8%, operating margin 10.5%, EPS $0.70 and EBITDA $400M, with Q3 guided to an 18.5-19.5% gross margin and $0.72-0.82 of EPS. The structural risks are equally clear: Apple was 29.8% and Qualcomm 11.1% of FY2025 net sales; 2026 capex is guided to $2.5-3.0B against $904.6M in FY2025; trailing free cash flow is -$172.4M and FY2026E free cash flow is roughly -$1.0B to -$1.7B; and management has pre-announced that underutilized Arizona capacity will drag both gross and operating margin in 2027 and 2028. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of $48.26 (48.4% below the 06-22 closing high of $93.55, after a 24.7% single-session fall on 07-28), market cap is about $11.99B and enterprise value about $11.96B, at about 21.6x trailing GAAP earnings, 1.60x EV/TTM revenue, 8.6x EV/TTM EBITDA and 2.58x book - but EV over EBITDA-minus-capex is $11.96B divided by $24.6M. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid reads a close-to-balanced skew, so the initiation opens at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: advanced-packaging 层首个节点：本层此前为空，AMKR 以架构校验身份开层，本书 schema 至此不再有空层
核心结论：AI 先进封装的瓶颈压倒性地是台积电的——82% “先进产品”是含智能手机倒装的口径产物、稼动率仅 70% 区间、无实质在手订单、Q3 指引同比 -1.9% 至 +3.2%；且 Q3 通信下滑源于安卓因内存短缺减产约 20%，Amkor 是被卡住的一方
真实的狭窄例外是地理：美国本土产能稀缺，10-Q 披露预计 2027 年收到约 $15 亿预付款（报道指认为 NVIDIA），亚利桑那一期已完全被承诺、Apple 为锚定客户
结构性风险：Apple 占 FY2025 销售额 29.8%；2026 年资本开支指引 $25-30 亿（FY2025 $904.6M），追溯自由现金流 -$172.4M，管理层预告亚利桑那 2027-2028 年拖累利润率
股价 $48.26（2026-07-30 收盘、较 6 月高点 -48.4%）：约 21.6x 追溯 GAAP、约 8.6x EV/追溯 EBITDA，但 EV/（EBITDA 减资本开支）为 $11.96B ÷ $24.6M；30/40/30 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

trigger.zh: 总收入连续两个季度同比负增长（下调依据），或同比增速回到两位数（上调依据）
trigger.en: Total revenue growth turns negative year over year for two consecutive quarters (downgrade evidence), or returns to double digits year over year (upgrade evidence)

latest.en: Q2 2026 revenue was $1,897.965M, +25.6% YoY and +12.7% QoQ, a record quarter; H1 was $3,582.666M, +26.5%. Q3 is guided to $1.95-2.05B against $1,986.968M actual in Q3 2025, or -1.9% to +3.2% YoY (midpoint +0.7%) and +2.7% to +8.0% QoQ; one quarter near zero growth, not yet two consecutive negative quarters

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 财报（2026 年 10 月下旬）/ Q3 2026 earnings (late October 2026)

trigger.zh: 毛利率连续两个季度回落到约 15% 以下，或全网稼动率回到 50-60% 区间（下调依据）；毛利率连续两个季度维持在 19% 以上（上调依据）
trigger.en: Gross margin falls back below ~15% for two consecutive quarters, or network utilization returns to the 50-60% range (downgrade evidence); gross margin holds above 19% for two consecutive quarters (upgrade evidence)

latest.zh: 毛利率三个季度走出 12.0%（2025 Q2）→ 14.2%（2026 Q1）→ 16.8%（2026 Q2），Q3 指引 18.5-19.5%；管理层在 Q2 电话会称稼动率由 50% 区间提升到 70% 区间、若干技术平台满产（平台未点名），并把 Q2 毛利率提升的约三分之二归因于放量/稼动、三分之一归因于产品结构；Q2 销售成本为材料 52.6%、人工 10.0%、折旧 8.6%、其他制造 12.0%
latest.en: Gross margin ran 12.0% (Q2 2025) → 14.2% (Q1 2026) → 16.8% (Q2 2026), with Q3 guided to 18.5-19.5%. On the Q2 call management said utilization improved from the 50% range into the 70% range with several technology platforms at full capacity (the platforms were not named), and attributed roughly two-thirds of the Q2 margin expansion to volume/utilization and one-third to product mix; Q2 cost of sales was 52.6% materials, 10.0% labour, 8.6% depreciation and 12.0% other manufacturing

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季毛利率与 Q3 指引兑现情况 / quarterly gross margin and delivery against the Q3 guide

metric.zh: 资本开支相对指引与自由现金流谷底
metric.en: Capex against the guide and the free-cash-flow trough

trigger.zh: FY2026 资本开支突破 $30 亿指引上限，或 FY2027 资本开支指引超过约 $25 亿；或 2026 下半年现金资本开支显著低于隐含的 $18.1-23.1 亿（意味着指引虚高或亚利桑那滑期）；或净债务超过约 1.5 倍 EBITDA
trigger.en: FY2026 capex exceeds the $3.0B top of the guide, or FY2027 capex guidance exceeds ~$2.5B; or H2 2026 cash capex tracks materially below the implied $1.81-2.31B (meaning either an inflated guide or Arizona slipping); or net debt exceeds ~1.5x EBITDA

latest.zh: FY2026 资本开支指引 $25-30 亿，对比 FY2025 的 $904.6M（占销售额 13.5%）与 FY2024 的 $743.8M（11.8%）；2026 上半年现金资本开支仅 $688.425M，隐含下半年 $18.1-23.1 亿；应付资本开支已由年末 $243.543M 升至 $621.326M，采购义务 $1,465.2M 中 $1,395.1M 在 12 个月内到期；追溯自由现金流 -$172.4M（经营现金流 $1,194.6M 减资本开支 $1,366.9M）；净现金仍为正但仅 $26.5M（现金 $1,551.890M + 短期投资 $960.272M 减债务 $2,485.7M）；下半年实际支出尚无数据
latest.en: FY2026 capex is guided to $2.5-3.0B against $904.6M in FY2025 (13.5% of sales) and $743.8M in FY2024 (11.8%). H1 2026 cash capex was only $688.425M, implying $1.81-2.31B in H2; capital expenditures payable has already risen from $243.543M at year-end to $621.326M, and $1,395.1M of the $1,465.2M of purchase obligations falls due within 12 months. Trailing free cash flow is -$172.4M (OCF $1,194.6M less capex $1,366.9M) and net cash is still positive but only $26.5M (cash $1,551.890M plus short-term investments $960.272M less debt $2,485.7M). No H2 spending data exists yet

trigger.zh: Apple 披露占比超过约 35%，或在没有替代收入的情况下大幅下降；或前十大客户占比回升到约 72% 以上
trigger.en: Apple's disclosed share exceeds ~35%, or falls sharply without replacement revenue; or top-ten customer concentration rises back above ~72%

latest.zh: FY2025 直接销售中 Apple 占 29.8%、Qualcomm 占 11.1%，前十大客户占 72%；前十大占比已连续两个季度改善，2026 Q1 降至 68%、Q2 降至 66%，驱动力是计算与汽车增速快过通信；财报写明公司没有实质在手订单、客户不提供具约束力的需求预测；Apple 于 2026 年 7 月另向 Broadcom 承诺至少 $300 亿用于美国芯片生产，说明其本土化开支分散于多家供应商
latest.en: In FY2025 direct sales to Apple were 29.8% and to Qualcomm 11.1% of net sales, with the ten largest customers at 72%. Top-ten concentration has improved for two consecutive quarters, to 68% in Q1 2026 and 66% in Q2 2026, as computing and automotive outgrew communications. The filings state there is no material backlog and that customers provide no binding forecasts. In July 2026 Apple separately committed at least $30 billion to Broadcom for US chip production, showing its onshoring spend is spread across suppliers

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季前十大客户占比，及 FY2026 10-K 的点名客户披露（2027 年 2 月）/ quarterly top-ten percentage, and the named-customer disclosure in the FY2026 10-K (February 2027)

metric.zh: 计算相对通信的收入结构

trigger.zh: 计算未能在 2027 年底前达到净销售额的约 30%（下调依据），或通信收入连续超过两个季度下滑（下调依据）；计算达到 30% 且毛利率维持在 19% 以上（上调依据）
trigger.en: Computing fails to reach ~30% of net sales by end-2027 (downgrade evidence), or communications revenue declines for more than two consecutive quarters (downgrade evidence); computing reaches 30% while gross margin holds above 19% (upgrade evidence)

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 终端市场为通信 42%、计算 22%、汽车工业 22%、消费 14%（2026 Q1 为 44/21/21/14，2025 Q2 为 40/22/20/18；FY2025 为 46/20/19/15）；管理层指引 Q3 计算收入环比增长近 30%（AI 数据中心需求与 HDFO CPU 上量），同时通信收入下滑，安卓销售已因内存供应约束下降约 20%；计算距 30% 的门槛尚有距离且时间未到，通信仅有一个季度被指引下滑——两条腿一条不可读、一条尚在阈值内
latest.en: Q2 2026 end markets were communications 42%, computing 22%, automotive-industrial 22% and consumer 14% (Q1 2026: 44/21/21/14; Q2 2025: 40/22/20/18; FY2025: 46/20/19/15). Management guided Q3 computing revenue to grow nearly 30% sequentially on AI data-center demand and an HDFO CPU ramp, while communications revenue declines with Android sales already down about 20% on memory supply constraints. Computing remains below the 30% threshold with the deadline still far off, and communications has only one guided down quarter - one leg is unreadable and the other is still inside the threshold
