metric.zh: 亚利桑那执行与 2027-2028 年利润率拖累
metric.en: Arizona execution and the 2027-2028 margin drag

trigger.zh: 亚利桑那一期建设或投产时点自 2027 年年中完工 / 2028 年上半年投产滑期，或一期“完全被承诺”的说法未转化为点名的多年期合约量，或投产后毛利率被拖到 15% 以下
trigger.en: Arizona Phase 1 construction completion or production start slips from mid-2027 / H1 2028, or the "fully committed" Phase 1 claim fails to convert into named multi-year contracted volume, or gross margin is dragged below 15% after start-up

latest.zh: 一期约 180 万平方英尺建筑面积（报道口径约 75 万平方英尺洁净室），2025 年下半年动工，10-K 称制造预计于 2028 年上半年开始（报道称 2027 年年中完工、2028 年初投产）；截至 2026-06-30 已发生成本 $333.6M，含资本化利息 $5.4M（2025 年内 $128.3M）；两期合计投资由原 $20 亿扩大至 $70 亿，约 3,000 个岗位；管理层在 Q2 电话会称一期已完全被承诺，同时预告未被充分利用的亚利桑那制造将在 2027 与 2028 年同时逆风毛利率与经营利润率；2026 年 5 月签约以约 $33M 购买约 67 英亩追加土地，预计 2026 Q4 交割
latest.en: Phase 1 is approximately 1.8 million square feet of building space (about 750,000 square feet of cleanroom per coverage), broke ground in H2 2025, and the 10-K expects manufacturing to begin in the first half of 2028 (coverage says construction completes mid-2027 with production in early 2028). Costs incurred through 2026-06-30 were $333.6M including $5.4M of capitalized interest ($128.3M during 2025). The two-phase investment expanded from $2B to $7B with about 3,000 jobs. On the Q2 call management described Phase 1 as fully committed while pre-announcing that underutilized Arizona manufacturing will be a headwind to both gross and operating margin in 2027 and 2028. In May 2026 Amkor agreed to buy about 67 additional acres for approximately $33M, closing in Q4 2026

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季亚利桑那成本进度与建设里程碑，投产后的稼动率与利润率口径（事件驱动）/ quarterly Arizona cost progress and construction milestones, then utilization and margin commentary after start-up (event-driven)

metric.zh: 客户预付款与 CHIPS / 投资税收抵免补贴叠加
metric.en: Customer prepayments and the CHIPS / investment-tax-credit subsidy stack

trigger.zh: 约 $15 亿预付款滑出 2027 年，或 $4.07 亿 CHIPS 直接拨款被削减、终止或追回，或 35% 投资税收抵免在资产投入使用后未体现为可回收利益（下调依据）；预付款按期到账且首笔 CHIPS 拨款或投资税收抵免转为现金（上调依据）
trigger.en: The ~$1.5B prepayment slips beyond 2027, or the $407M CHIPS direct funding award is reduced, terminated or clawed back, or the 35% investment tax credit is not reflected as a recoverable benefit once assets are placed in service (downgrade evidence); the prepayment arrives on schedule and the first CHIPS disbursement or ITC benefit converts to cash (upgrade evidence)

latest.zh: 10-Q 披露 2026 年 7 月另行签署预付款协议，预计 2027 年收到约 $15 亿（文件未指名交易对手；报道指认为 NVIDIA，源自 2026-07-23 公布的多年期战略合作）；另预计两年内收到约 $3 亿预付款、收到时均需备用信用证，其中 2026 年 7 月已收到 $1.0 亿；2024 年 12 月签署的 CHIPS 直接资助协议最高 $4.07 亿，以建设与生产里程碑为条件、带审计权与追回条款，**至今一分未收到**；另可享 CHIPS 法案经 OBBBA 修订后对合格美国半导体制造投资的 35% 投资税收抵免，但该抵免挂钩资产投入使用，最早 2028 年
latest.en: The 10-Q discloses that in July 2026 Amkor separately entered into an advance payment agreement under which it expects to receive approximately $1.5 billion in 2027 (the filing does not name the counterparty; coverage identifies NVIDIA, from the multi-year strategic partnership announced 2026-07-23). It also expects about $300M of advance payments over two years, all requiring standby letters of credit, of which $100.0M was received in July 2026. The CHIPS Direct Funding Agreement signed December 2024 is for up to $407 million, conditioned on construction and production milestones with audit and clawback rights, and **no funds have been received to date**. Amkor is separately eligible for a 35% investment tax credit on qualified US semiconductor manufacturing investment under the CHIPS Act as amended by the OBBBA, but that credit attaches to property placed in service, so 2028 at the earliest

monitoring.nextCheck: 2027 年现金流量表与合同负债余额、CHIPS 拨款到账公告、投资税收抵免的税务附注处理（事件驱动）/ the 2027 cash-flow statements and contract-liability balance, CHIPS disbursement announcements, and ITC treatment in the tax footnote (event-driven)

metric.zh: 封装层是否成为供给受限环节
metric.en: Whether the packaging layer becomes a supply-constrained link

trigger.zh: Amkor 或同层竞争者声明先进封装处于配给状态、交期显著拉长，或某个点名的 AI 加速器项目因封装产能不足而延期，或有客户在台积电之外双源 2.5D / HDFO 封装——任一情况都会把本层由架构读数升级为约束读数
trigger.en: Amkor or a peer states that advanced packaging is on allocation or that lead times have extended materially, or a named AI accelerator program slips for want of packaging capacity, or a customer dual-sources 2.5D / HDFO packaging outside TSMC - any of which would upgrade this layer from an architecture read to a constraint read

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 全网稼动率由 50% 区间升至 70% 区间，管理层称若干技术平台满产但未点名是哪些；财报写明业务通常不带有任何实质在手订单、客户不提供具约束力预测且存在重复下单；Q3 收入指引对 2025 Q3 实绩为同比 -1.9% 至 +3.2%；且 Q3 通信下滑被归因于安卓因内存供应约束减产约 20%——当前可见的卡口约束在内存层而非封装层；台积电自身 2026 Q2 的财报、演示与管理层报告并未量化 CoWoS 排产
latest.en: In Q2 2026 network utilization improved from the 50% range into the 70% range, with management saying several technology platforms were at full capacity but not naming them. The filings state the business typically carries no material backlog, that customers give no binding forecasts and that double booking occurs. Q3 revenue is guided to -1.9% to +3.2% against Q3 2025 actual, and the guided Q3 decline in communications is attributed to Android volumes falling about 20% on memory supply constraints - so the visible binding constraint sits in the memory layer, not the packaging layer. TSMC's own Q2 2026 release, presentation and management report do not quantify CoWoS scheduling

monitoring.nextCheck: Amkor 与同层竞争者每季的产能、配给与交期口径，以及台积电的 CoWoS / 3DFabric 产能评论（事件驱动）/ quarterly capacity, allocation and lead-time commentary from Amkor and its peers, plus TSMC's CoWoS / 3DFabric capacity commentary (event-driven)

metric.zh: 估值倍数相对资本周期的位置
metric.en: Valuation multiple against the capital cycle

trigger.zh: EV/EBITDA 在自由现金流仍为负时升到约 12 倍以上（下调依据），或在自由现金流转正时压缩到约 7 倍以下（上调依据）
trigger.en: EV/EBITDA rises above ~12x while free cash flow is still negative (downgrade evidence), or compresses below ~7x while free cash flow turns positive (upgrade evidence)

latest.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $48.26 与 10-Q 封面 248,452,472 股计，市值约 $11.99B、企业价值约 $11.96B（净现金约 $26.5M）：约 21.6x 追溯 GAAP 市盈率、约 1.60x EV/追溯收入、约 8.6x EV/追溯 EBITDA（$1,391.5M）、约 18.6x EV/追溯经营利润、约 2.58x 市净率、约 18.6x 本报告 FY2026E EPS 约 $2.60；但 EV/（追溯 EBITDA 减追溯资本开支）为 $11.96B ÷ $24.6M，且追溯自由现金流为 -$172.4M；股价较 2026-06-22 收盘高点 $93.55 低 48.4%；提示：约 $15 亿预付款于 2027 年到账后将同时体现为现金与合同负债，简单的“市值减净现金”会把企业价值低估约 $15 亿
latest.en: At the 2026-07-30 close of $48.26 and the 248,452,472 shares on the 10-Q cover, market cap is about $11.99B and enterprise value about $11.96B (net cash ~$26.5M): about 21.6x trailing GAAP earnings, 1.60x EV/TTM revenue, 8.6x EV/TTM EBITDA ($1,391.5M), 18.6x EV/TTM operating income, 2.58x book and about 18.6x this report's FY2026E EPS of roughly $2.60. But EV over TTM EBITDA minus TTM capex is $11.96B divided by $24.6M, and trailing free cash flow is -$172.4M. The price is 48.4% below the 2026-06-22 closing high of $93.55. Note for future grading: once the ~$1.5B prepayment lands in 2027 it will sit as cash and as a contract liability simultaneously, so a naive market-cap-minus-net-cash EV will understate enterprise value by about $1.5B

monitoring.nextCheck: 每季价格账本与 Q3/Q4 的 EBITDA 与自由现金流实绩 / quarterly price ledger and Q3/Q4 EBITDA and free-cash-flow actuals

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $48.26（2026-07-30 收盘）计，这是本覆盖中少见的一个两侧都成立、且互不抵消的局面，因此立场落在中性观察而不是偏多或谨慎。看多的一侧是估值与拐点：股价较 06-22 收盘高点 $93.55 低 48.4%，07-28 单日 -24.7%；约 21.6x 追溯 GAAP、约 8.6x EV/追溯 EBITDA、约 1.60x EV/收入、约 2.58x 市净率；而毛利率三个季度由 12.0% 拐到 16.8% 且 Q3 指引 18.5-19.5%，经营利润率由 6.1% 升到 10.5%，全部基于干净的 GAAP、无非 GAAP EPS 可争。反推检验也不苛刻：以 8% 年化走三年到 8 倍 EV/EBITDA 终值，只需约 11% 的 EBITDA 复合增速，而把 Q3 指引年化已接近 $17 亿——基准情景跨得过去，这就是本次不开谨慎的原因。看空的一侧不是盈利而是所有者盈余：EV/（EBITDA 减资本开支）是 $11.96B 除以 $24.6M，追溯自由现金流 -$172.4M，FY2026E 约 -$10 亿至 -$17 亿（占市值 8-14%），净现金在一致的不含租赁口径下已由 2025 年末约 $5.461 亿降至 $26.5M（期间还募了 $11.5 亿零票息可转债），4 月授权的 $3 亿回购一分未用，而管理层已预告吞掉这些现金的亚利桑那资产将在 2027-2028 年同时拖累毛利率与经营利润率。换句话说，市场没有错误定价 Amkor 的盈利，它是在拒绝为被一项不可逆建设完全吞掉、且 2028 年才开始产出的盈利付钱。确信度为中而非高，是因为决定此事的三个变量——2028 年亚利桑那稼动率、Apple 是否维持在 30% 附近（FY2025 为 29.8%）、内存短缺还要压制占收入 42% 的通信多久——全都在当前披露窗口之外；为中而非低，是因为事实底稿只有三天（Q2 财报 07-27、10-Q 07-28）、是一手的、且以本覆盖标准看异常干净。
stanceRationale.en: At $48.26 (the 2026-07-30 close) this is one of the rare situations in this coverage where both sides genuinely hold and neither cancels the other, which is why the stance lands at neutral-watch rather than constructive or cautious. The positive side is valuation and inflection: the price is 48.4% below the 06-22 closing high of $93.55 after a 24.7% single-session fall on 07-28, at about 21.6x trailing GAAP earnings, 8.6x EV/TTM EBITDA, 1.60x EV/revenue and 2.58x book, while gross margin inflected from 12.0% to 16.8% over three quarters with 18.5-19.5% guided for Q3 and operating margin rose from 6.1% to 10.5% - all on clean GAAP with no non-GAAP EPS to argue about. The reverse test is undemanding too: earning 8% a year for three years to a terminal 8x EV/EBITDA needs only about 11% compound EBITDA growth, and annualizing the Q3 guide is already near $1.7B. The base case clears that, which is why this is not a cautious initiation. The negative side is not earnings but owner earnings: EV over EBITDA-minus-capex is $11.96B divided by $24.6M, trailing free cash flow is -$172.4M and FY2026E free cash flow is roughly -$1.0B to -$1.7B, or 8-14% of market cap in a single year. Net cash has fallen from about $546.1M at year-end 2025 to $26.5M on a consistent leases-exclusive basis despite raising $1.15B of zero-coupon converts, the $300M buyback authorized in April is entirely unused, and management has pre-announced that the Arizona asset consuming all of this cash will drag both gross and operating margin in 2027 and 2028. Put differently: the market is not mispricing Amkor's earnings, it is declining to pay for earnings that are fully consumed by an irreversible build whose output starts in 2028. Conviction is medium rather than high because the three variables that settle this - Arizona utilization in 2028, whether Apple stays near 30% (29.8% in FY2025), and how long the memory shortage throttles the 42% of revenue that is communications - all sit outside the current disclosure window; and medium rather than low because the fact base is three days old (Q2 results 07-27, 10-Q 07-28), primary, and unusually clean by the standards of this coverage.

upgrade.zh: 毛利率连续两个季度维持在 19% 以上，同时计算向占收入 30% 增长且总收入回到两位数同比增速；约 $15 亿预付款按期在 2027 年到账，且首笔 CHIPS 拨款或 35% 投资税收抵免转为现金；FY2027 资本开支指引回归到约 $20 亿以下，使自由现金流可见地走在 2029 年转正的路径上；且 Apple 披露占比维持在约 30% 以下而未留下收入缺口——则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Gross margin holds above 19% for two consecutive quarters while computing grows toward 30% of revenue and total revenue returns to double-digit year-over-year growth; the ~$1.5B prepayment is received on schedule in 2027 and the first CHIPS disbursement or 35% investment tax credit converts to cash; FY2027 capex guidance normalizes below ~$2.0B so that free cash flow is visibly on a path to positive by 2029; and Apple's disclosed share stays below ~30% without leaving a revenue hole - upgrade to constructive.

downgrade.zh: 毛利率连续两个季度回落到约 15% 以下，或全网稼动率回到 50-60% 区间；FY2026 资本开支突破 $30 亿指引上限，或 FY2027 资本开支指引超过约 $25 亿；约 $15 亿预付款滑出 2027 年；Apple 披露占比超过约 35%，或在没有替代收入的情况下大幅下降；或总收入连续两个季度同比负增长——则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: Gross margin falls back below ~15% for two consecutive quarters or network utilization returns to the 50-60% range; FY2026 capex exceeds the $3.0B top of the guide or FY2027 capex guidance exceeds ~$2.5B; the ~$1.5B prepayment slips beyond 2027; Apple's disclosed share exceeds ~35% or falls sharply without replacement revenue; or total revenue growth turns negative year over year for two consecutive quarters - downgrade to cautious.

title: Kioxia 铠侠深度研究报告 - NAND 发明者的 AI 存储超级周期与顶峰定价
titleEn: Kioxia Deep Research Report - The NAND Inventor's AI Storage Supercycle and Peak-Cycle Pricing
summary: 首次覆盖铠侠作为 memory-storage 层第四块拼图。Q1 FY2026 营收 ¥1.767 万亿（同比 5.2 倍）、营业利润率 71.9%、归母净利润 ¥8,422 亿；H1 指引隐含 Q2 营业利润率约 79%。官方 Q1 资产负债表显示 2026-06 末现金 ¥7,910 亿、债券与借款 ¥6,346 亿，即约 ¥1,565 亿净现金（不含租赁）。同日公告为 1 股拆为 3 股及上限 ¥8,000 亿/3,000 万股回购框架。按 2026-07-31 收盘 ¥46,500、市值约 ¥25.48 万亿，TTM P/E 约 18.5 倍；20/50/30 情景中点加权净利约 ¥1.17 万亿、股权价值约 ¥15.7 万亿。反向倍数隐含约 18.5% 三年盈利 CAGR，而基准情形假设利润回归，故谨慎 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial coverage of Kioxia as the fourth memory-storage report. Q1 FY2026 revenue was ¥1,767.1B (5.2x YoY), operating margin 71.9%, and profit attributable to owners ¥842.2B; H1 guidance implies about 79% Q2 operating margin. The official Q1 balance sheet shows ¥791.0B cash and ¥634.6B of bonds and borrowings at June 2026, or about ¥156.5B net cash before leases. The same-day disclosures authorize a 3-for-1 split and a buyback facility up to ¥800B / 30M shares. At the 2026-07-31 close of ¥46,500 and about ¥25.48T market cap, TTM P/E is about 18.5x; a 20/50/30 midpoint scenario weights sustainable profit at ¥1.17T and equity value at ¥15.7T. Reverse-multiple math implies about 18.5% three-year earnings CAGR while the base case expects normalization, supporting cautious / medium conviction.
highlights: Q1 FY2026：营收 ¥1.767 万亿（同比 5.2 倍）、营业利润 ¥1.270 万亿（利润率 71.9%）、归母净利润 ¥8,422 亿；H1 指引隐含 Q2 利润率约 79%
2026-06 末已达约 ¥1,565 亿净现金（现金 ¥7,910 亿减债券与借款 ¥6,346 亿，不含租赁），纠正源分支沿用的 3 月末净负债
公司公告为 1 股拆为 3 股；回购框架上限 ¥8,000 亿 / 3,000 万股（流通股 5.5%），实际执行可低于上限或为零
¥46,500（2026-07-31 收盘）、市值约 ¥25.48 万亿；情景中点加权净利约 ¥1.17 万亿、股权价值约 ¥15.7 万亿，反向倍数隐含约 18.5% 盈利 CAGR——谨慎 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 ¥46,500、约 ¥25.48 万亿市值计，TTM P/E 约 18.5 倍。若三年后倍数回归 14 倍并要求 8% 年化回报，当前价格隐含约 18.5% 盈利 CAGR；但 20/50/30 情景中点加权的可持续净利仅约 ¥1.17 万亿、股权价值约 ¥15.7 万亿，且基准情形假设利润由当前 TTM 约 ¥1.38 万亿回归。Q1 已转为净现金与回购框架是正面证据，但顶峰利润持续性与供给响应使预期差仍为负。
stanceRationale.en: At ¥46,500 and about ¥25.48T of market cap, TTM P/E is roughly 18.5x. If the multiple normalizes to 14x over three years with an 8% hurdle, the price implies about 18.5% earnings CAGR; yet the 20/50/30 midpoint scenario weights sustainable profit at only about ¥1.17T and equity value at ¥15.7T, while the base case expects profit to normalize from about ¥1.38T TTM. Q1 net cash and the buyback facility are positives, but peak-profit durability and the supply response leave a negative expectation gap.

upgrade.zh: 若连续两个季度行业产能纪律无恶化（K3 未批准或延后、三星/SK 扩产克制、YMTC 三期爬坡低于预期），且 H1 指引兑现、全年指引恢复、回购按上限执行，则上调至 neutral-watch。
upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch if capacity discipline holds for two consecutive quarters (K3 not approved or deferred, restrained Samsung/SK expansion, YMTC Phase 3 ramping below plan) while H1 guidance is delivered, full-year guidance returns, and the buyback executes toward its ceiling.

downgrade.zh: 若任一季度营业利润率环比回落超过 5pp、NAND 合约价环比转负并伴随指引下修，或三星宣布激进扩产，则下调至 bearish-avoid 方向重新评估。
downgrade.en: Reassess toward bearish-avoid if any quarter shows a sequential operating-margin drop of more than 5pp, NAND contract pricing turns sequentially negative alongside a guidance cut, or Samsung announces an aggressive capacity expansion.

title: Palantir 深度研究报告 - AI 应用变现跑通了，但价格在跟倍数赛跑
titleEn: Palantir Deep Research Report - Application-Layer AI Monetization Works, but the Price Is Racing the Multiple
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的应用层订单质量仪表盘首次覆盖：本书此前只有 AI 基础设施的买方（MSFT/META/GOOG/AMZN/ORCL）、转租方（CRWV/NBIS）和模型方（MiniMax），缺一个能证明「最后一公里」跑通的标的——终端企业真的为 AI 应用付大钱，而卖方还能赚到真实利润。2026 Q2（季度截至 2026-06-30，08-03 盘后发布）给出了本覆盖书最强的一份经营答卷：收入 $19.35 亿（+93%，连续五个季度加速）、美国商业 +149%、GAAP 营业利润率 47%（一年前 26.8%）、调整后自由现金流 $12.20 亿（利润率 63%）、Rule of 40 达 155%、美国商业 TCV +153% 快于收入增速、现金 $92 亿对债务 $2.12 亿。风险不在生意而在价格：以 2026-08-03 收盘 $125.65 为主锚（Q2 于该收盘后发布，盘后指示价 $144.42），市值约 $3,012 亿、约 107 倍追溯 GAAP 盈利（还原 1.3% 有效税率后约 134 倍）、约 48.9 倍追溯收入、约 36.9 倍 FY2026 指引收入。决定性证据是它自己的历史：2025-11-03 至 2026-06-25 股价跌 48%，同期季度增速却从 63% 加速到 85%——倍数压缩快于生意复利。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格读出负向预期差，初始立场谨慎 / 中确信，且明确是估值与倍数风险判断，不是生意质量判断。
summaryEn: Initial application-layer order-quality dashboard coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer. Until now the book held buyers of AI infrastructure (MSFT/META/GOOG/AMZN/ORCL), renters of it (CRWV/NBIS), and a model builder (MiniMax), but nothing that proved the last mile works: that an end enterprise writes a large cheque for an AI application and the vendor selling it earns a real margin. Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported 08-03 after the close) is the strongest operating print in this entire book: revenue $1.935B (+93%, a fifth consecutive quarter of acceleration), US commercial +149%, a 47% GAAP operating margin (from 26.8% a year ago), adjusted free cash flow $1.220B at a 63% margin, a Rule of 40 score of 155%, US commercial TCV growing 153% - faster than revenue - and $9.2B of cash against $212M of debt. The risk is not the business but the price. Anchored to the 2026-08-03 close of $125.65 (Q2 landed after that close; the post-market indication was $144.42), market cap is ~$301.2B at ~107x trailing GAAP earnings - ~134x once the ~1.3% effective tax rate is normalized - ~48.9x trailing sales and ~36.9x FY2026 guided revenue. The decisive evidence is the stock's own history: it fell 48% between 2025-11-03 and 2026-06-25 while quarterly growth accelerated from 63% to 85%, because the multiple compressed faster than the business compounded. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid reads a negative expectation gap; the initiation opens at cautious / medium conviction, explicitly as a valuation and multiple-risk call rather than a business-quality one.
highlights: demand-risk 层应用层订单质量仪表盘：本书首次覆盖「AI 支出是否转化为终端客户应用收入与利润」这条最后一公里；ORCL/AMZN 盯基础设施订单质量，PLTR 盯应用层订单质量
单位经济已证明：GAAP 营业利润率 47%（一年前 26.8%）、调整后 62%、调整后 FCF $12.20 亿（利润率 63%）、Rule of 40 155%、现金 $92 亿对债务 $2.12 亿、无外部融资需求
盈利质量与稀释是主要瑕疵：追溯有效税率约 1.3%（美英递延税资产仍全额估值备抵，转回后税率结构性抬升）；单季股权激励 $2.65209 亿占收入 13.7%，回购可忽略

stanceRationale.zh: 这是一个估值与倍数风险的判断，不是对生意质量的判断——本书其他 cautious 结论（Oracle 的负自由现金流、Nebius 的杠杆、MiniMax 的模型层商品化）都源于生意本身有问题，而这门生意没有：现金 $92 亿对债务 $2.12 亿、每季 GAAP 盈利、47% GAAP 营业利润率、Rule of 40 155%，是本书最强的经营答卷。问题在价格：以 2026-08-03 收盘 $125.65 计约 107 倍追溯 GAAP 盈利（还原 1.3% 有效税率后约 134 倍）、约 48.9 倍追溯收入；以盘后指示价 $144.42 计为约 123 倍与约 56.2 倍——两个锚点指向同一结论。决定性证据是它自己的历史：2025-11-03 至 2026-06-25 股价跌 48%，同期季度增速却从 63% 加速到 85%，倍数压缩快于生意复利。30/40/30 网格把预期差读为负向。
stanceRationale.en: This is a valuation and multiple-risk call, not a business-quality call. Every other cautious verdict in this book (Oracle's negative free cash flow, Nebius's leverage, MiniMax's model-layer commoditization) rests on something being wrong with the business; nothing is wrong with this one - $9.2B of cash against $212M of debt, GAAP-profitable every quarter, a 47% GAAP operating margin, and a Rule of 40 score of 155% make it the strongest operating print in the book. The problem is the price: ~107x trailing GAAP earnings at the 2026-08-03 close of $125.65 (~134x once the ~1.3% effective tax rate is normalized) and ~48.9x trailing sales; ~123x and ~56.2x at the $144.42 post-market indication - both anchors reach the same verdict. The decisive evidence is the stock's own history: it fell 48% between 2025-11-03 and 2026-06-25 while quarterly growth accelerated from 63% to 85%, because the multiple compressed faster than the business compounded. The 30/40/30 grid reads the expectation gap as negative.

upgrade.zh: 美国商业增速在 FY2027 守住约 100% 以上且国际增速拐头至约 50% 以上、调整后营业利润率维持 ≥60%、股权激励降至收入的约 10% 以下，且前瞻市销率企稳而非继续压缩，则上调至 neutral-watch；若杀估值把上述基本面带到约 25 倍前瞻市销率以下，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: US commercial growth holds above ~100% into FY2027 with international inflecting above ~50%, adjusted operating margin holds >=60%, SBC falls below ~10% of revenue, and the forward sales multiple stabilizes rather than continuing to compress - upgrade to neutral-watch; and to constructive if a de-rate delivers those fundamentals below ~25x forward sales.

downgrade.zh: 美国商业增速跌破约 60% 而倍数仍在约 30 倍前瞻市销率之上、估值备抵转回叠加常态税率暴露出显著更慢的 GAAP EPS 增长、美国商业订单增速连续两个季度低于收入增速，或政府预算/政策事件损害占比 42% 的政府基本盘，则下调至 bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: US commercial growth decelerates below ~60% while the multiple is still above ~30x forward sales, a valuation-allowance release plus a normalized tax rate exposes materially slower GAAP EPS growth, US commercial bookings growth runs below revenue growth for two consecutive quarters, or a government-budget or policy event impairs the 42% government base - downgrade to bearish-avoid.

title: ASE Technology Holding 深度研究报告 - 第三方 OSAT 能否拥有独立先进封装份额的架构校验
titleEn: ASE Technology Holding Deep Research Report - Architecture Check on Whether a Merchant OSAT Can Own Independent Advanced-Packaging Share
summary: AI 基础设施书 advanced-packaging 层的第二个架构校验。2026 Q2 合并收入 NT$191.064B（+26.7%）、ATM 收入 NT$126.148B（+36.3%）、ATM 毛利率 27.3%、经营利润率 15.7%，计算占 ATM 收入由一年前 24% 升至 30%；ASE 的 VIPack、2.5D/3D、FOCoS 与测试组合证明第三方 OSAT 能承接有价值的 AI/HPC 工作。但公司仍未点名任何 AI 加速器在台积电之外完成全流程封装，也未披露独立价格或 CoWoS 外包量，因此本层继续是归属与架构读数，不升级为约束读数。以 2026-08-07 收盘 $37.39 计，Q2 加权基本至稀释股权价值约 $82.0-84.2B、企业价值约 $88.3-90.5B，约 15.2-15.6x Q2 年化 EBITDA、32.0x Q2 年化 ADS EPS；三年、11x 退出和 8% 年化回报反推需要约 20%-21% EBITDA CAGR，高于 15%-18% 基准假设。20/50/30 情景网格支持中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: The second architecture check in the AI-infrastructure book's advanced-packaging layer. Q2 2026 consolidated revenue was NT$191.064B (+26.7%), ATM revenue NT$126.148B (+36.3%), ATM gross margin 27.3%, operating margin 15.7%, and computing rose from 24% to 30% of ATM revenue. ASE's VIPack, 2.5D/3D, FOCoS and test portfolio proves that a merchant OSAT can capture valuable AI/HPC work. Yet the company names no accelerator program packaged end-to-end outside TSMC and discloses neither independent pricing nor outsourced CoWoS volume, so the layer remains an ownership and architecture read rather than a constraint read. At the 2026-08-07 close of $37.39, Q2 weighted basic-to-diluted shares imply equity value of $82.0-84.2B and EV of $88.3-90.5B, or roughly 15.2-15.6x annualized Q2 EBITDA and 32.0x annualized Q2 ADS EPS. A three-year reverse test at an 11x exit and 8% annual return requires about 20-21% EBITDA CAGR, above the 15-18% base case. The 20/50/30 scenario grid supports neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: advanced-packaging 层第二个架构校验：ASE 证明第三方 OSAT 能承接高价值 AI/HPC 工序，但仍无点名项目证明其在台积电之外拥有独立封装队列
ATM 计算占比由一年前 24% 升至 30%；凸块/倒装/晶圆级/SiP 占 49%，测试占 19%
Q2 设备资本开支 $1.695B，高于约 $1.45B 的季度 EBITDA；H1 简单自由现金流约 -NT$40.5B
股价 $37.39（2026-08-07 收盘）：约 15.2-15.6x Q2 年化 EBITDA、32.0x Q2 年化 ADS EPS；20/50/30 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-08-07 收盘 $37.39 计，约 15.2-15.6x Q2 年化 EBITDA；三年后以 11x 退出并要求 8% 年化回报，当前价格隐含约 20%-21% EBITDA CAGR，高于 15%-18% 基准假设，且 H1 简单自由现金流约 -NT$40.5B——预期差略偏负；但 Q2 ATM 收入 +36.3%、毛利率 27.3% 和计算占比 30% 的经营证据足够强，因此 20/50/30 网格支持中性观察而非谨慎。
stanceRationale.en: At the 2026-08-07 close of $37.39, ASE trades at about 15.2-15.6x annualized Q2 EBITDA; an 11x exit in three years at an 8% required annual return implies roughly 20-21% EBITDA CAGR, above the 15-18% base case, while H1 simple FCF was about -NT$40.5B, leaving a mildly negative expectation gap. Yet Q2 ATM revenue growth of 36.3%, a 27.3% gross margin and a 30% computing mix are strong enough for the 20/50/30 grid to support neutral-watch rather than cautious.

upgrade.zh: 计算占比持续向 35% 推进、ATM 经营利润率连续两个季度维持 17% 以上、简单自由现金流转正路径清晰，且出现点名的台积电外部全流程 AI 加速器封装项目，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: Computing progresses toward 35%, ATM operating margin holds above 17% for two quarters, the path to positive simple FCF becomes visible, and a named end-to-end accelerator package outside TSMC appears - upgrade to constructive.

downgrade.zh: ATM 毛利率跌破 24%、新产能里程碑滑期、前五客户占比升破 50%，或设备资本开支连续两个季度高于 EBITDA 且没有相应的 ATM 增长，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: ATM gross margin falls below 24%, capacity milestones slip, top-five customers exceed 50%, or equipment capex exceeds EBITDA for two quarters without commensurate ATM growth - downgrade to cautious.
